title: Senior/Staff DRAM BIOS Firmware Partner Lab Support Engineer
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Senior/Staff DRAM BIOS Firmware Partner Lab Support Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will work at the intersection of system firmware and DRAM product engineering. The primary function of this role is to apply system and BIOS firmware—particularly early boot and memory initialization stages—to enable, qualify, validate, and debug Micron memory products on next‑generation platforms.

This role focuses on using firmware as a technical instrument for memory bring‑up, training, configuration, margining, and failure analysis, directly influencing DRAM readiness, quality, and customer success. You will work closely with System Enablers, External platform partners, DRAM Product Engineering to support early silicon, qualification, and customer enablement activities across Nvidia, Intel, AMD, and ARM ecosystems.

What You Will Do

Memory Enablement & Product Support (Primary Focus)

  • Server as the primarily onsite BIOS engineering for enabler and customer
  • Use BIOS and system firmware to:
    • Enable and debug DRAM initialization and training flows
    • Support memory qualification, validation, and characterization
    • Investigate boot, training, stability, margin, and field issues related to memory
  • Analyze and modify memory reference code (MRC) integrations to support Micron DRAM
  • Correlate firmware behavior with electrical and functional DRAM outcomes
  • Develop and use firmware-based debug hooks, controls, and instrumentation to accelerate root-cause analysis

Firmware Development & Debug

  • Design, modify, and maintain early boot firmware (SEC/PEI/Pre‑Memory, SoC init, memory init paths)
  • Integrate and debug platform vendor MRCs (Intel, AMD, ARM)
  • Add firmware support for:
    • New DRAM types, configurations, and revisions
    • Training modes, timing features, and platform‑specific requirements
  • Maintain BIOS images used by:
    • DRAM compatibility and validation labs
    • Failure analysis and characterization teams
    • System partners and select customers

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work directly with:
    • Internal System Enablers and external platform partners
    • DRAM Design and Product Engineering
    • System Validation, Characterization, and FA teams
    • Production Engineering and Quality
  • Translate DRAM-level issues into targeted firmware experiments
  • Represent firmware considerations in platform readiness and qualification discussions

Scope & Influence

  • Independently own complex memory-focused firmware debug efforts
  • Mentor other engineers in memory bring‑up and debug workflows
  • Drive improvements in firmware tooling and processes that increase validation efficiency and product readiness
  • Using AI to make the daily work more efficiency

Required / Preferred Skills & Experience

Experience

  • 5+ years of firmware, low-level systems, or platform enablement experience
  • Prior experience with memory initialization, training, bring‑up, or debug strongly preferred

Firmware & Software

  • UEFI BIOS source development (AMI, Insyde, or equivalent)
  • Hands-on experience with Memory Reference Code (MRC) integration and debug
  • Proficiency in C; working knowledge of Python and/or Assembly
  • Comfortable working in early boot / pre‑OS environments

Hardware & Systems

  • Strong understanding of system‑level interactions between:
    • CPU, memory controller, and DRAM subsystems
  • Familiarity with x86 and/or ARM platforms
  • Experience debugging real hardware issues involving memory stability, training, or boot behavior

Personal Attributes

  • Strong analytical and root‑cause analysis skills across HW/SW boundaries
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Effective collaborator across vendor / engineering disciplines
  • Self‑directed, technically curious, and comfortable operating in early enablement phases

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.​

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Summary

This position will participate in a variety of technical and non-technical activities in support of the organization’s mechanical engineering needs including research and development, product and process design and redesign, sustaining engineering, and equipment and product testing.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Use advanced, extensive knowledge of products, processes, and product application in the performance of job duties.
  • Perform product research, design, development, and testing.
  • Perform product redesign and enhancement.
  • Perform production and test equipment design, development, and testing.
  • Perform sustaining engineering.
  • Participate in manufacturing process improvement activities.
  • Prepare and present proposals, statements of work, technical reports, etc.
  • Provide technical support to manufacturing departments.
  • Perform day-to-day technical and non-technical activities.
  • Assigned to lead and direct engineering projects.
  • Coordinate and direct other members of the engineering staff on assigned engineering projects.
  • May be assigned as a mentor to develop junior engineering staff members.
  • Respond to inquiries or complaints from internal production departments, vendors, and customers.
  • Participate in Company Quality and Safety systems
  • Follow all Trade Compliance policies
  • Perform all other duties requested, directed, or assigned.


Requirements:

Education and Experience:

  • BS(or higher) Mechanical Engineering Technology or Mechanical Engineering Degree
  • 5 years related mechanical engineering experience (as described above)
  • Knowledge of deployable marine seismic data acquisition equipment (preferred)


Job Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret engineering documentation, technical specifications, drawings, financial reports, and legal documents.
  • Ability to apply engineering knowledge to support design, development, implementation, and operation activities.
  • Ability to review, evaluate and analyze technical designs.
  • Ability to prepare, review and evaluate technical documentation, specifications, test plans and procedures.
  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot technical matters.
  • Knowledge of engineering testing - including debugging, design, and DFT (design for test).
  • Knowledge of deployable marine seismic data acquisition equipment
  • Good English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with all levels of the organizations and with customers.
  • Self-starter with ability to work with limited supervision.
  • Proficient with MS Office applications (i.e., Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), ERP systems (preferably IFS), and ability to work efficiently with engineering drawing and modeling packages (preferably SolidWorks, PDMPro, AutoCAD 2D). Mechanical Finite Element. Preferably SolidWorks Simulation.
  • Knowledge of change control practices. Ability to follow engineering change control processes.
  • Knowledge of Trade Compliance classifications (preferably EAR & ITAR). Ability to follow Trade Compliance documentation and labeling requirements. Trade Compliance classification experience is beneficial.
  • Ability to effectively present information to employees, managers, and customer representatives.
  • Excellent project management skills.
  • Ability/willingness to develop/coach/train junior engineers and technicians.

Other Qualifications

  • Ability to research, comprehend and retain job related information and instructions.
  • Ability to concentrate and focus for extended periods of time on technical/engineering work.
  • Ability to frequently work at a computer performing data entry, calculations, technical documentation and drawings, engineering modeling, and extracting data for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to frequently utilize sophisticated math and engineering problem solving skills/techniques.
  • Ability to handle multiple and competing priorities/tasks.
  • Ability to work in production areas, engineering test areas, and with tools, machinery, and equipment which may include pressure chambers and tensioning devices.
  • Operate test equipment such as multimeters, isolation resistance meters, and oscilloscopes.
  • Regularly required to sit, stand, or be mobile throughout the facility.
  • Ability to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required for this position include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Frequently uses computer and occasionally operates office equipment (phone, printers, copiers, etc.)
  • Frequently communicates with customers, managers, employees, and suppliers. Must be able to exchange accurate information.
  • Ability to lead and/or coordinate the activities of others in the group.
  • Ability to move about facility in the performance of work.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet requirements.
  • Must be able to organize work areas.
  • Limited Domestic travel.
  • U.S. Person for access to ITAR-Controlled Technical Data.

Other Qualifications

U.S. Person for access to ITAR-Controlled Technical Data.

ITAR regulations dictate that information and material pertaining to defense and military related technologies may only be shared with US Persons unless authorization from the Department of State is received or a special exemption is used.

A "U.S. person" can be:

A U.S. citizen;

A permanent resident who does not work for a foreign company, a foreign government, or a foreign governmental agency/organization;

A political asylee;

A part of the U.S. government, or

A corporation, business, organization, or group that is incorporated in the United States under U.S. law.

A foreign person is any person who is not a lawful permanent resident of the US and includes foreign governments and organizations.

title: Junior finance professional
description:
We are looking for a Moscow-based junior finance professional to provide financial reporting, compliance and business partnering support across the Etihad Airways’ Europe region. This will be a pivotal role in ensuring all financial related compliance matters are met and ensuring all risks of penalty exposures are managed from a compliance perspective. Furthermore, the role will also require challenging the status quo and identifying opportunities for process improvements across the financial operations from AP, AR, Revenue Accounting and GL perspective.

Accountabilities

title: Software Systems Engineer
description:
At Amentum, we're not just solving problems; we're engineering the future. Our team is driven by an unyielding commitment to innovation, integrity, and collaboration, tackling some of the most significant challenges in science, security, and sustainability. If you're passionate about making a real impact and want to be part of a community that values ethical excellence, this is the place where your ambition can thrive.

Here, we believe that success comes from continuously pushing boundaries and working together to deliver on our promises. We embrace challenges with confidence and are dedicated to creating a secure and vibrant future for all.

We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area for us. We’re happy to discuss hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours, patterns and locations to suit you and our business.

About the Opportunity

An opening has become available in the Robotics and Remote handling Team at Amentum for an enthusiastic and eager to learn Software Systems Engineer. The successful applicant will join a growing team of engineers who specialise in developing, building and deploying robotic systems for solving clients’ challenges such as maintenance and inspection activities in challenging environments across a number of industrial sectors. Primarily responsible for supporting the UK Nuclear fleet, the robotics team have also provided robotics platforms for Space, Defence, Road, Rail and Critical Infrastructure.

The key focus of the role is to provide low level software capability required at the heart of robotic and mechatronic systems. As part of the robotics software team the successful candidate will work on exciting R&D projects alongside other engineers and receive a mix of formal training and mentorship from more experienced members of the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Development and implementation of robotic and mechatronic systems for range of industrial applications.

  • Work alongside colleagues and collaboration partners to innovate and develop best in class solutions to new and novel challenges.

  • Support implentation of solutions where required both within the UK and overseas.

  • Liasion with other associated departments / organisations both within and outside Amentum.

Here’s What You’ll Need

  • Experience with software development (C, C++) including for embedded devices (Arduino, Pico).

  • Experience with communication interfaces (e.g. serial, i2c, can).

  • Familiar with networking (e.g. TCP/IP, DDS, Websockets).

  • Familiar working with hardware (e.g. robots, motor control, sensors).

  • Familiar with software development processes (e.g. git).

Our Culture

Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration.

We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. Supporting mental wellbeing and fostering a sense of connection are essential to how we work.

When we embrace different perspectives and work together, we become more innovative, more agile, and more successful.

We partner with VERCIDA, for greater online accessibility please visit www.vercida.com to view and access our roles. As a Disability Confident employer, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for a vacancy. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact Gillian.Calderwood@global.amentum.com

title: Grant Administrator, Department, Institute, School and Centers (DISC) Pre-Award
description:
The Grant Administrator, DISC Pre-Award supports departmental and institutional efforts in securing external funding for research, training, and creative activities. Rooted in an understanding of federal regulations governing sponsored projects, other sponsor requirements, and institutional compliance requirements, the Grant Administrator serves as a primary liaison between principal investigators (PIs) and the institutional Pre-Award Services team. Under minimal oversight, they provide expert guidance and act as a trusted advisor to PIs throughout the proposal development process, ensuring all submissions comply with sponsor guidelines and institutional policies. This position also collaborates closely with other key institutional offices including the Pre-Award Services Team, the DISC Post-Award Team, and Faculty Affairs to maintain the office’s reputation for providing exceptional partnership to our research community in grants management and to promote Brandeis University’s core mission as a research institution.

Job Description

Pre-Award Proposal Development (90%)

  • Supports a portfolio of sponsored projects proposals and ensures a high-quality product is delivered to the Pre-Award Services team for review and submission, including assisting in the development, preparation, finalization, and submission of the proposals.

  • Obtains and reviews sponsor guidelines for all proposals; advises the PI on administrative requirements in preparing proposal submissions. Coordinates and reviews certain proposal elements (biosketches and facilities & resources) for consistency, accuracy, and completeness. Reviews proposals for consistency with sponsor guidelines on format, compliance with the FOA, font size and page limits, narrative, etc.

  • Works closely with the PI to develop budgets and budget justification, ensuring accuracy. Reviews budgets for consistency with sponsor requirements; monitors for compliance with agency and University guidelines; verifies all financial information, including institutional salaries, fringe, indirect rates, etc. for the project.

  • Ensures all applications meet sponsor and institutional guidelines and deadlines, including management of the Just-In-Time process.

  • Confers with PI and pre-award support staff at collaborating institutions to secure necessary sub-awards documents for proposals.

  • Monitors and facilitates the proposal routing process in compliance with University procedures.

Program Support (10%)

  • Continues to develop in-depth and expansive knowledge of external sponsor regulations and requirements and stays fully abreast of all proposed changes in federal and state regulations and laws affecting sponsored programs, including the Federal Acquisition Regulations, the Code of Federal Regulations and state and institutional policies and reporting requirements to ensure continued compliance

  • May contribute to the development of institutional policies and operational/administrative procedures in relevant areas, and may provide guidance regarding the interpretation of regulations, laws, and policies to the research community.

  • Builds effective relationships with key Brandeis stakeholders with tact and diplomacy.

  • Supports the team by sharing knowledge on the grant administration process, internal procedures, and best practices.

  • All other duties, as assigned.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, advanced degree preferred (MA/MS/JD/MBA/PhD)

  • 2-4+ years work-related experience

  • Experience in a university setting, and familiarity with the research administration function, including sponsored projects administration and policy or a related field involving regulatory work and application preparation (i.e. banking, science, etc.).

  • Understanding of Federal funding agencies and regulatory bodies, and experience in developing approaches to emerging administrative and compliance requirements.

  • Ability to manage ambiguity and be able to juggle and prioritize multiple time-sensitive demands in a rapidly changing organization and environment.

  • A collaborative and inclusive professional style, ability to build strategic relationships with staff at all levels, excellent organizational and communication skills (written, verbal, listening), ability to make strategic connections, and the utmost respect for discretion, confidentiality and professionalism.

  • Ability and inclination to anticipate future opportunities and consequences.

  • Resonance with the mission and goals of the Office’s priorities

Skills & Knowledge:

  • Legal, regulatory, scientific, or social science background helpful

  • Familiarity with research administration and compliance concepts and business processes as well as knowledge of a University setting, including academic and central administrative functions

Dimensions & Scope:

  • Expected to be a part of diverse teams, requiring high degree of collaboration and inspiring confidence with team members.

The maximum salary for the position is $70,000

This job is located in Waltham, MA. While the flexibility of a hybrid schedule is available, the ORA maintains a vibrant, in-office work culture, and working in the office with the team several days each week is required.

Per Brandeis University’s policies, the candidate must reside in a state in which Brandeis is registered to conduct business, currently MA, RI, ME, VT, NH, RI, CT, NY, CA. Relocation assistance for this position is not available. All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States; sponsorship is not available for this position.

Pay Range Disclosure

The University's pay ranges represent a good faith estimate of what Brandeis reasonably expects to pay for a position at the time of posting. The pay offered to a selected candidate during hiring will be based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience and education/training, internal peer equity, and applicable legal requirements.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Brandeis University is an equal opportunity employer which does not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religious creed, gender identity and expression, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, genetic information, disability, caste, military or veteran status or any other category protected by law (also known as membership in a "protected class").

title: Physician Assistant-QHC-12811-003
description:
Under the general (direct or indirect) supervision of a licensed and Board-Certified Physician, evaluates and treats patients with medical and/or surgical oncologic, hematologic and/or surgical problems. Delivers direct patient care; performs routine histories and physical examinations; performs and/or interprets diagnostic tests and/or procedures as detailed in the department specific scope of practice. Participates in teaching and quality assurance activities with other members of the clinical department.

The Hematology/Sickle Cell Physician Assistant functions in the outpatient/ambulatory and inpatient settings. The Physician Assistant plays a vital role in supporting patients and hematologists by coordinating and delivering high-quality care to patients with complex hematologic diseases.

A. Clinical: Under the direct or indirect supervision of the Department’s physician/surgeon of the Medical Staff, performs the clinical duties of a Physician Assistant, including;

  1. Participates in outpatient/ambulatory care, including new and follow-up patient visits, coordination of care, and rendering prescribed treatments.
  2. Provides inpatient consultation, inpatient care, patient rounds, and inpatient consultations under the direction of the supervising physicians/surgeons. May respond to initial requests for service-specific consultation.
  3. Performs medical evaluations, including histories, physical examinations, ordering/interpreting diagnostic tests, and prescribing medications as appropriate, in conjunction with supervising physicians/surgeons. Writes appropriate documentation in patients’ charts.
  4. Performs perioperative management, including preoperative assessments and postoperative evaluations, as directed by physicians/surgeons.
  5. May perform routine or emergency procedures including but not limited to pap smears, irrigation and suturing of wounds or incisions, drainage of abscesses, insertion of nasogastric tubes and intravenous lines, sampling of arterial blood, etc.
  6. Writes appropriately authorized prescriptions including controlled substances.
  7. May initiate or participate in initial management and stabilization of patients or other medical or surgical emergencies.
  8. Assists in/Performs bedside procedures, as appropriate.
  9. Assists in operative procedures as a first assistant, as appropriate.
  10. Educates patients, families, and caregivers about disease processes, treatment plans, and post-treatment care.
  11. Participates in multidisciplinary tumor boards and collaborates with physicians, nurses, and other members of the care team to ensure continuity of care.
  12. Collaborates with physicians, residents, nursing, and other team members to ensure delivery of optimum quality of patient care. Confers regularly with supervising physician to keep them apprised of clinical developments.
  13. Performs other duties pursuant to clinical responsibility, such as arranging follow-up for patients, obtaining informed consent from patient for procedures they are credentialed to perform, recalling patients for further evaluation and treatment, escorting patients, when necessary, to other areas of the hospital, etc. Informs patients of necessary post-discharge instructions as required.

B. Administrative:

  1. Participates in clinical research, including establishing and maintaining research database. Assist with the coordination of clinical trials.
  2. Provides continuity in patient care areas to assure that department and hospital policies concerning patient care standards are adhered to.
  3. Participates actively in the training of new employees. Assures that the training process meets Departmental standards.
  4. Participates in the ongoing quality improvement activities of the Department, as assigned.
  5. Plays an active role in the training of students. Assures that the training process meets Departmental and educational standards.
  6. Participates in special projects, as assigned.
  7. Remains informed of patient management trends based on literature. Participates actively in continuing medical education activities, as appropriate to the scope of practice.
  8. Represents Department on hospital wide committees, as assigned.

-Graduation from an accredited Review Commission on Education for the Physician Assistant (ARC-PA) program, as approved by the New York State Education Department.

-Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Physician Assistant Studies from an ARC-PA–accredited PA program. For those hired after 2026, a Master’s degree (MMS/MHS/MS or equivalent) is required.

-Current certification by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA).

-Current and unrestricted Physician Assistant (PA) license New York State license.

-Current unrestricted DEA certificate for mid-level providers (Full schedule: 2. 2N. 3, 3N, 4, 5).

-New York State Mandated Infection Control Course Certificate.

-American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS) and/or Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certifications as required by Department.

-Specialized certification may be required in specific skills (i.e., central line, PICC, ultrasound, advanced airway) may be required.

-Demonstrates the highest level of professionalism.

-Possesses the knowledge and demonstrates the ability required to effectively diagnose and treat medical/surgical problems under the direction of physician; Demonstrates ability to interact effectively with hospital staff, patients and family members.

-Possesses the necessary manual dexterity and skills required for anticipated clinical duties and physical strength necessary for lifting and proper handling/positioning of patients.

-Strong work ethic and desire to participate in a team-oriented, people-centered, collaborative mission-driven institution

-Demonstrates a high level of interpersonal skills to allow effective communication with a wide variety of team members, colleagues, and physicians.

-Demonstrates a high degree of responsibility required for daily contacts with patients and their families.

-Possesses excellent written and verbal communication skills, bedside manner.

Compensation Statement

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $68.52 - $91.36 Hourly. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

title: Software Engineer, Performance Lab and Tools
description:
NVIDIA is searching for outstanding software engineers to join the Windows DevOps and Test Labs (WDTL) software team. As a WDTL engineer, you will be building and maintaining the systems, tools and infrastructure required to support and verify the DirectX driver software on our broad family of GPUs. A key part of this role involves hands-on management of our automated test lab, ensuring our fleet of test machines is healthy, up to date, and ready to validate drivers across a wide range of hardware configurations. You will support the evolving technologies of our GPU product cycles, including new operating systems, DirectX, HW features and other derivative GPU technologies. You will help NVIDIA deliver high quality graphics drivers and innovative products that continue to make us a world leader in visual computing.

What you'll be doing:

  • Maintaining and operating a lab of automated testing machines, including system imaging, hardware triage, network configuration, and infrastructure uptime

  • Building tools and systems to support automated testing and improve the software engineering process

  • Build and improve driver verification infrastructure to advance the speed and effectiveness of automated testing

  • Support hardware bringup activities for new GPU products, coordinating early driver validation on pre-release silicon

  • Work with various business units launching testing and automation on Windows platforms

  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware and OS-level issues across the test lab environment

  • Applying DevOps principles to improve our systems and processes

  • Be part of a distributed team of highly skilled and expert engineers

What we need to see:

  • B.S. or higher degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field (or equivalent experience)

  • As a skilled developer with at least 3+ years proven experience and you will have at least one scripting language: Perl, PHP or Python

  • Application development skills in C# or a similar compiled language (C++, Java, Go), with experience building tools, services, or automation frameworks. C# is ideal

  • Knowledge of Windows operating system internals (kernel, drivers, registry, imaging, deployment tools)

  • Experience with source control systems

  • Familiarity with databases, SQL, or full stack development a plus

  • Background with tools development and automated test frameworks a plus

  • Experience with hardware product bringup or pre-release silicon validation a plus

  • Experience automating Windows image creation and deployment for test environments a strong plus

  • Hands-on experience managing or maintaining a lab environment of physical test machines a plus

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most resourceful and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 116,000 USD - 189,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until July 27, 2026.

title: Equipment Application Engineer
description:
Brooks is a leading provider of automation solutions with over 40 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, offering precision robotics, integrated automation systems, and contamination control solutions that empower chip manufacturers worldwide. Our product portfolio includes a range of automation solutions, including robots, vacuum systems, and atmospheric robots for semiconductor manufacturing (www.brooks.com).

Are you looking for a place where you can be part of a transformation? Join us at Brooks Automation and be a part of a dynamic organization that is shaping the future of technology.

Equipment Application Engineer

Job Description

About Us

Brooks Automation is a growing, fast-paced technology leader supporting the dynamic and expanding semiconductor market. At Brooks, new ideas, technologies, and ways of thinking are shaping our future. Our customer-focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and collaborate closely to achieve outstanding results.

We are seeking a highly motivated Equipment Application Engineer to join our team and contribute to the deployment and optimization of advanced contamination control solutions.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support for equipment applications, assisting customers with the deployment, optimization, and maintenance of AMC (Airborne Molecular Contamination) control systems.
  • Analyze equipment operation data to identify, resolve, and prevent AMC-related issues.
  • Collaborate with process, equipment, and quality engineers to integrate cross-functional requirements and deliver technical solutions.
  • Participate in equipment testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure system stability and performance.
  • Prepare technical documentation, operation manuals, and customer reports; deliver training and technical presentations.
  • Support new product introduction (NPI) and customer site evaluations, including equipment installation, calibration, and functional verification.
  • Conduct regular customer visits to understand usage scenarios and pain points, providing feedback for product design and feature enhancements.
  • Participate in project planning and progress tracking to ensure quality and timely delivery.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to support customer site requirements.
  • Capable of equipment maintenance and modification.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in engineering-related fields such as Mechanical, Electrical, Materials, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a background in equipment engineering, process integration, or technical support.
  • Familiarity with semiconductor process equipment (e.g., FOUP systems, AMC control units, gas analyzers) and their applications.
  • Experience with equipment validation processes, FAT/SAT, DOE design, and data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, JMP).
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and coordination skills to align requirements and drive project execution.
  • Proficient in technical writing and capable of communicating effectively with international customers in English.
  • Knowledge of cleanroom protocols and relevant standards such as ESD and safety compliance is preferred.
  • Self-motivated, eager to learn, and adaptable to new technologies and challenges.

What We Offer

  • Responsibility for technically challenging projects with significant scope for shaping outcomes.
  • Collaboration with international customers and external manufacturing partners.
  • A modern work environment with short decision‑making paths.
  • Personal and professional development opportunities in project and program management.
  • Attractive compensation and flexible working conditions.

Salary Ranges

NT$1,629,503.39 TWD to NT$2,204,622.23 TWD

title: Udekørende sygeplejerske
description:
Vi opnormerer i det udekørende sygeplejeteam i den vestlige del af Hedensted Kommune. Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel i ældreplejen, med fokus på tid, faglighed og nærvær? Så har du mulighed for at blive en del af et velfungerende sygeplejeteam. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes, når medarbejderne har frihed, tillid og mulighed for at bruge deres faglige dømmekraft.

Om jobbet og opgaverne

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret sygeplejerske til vores udekørende team, som brænder for at arbejde tæt sammen med både borgere og kollegaer.

Vi arbejder i tråd med ældrereformen, hvor borgeren sættes i centrum og hvor faste teams og relationer prioriteres højt. I vores udekørende team får du mulighed for at arbejde tæt med både borgere og kollegaer, samt være en del af en hverdag med nærvær, tid til kerneopgaven og stærk faglighed.

Vi værdsætter tillid til medarbejdernes faglige dømmekraft. Den nye ældrereform understøtter udvikling, trivsel og faglighed, hvilket stemmer overens med det arbejdsmiljø, der er en del af gruppen hos os.

Stillingen er på 30-37 timer om ugen, fortrinsvis dagvagt med 5-6 aftenvagter på otte uger og to weekendvagter på to måneder.

Vores forventninger til dig

Der er behov for stor generalist viden, hvorfor en bred erfaring inden for forskellige kliniske områder, vil blive vægtet højt. Vi har flere sygeplejersker med specialefunktioner og vi varetager både planlagte og akutte opgaver. Sygeplejen ydes dels i borgerens hjem og dels i vores sygeplejeklinik. Der er stort behov for og forventninger til, at du kan udføre, lede, formidle og udvikle sygepleje, samtidig med du har fokus på at gøre brug af borgerens egne ressourcer, da vi arbejder ud fra en rehabiliterende tankegang.

Som primær sygeplejerske arbejder du i tæt tilknytning med et plejeteam, hvor du skal være med til, sammen med lederen at sikre det faglige niveau. Vi vægter højt, at borgerne modtager en omsorgsfuld og professionel pleje og vi anvender TOBS og triagering til tidligt at opspore begyndende sygdom, så vi kan forebygge indlæggelser.

Vores udekørende team har base på Plejehjemmet Nedergården i Uldum, hvor vi har vores daglige gang sammen med den udekørende hjemmepleje. Vi arbejder med fri tjenesteplanlægning, hvor der er mulighed for stor indflydelse på egen arbejdstilrettelæggelse. Vi anvender CURA omsorgssystem og KMD Opus Vagtplan.

Opslaget er langt fra fyldestgørende, men vi håber det alligevel har vakt din interesse, så du vil sende os en ansøgning.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Vi er et velfungerende sygeplejeteam på ca. 20 udekørende sygeplejersker og sygeplejestuderende. Vi er en gruppe, som i en travl hverdag formår at have det rigtig godt sammen – vi prioriterer den kollegiale trivsel og vores leder vægter vores arbejdsmiljø højt. Vi sætter stor pris på højt humør og et godt grin. Vi er gode til at sparre med hinanden og dermed gøre brug af vores forskellige kompetencer samt at fortælle både de gode historier, men også dem, der gør ondt. Har du lyst til at være primærsygeplejerske i det nære sundhedsvæsen og være en del af en rigtig god arbejdsplads, så skynd dig at sende en ansøgning afsted til os.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn og ansættelse efter gældende overenskomst, med mulighed for at forhandle kvalifikations- og funktionsløn.

Har du spørgsmål

Er du interesseret i at høre mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte enten leder Karin Gregersen 40769921 eller teamleder Belinda Mortensen 20124776.

Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfrist den 31. august 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler vil blive afholdt løbende. Når den rette kandidat er fundet nedtages opslaget.

title: Loss Prevention Supervisor
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Patrol all areas of the property; secure rooms; assist guests with room access. Conduct emergency response drills, daily physical hazard/safety inspections, investigations, interviews, and key control audit. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions and alarm systems. Authorize, monitor, and document access to secured areas. Assist guests/employees during emergency situations. Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required. Gather information and complete reports. Maintain confidentiality of reports/documents, release information to authorized individuals. Defuse disturbances in accordance with company policies and procedures. Resolve safety hazard situations. Handle all interruptions and complaints. Escort unwelcome persons from the property. Ensure compliance with alcoholic beverage control laws. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Provide proper paperwork to employees.

Assist management in training, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Teaching Fellow - Health Science
description:
Health Science Teaching Fellow | School of Health Science and Clinical Practice | Full-time | Torrens University Australia

Help shape the future of higher education.

At Torrens University Australia, we're redefining what learning looks like.

We're building a new cohort of Teaching Fellows - innovative, student-focused academics who are passionate about creating engaging learning experiences and helping shape the next generation of teaching and learning.

This is more than a teaching role. You'll join a team leading the evolution of higher education through student-centred learning, AI-enabled teaching, digital innovation, and contemporary learning design.

Why this role?

This role has been created to strengthen Torrens University’s permanent academic workforce, supporting the delivery of flexible, high-quality, student-centred learning experiences across on-campus, online, hybrid and asynchronous learning environments, while enhancing student success and employability.

We're looking for educators who don't simply teach, they innovate.

People who are excited by questions like:
• How can AI enhance learning?
• What does great online teaching look like?
• How can data and student feedback improve the learning experience?
• How do we prepare graduates for careers that don't yet exist?

About the role

As a Teaching Fellow (Health Science), you'll join the School of Health Science and Clinical Practice, where you'll deliver engaging learning experiences across the Diploma and Bachelor of Health Science programs delivering engaging learning experiences in subjects such as Understanding Health, Disease Prevention, Human Structure & Physiology 1 & 2.


You'll combine outstanding teaching practice with digital capability, learning design and innovation to create learning experiences that are flexible, engaging and centred around student success.

What you'll be doing - review Job description for full details

We're looking for educators who…

Put students first: You create inclusive, engaging learning experiences and genuinely care about helping every student succeed.
Embrace innovation: You're curious about new technologies, confident experimenting with AI and digital tools, and willing to rethink traditional approaches to teaching.
Use evidence to improve: You seek feedback, use learning analytics and continuously refine your teaching based on what works.
Collaborate: You enjoy working with colleagues across disciplines to improve learning, share ideas, and solve challenges together.
Thrive in change: You're adaptable, resilient, and excited by working in a dynamic, digitally evolving higher education environment.

Two full-time permanent positions: one based at our Flinders Street Campus in Melbourne and one at our Surry Hills Campus in Sydney.
Hybrid work arrangement: 3 days on campus and 2 days online (negotiable)

What you'll bring

  • MSc, PhD, or equivalent qualification in a relevant discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience in the healthcare sector, with the ability to apply industry knowledge to teaching and student learning.

  • Strong facilitation skills across online and face-to-face learning environments

  • Experience using learning technologies and digital tools to enhance teaching

  • Confidence using, or enthusiasm for adopting, AI-enabled approaches in education

  • Experience designing engaging learning and assessment activities

  • A student-centred approach to teaching and learning

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • A growth mindset and commitment to continuous professional learning

  • Relevant postgraduate qualifications (or working towards completion)

How to Apply - Our recruitment process is different

There is no prescribed format for your application. We encourage you to submit your application in the format that best showcases your experience, teaching philosophy and suitability for the role.

In addition to your CV, you may submit a short video, digital portfolio, presentation, personal website or another format that best represents you. Content matters more than creativity. We're interested in your teaching approach, impact, and capability—not production quality.
Recommended maximum length:
• Video: Up to 5 minutes
• Presentation or digital portfolio: Up to 5 slides/pages

Your application should demonstrate your teaching philosophy, student-centred approach, use of digital technologies and AI, innovation, continuous improvement, and the impact you've had on student outcomes.

Why join Torrens?

Join an institution committed to transforming education through innovation, technology and exceptional student experiences. You'll help shape the future of higher education while working alongside innovative educators committed to student success.

Applications close: 14th August 2026

We will be reviewing applications as they are received.

Application Process: Review > Interview(s) > Reference & Background Checks > Offer

Should you have accessibility requirements or needs please contact sebastian.pabon@torrens.edu.au for confidential support to ensure an equitable, barrier free application process as we have a Reasonable Adjustment Procedure in place to support you through the recruitment process.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete our application process, please contact our Human Resources Department at yourcareer@torrens.edu.au

title: FEM Specialist
description:
We are looking for a specialist with broad FEM experience for our mechanical development department in GN Hearing.

The Team you will be part of:

Welcome to GN Hearing’s Mechanical line of R&D. With a team of more than 20 engaged Mechanical Engineers, we take pleasure in sharing ideas, brainstorming fresh concepts, experimenting with various materials, and designing effective manufacturing solutions.

We do not consider ourselves to be a typical Mechanical Engineering team. We take pride in the unique resources at our disposal, including advanced testing and sound laboratories, and our holistic approach to product development that spans from initial ideas through manufacturing and market evaluation. We utilize a wide range of different simulation tools to secure best performance of our products.

Customer feedback is essential for us, and we are proud of our efficiency and the fact that we are part of launching patient-centric new products on a regular basis. E.g. products like the recent ReSound Vivia that is our most advanced hearing aids to this date.

Our team also has a global scope as we have R&D colleagues in Xiamen, China, who are helpful sparring partners to our projects, while they also own their own projects.

While making a big difference for all our customers we also believe in creating a fantastic work environment. We aim to create a setting that encourages contributions from all and inspires innovative thinking around our products. We believe this is stimulating for our organization and for all team members. We have recently introduced an Agile approach to our projects to ensure that we can keep up with the newest technologies and trends before product launches.

Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

  • Participate in expanding the simulation competence across departments

  • Develop simulation models

  • Contribute to projects by sharing knowledge and conducting simulations

  • Explore new ways of using simulation for optimizing hearing instruments and accessories

  • Implement new material models suitable for the given simulation task.

To perform well in the role, you are likely to bring experience in the following areas:

  • 3DXperience or similar software

  • FEM model creation

  • Python, including integration with macros in 3DXperience

  • Advanced material modelling within polymers and foams, such viscoelastic, plastic materials and hyperelastic behavior

  • Engineering analysis within areas such as structural mechanics, fluid flow, thermodynamics, acoustics, vibroacoustics, drop testing, and magnetic analysis

  • CFD (Computational fluid dynamics)

We work alongside our colleagues in the electroacoustics department, so it is important to have a comprehensive understanding of structural mechanics and vibroacoustics to accomplish our goals.

At GN, we support flexible working whenever possible and trust our people to balance flexibility with the need for in-person collaboration.

We encourage you to apply

Even if you do not match every qualification, we welcome your application if you believe you bring relevant transferable skills. We value mindset and motivation alongside experience, and we are committed to supporting your growth as well as that of your team and the wider GN organization.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. We encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to support an equal application process.

If you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know when accepting the invitation.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than August 25th, 2026.

Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

We review applications on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Due to summer vacations, response times may be slightly longer than usual.

We will close and unpublish the position once we have identified the candidate to hire, this might be before the above-mentioned date.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we create technology that enhances hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss overcome real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and deliver great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

title: Creative Project Manager
description:
The Role

As a Creative Project Manager, you will be the operational backbone of the creative function at our agency. You’ll partner closely with creative strategists, designers, media teams, and contractors to ensure work is scoped correctly, resourced effectively, and delivered on time — without sacrificing creative quality or performance outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving agency environments and can balance structure with flexibility as scopes evolve at the pace of AI-driven change.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Project & Scope Management

• Track and manage project scope across hours, deliverables, and timelines to ensure work aligns with client agreements and internal capacity

• Scope new creative initiatives and iterations, with flexibility to adjust scopes as priorities, performance insights, or AI-driven workflows evolve

• Partner with strategy and account teams to identify scope risks early and recommend solutions

  • Partner with sales and account teams during the scoping phase to validate deliverables against team capacity before contracts are finalized (scope approval from this role is required before client agreements are signed)

  • Flag scope threshold breaches at 75% usage and escalate immediately to service lead and account manager for client notification and billing decisions

  • Track and report absorbed overage costs monthly to quantify revenue impact and inform contract negotiations

Workflow & Resourcing

• Manage day-to-day workflow and allocation of creative strategy and design team resources

• Monitor team utilization across accounts and proactively flag resourcing gaps or bandwidth constraints

• Coordinate timelines and deliverables across internal teams and external contractors

  • Escalate capacity conflicts to leadership with clear tradeoff recommendations when competing client priorities exceed available resources (e.g., "Client A timeline slips 3 days OR Client B gets reduced execution quality")

  • Make day-to-day resource allocation decisions within approved capacity; escalate strategic prioritization decisions that require client relationship or revenue considerations

Process & Tools

• Own and maintain creative workflows in Asana, ensuring projects, tasks, dependencies, and timelines are clearly documented and up to date

• Lead recurring creative standups to review work in progress, upcoming priorities, potential challenges, and risk areas

• Identify and implement process improvements to support speed, clarity, and scalability

Collaboration & Communication

• Serve as the central point of coordination between creative, media, strategy, and contractor teams

• Ensure teams have clear briefs, expectations, and timelines before work begins

• Communicate status updates, changes, and risks clearly to stakeholders

  • Flag scope threshold breaches (at 75% usage) and escalate to the service lead and account manager for client notification and billing decisions

  • Escalate capacity conflicts to leadership with proposed tradeoffs when competing priorities exceed available resources

  • Partner with account managers to notify clients of scope departures, timeline impacts, or need for additional budget

Authority and Decision Rights

This role has authority to:

  • Approve or reject project timelines based on team capacity

  • Allocate resources across accounts within budgeted hours

  • Pause work when critical brief information is missing

  • Require brief revisions before creative work begins

This role escalates to leadership:

  • Scope changes that exceed contracted deliverables

  • Capacity conflicts requiring client deprioritization

  • Contract-level decisions on billing overages vs. absorbing costs

  • Strategic tradeoffs between client relationships and team sustainability

title: Quality Control Analyst (HPLC)
description:
🚀 We're looking for a detail-driven Quality Control Analyst (HPLC) with a strong foundation in GMP/GLP compliance, QMS activities, and audit readiness.

Main Responsibilities:

  1. Perform sampling and analytical testing of raw materials, finished goods, intermediates, water, and environmental monitoring samples according to approved monographs and SOPs, with result entry in analytical sheets, QA forms, and LIMS.
  2. Investigate and report out-of-specification (OOS), out-of-trend (OOT), and borderline results, initiating LIRs and CAPAs as required.
  3. Maintain 24/7 audit readiness and actively participate in internal, external, and regulatory audits.
  4. Ensure instrument calibration, verification, and maintenance of reserved samples and storage chambers.
  5. Maintain laboratory housekeeping, cGMP, GLP, and safety compliance standards, including 5-S practices.
  6. Manage chemical stock records, standard reconciliation, and timely labeling of sampled, approved, and rejected materials.
  7. Ensure data integrity compliance in online documentation and maintain awareness across the team regarding data integrity norms.
  8. Support QC efficiency enhancement programs and analysis reduction initiatives.
  9. Complete assigned training and participate in CAPA closure activities.
  10. Perform additional duties as assigned by the QC Manager or Group Leader.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Education: B.Sc, M.Sc. in Chemistry or B.Pharma.

  • Experience: 8-10 Years of Industrial Experience.

  • Preferred Industry: API / Pharma.

title: RFP Writer
description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

Ares Management is seeking a highly motivated, intellectually curious and commercially minded RFP Writer to join the Global Client Solutions RFP Team. This role sits at the center of the fundraising and investor diligence process, partnering closely with relationship managers, product teams, investment professionals and subject matter experts to deliver compelling, accurate and timely responses to RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and other investor-driven requests.

The RFP Writer will help drive high-quality execution across the full response lifecycle from intake and AI-assisted content development through review, production and final delivery, while developing a deep understanding of Ares’ investment strategies, platform capabilities and client needs. The successful candidate will bring strong writing judgment, project management discipline, attention to detail and the ability to use technology thoughtfully to improve speed, consistency and quality in a fast-paced, global environment.

Ares is a flat, flexible, and dynamic organization. The firm fosters a culture of collaboration, entrepreneurialism, integrity and partnership, both internally amongst colleagues and externally amongst clients and other stakeholders. The Ares team operates with a growth mindset, communicates transparently, and cultivates a high-performance and results-oriented environment.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIP

Reports to: VP, Global Client Solutions, RFP

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and project manage RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and ad-hoc investor requests from intake through final delivery, balancing timelines, stakeholders and competing priorities.

  • Partner with relationship management, product strategy, investment teams and subject matter experts to create clear, differentiated and responsive investor materials.

  • Customize proposal language to address investor priorities and diligence themes while maintaining consistency with approved messaging.

  • Develop strong knowledge of Ares’ strategies, products, performance data, platform capabilities and corporate infrastructure to support accurate content creation.

  • Review and validate qualitative and quantitative content, including questionnaires, datasets and consultant database submissions, with a focus on accuracy and quality control.

  • Maintain and govern proposal content across RFP technology platforms, including AI enablement, content reuse and alignment with firm standards.

  • Leverage AI-enabled tools, data and process improvements to enhance drafting efficiency, response quality, workflow transparency and the stakeholder experience.

  • Apply sound judgment when using AI-assisted content, validating accuracy, tone, sourcing and alignment with approved messaging before materials are shared.

  • Serve as a collaborative, solutions-oriented partner with strong communication skills and accountability under tight deadlines.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university or international equivalent, preferably in a related field (economics, finance, accounting, or marketing).

Experience Required:

  • 3-6 years of experience in the financial services or asset management industry, ideally in RFP, investor relations, client service, product strategy, due diligence or a related fundraising support function.

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex written deliverables from intake through final delivery, including drafting, editing, stakeholder coordination, quality control and deadline management.

  • Experience using, implementing or optimizing RFP, proposal automation, knowledge management or AI-enabled workflow tools is preferred.

General Requirements:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex investment, platform and operational information into clear, accurate and persuasive responses.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to organize workstreams, manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders and drive multiple concurrent deliverables to completion.

  • Proactive mindset with the ability to identify process improvements, adopt AI-enabled tools and contribute ideas that enhance team efficiency, content quality and response consistency.

  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality, particularly when reviewing written materials, quantitative data, performance information and client-facing content.

  • Ability to operate effectively under tight deadlines in a fast-paced, evolving environment while remaining calm, organized and solutions-oriented.

  • Collaborative team player who builds strong working relationships across functions, demonstrates accountability and communicates proactively with internal partners.

  • Intellectual curiosity and interest in developing a strong understanding of asset management, investment strategies, private markets and the institutional investor diligence process.

  • Working knowledge of the asset management industry and familiarity with private markets or alternative investment products preferred.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Experience with Salesforce, PowerBI or AI-enabled workflow, content management and reporting tools a plus.

Reporting Relationships

Vice President, RFP

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role.

$100,000 - $120,000

The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long-Term Disability (LTD) and Short-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit.

Ares offers a number of additional benefits including access to a world-class medical advisory team, a mental health app that includes coaching, therapy and psychiatry, a mindfulness and wellbeing app, financial wellness benefit that includes access to a financial advisor, new parent leave, reproductive and adoption assistance, emergency backup care, matching gift program, education sponsorship program, and much more.

There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.

title: Solution Architect Manager - Intern Program
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

Join NVIDIA as an Intern Program Manager in China and take charge of our intern program, driving it with your technical expertise and leadership skills! This opportunity allows you to orchestrate a world-class intern experience, ensuring seamless coordination and successful implementation of projects. Become part of an ambitious team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

  • Serve as the direct manager for all interns, owning program operations end-to-end

  • Handle program logistics: onboarding, offboarding, scheduling, access, and daily operational needs

  • Facilitate check-ins, reviews, and presentations to maintain transparency of intern work

  • Continuously improve the program based on feedback and outcomes

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

  • 4+ years of working experience with some exposure to coordination or people management, above 1 year leading experience

  • Strong organizational and communication skills are required. Proficiency in Chinese and English

  • Technical background sufficient to understand what interns and mentors are working on

  • Ability to work across multiple teams and collaborators simultaneously

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Hands-on experience with CUDA, GPU computing, or HPC

  • Background in LLM training, fine-tuning, or inference

  • Scientific computing or research experience

  • Prior experience running an internship or early-career program

We are excited to learn in what ways you can contribute to our innovative projects and help us build the future of AI!

title: Software Development Trainee
description:
Grow with us

About this opportunity:

Ericsson is a world-leading provider of telecommunications equipment and services to mobile and fixed network operators. Over 1,000 networks in more than 180 countries use Ericsson equipment, and more than 40 percent of the world's mobile traffic passes through Ericsson networks. Using innovation to empower people, business and society, Ericsson is working towards the Networked Society: a world connected in real time that will open opportunities to create freedom, transform society and drive solutions to some of our planet’s greatest challenges.


As Ericsson Finland, we have been privileged to be part of building the Finnish society already since 1918. Over the course of these hundred years, together with our customers and partners we have shaped the Finnish society to what it is today – a leading edge country of technology and digitalization. The same building blocks – enthusiasm, innovations and highly skilled people – carry us towards the next hundred years.


Ericsson is a significant R\&D actor in Finland, focusing on product and network security, cloud, 5G and 6G research. Ericsson Finland employs around 600 professionals and our main office in Finland is in Jorvas, Kirkkonummi.


Utilizing our hybrid workplace model of seamless integration of the physical and virtual workplace.

Join Ericsson’s Distributed Cloud team as a Software Developer Intern and help build the Cloud Container Distribution that powers 5G Core and Cloud RAN. You’ll be contributing to real product features, with a strong focus on AI/LLM agentic workflows integrated into a modern cloud-native stack. You’ll also get hands-on exposure to Kubernetes and cloud networking in a production-grade environment. The internship can be part time and in length 3-6 months, and there is a possibility to combine your thesis work to the internship.



What you will do:

  • Explore and apply agentic workflows (LLM-powered assistants and automations) to optimize engineering processes and improving customer experience e.g., faster troubleshooting, better onboarding, configuration management and smarter documentation use etc.
  • Work with Kubernetes as a platform: help build, configure, and operate services that run in clusters.
  • Support networking aspects of cloud platforms (service connectivity, traffic policies, and reliability)
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional environment: participate in planning, pair programming, reviews, and demos; write clear documentation
  • Evaluate your solutions for usability, maintainability, security, and impact; and iterate based on feedback.

The skills you bring:

  • Enrolled in a BS/MS program in CS/EE/CE (or related).
  • Strong Python skills and solid understanding of data structures and algorithms.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or cloud-native observability (Prometheus/Grafana, tracing, log pipelines).
  • Familiarity with LLMs/AI concepts: prompt design, function/tool calling, RAG basics, evaluation.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and containers; ability to read logs and troubleshoot systems.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals.
  • Clear communication, curiosity, and a bias for hands-on experimentation.


It is an advantage if you have:

  • Exposure to agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI) or vector databases.
  • Experience in fine tuning LLMs or other ML models.
  • Experience in Kubernetes administration and life-cycle management.
  • Go (Golang) proficiency is a plus.
  • Interest in telecom/5G, CNFs, or large-scale distributed systems.

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply?Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Primary country and city: Finland (FI) || Jorvas

title: Director, Platform & Infrastructure
description:

title: Technical Team Lead – Python Data Automation & Web Scraping
description:
