title: RFP Writer
description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

Ares Management is seeking a highly motivated, intellectually curious and commercially minded RFP Writer to join the Global Client Solutions RFP Team. This role sits at the center of the fundraising and investor diligence process, partnering closely with relationship managers, product teams, investment professionals and subject matter experts to deliver compelling, accurate and timely responses to RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and other investor-driven requests.

The RFP Writer will help drive high-quality execution across the full response lifecycle from intake and AI-assisted content development through review, production and final delivery, while developing a deep understanding of Ares’ investment strategies, platform capabilities and client needs. The successful candidate will bring strong writing judgment, project management discipline, attention to detail and the ability to use technology thoughtfully to improve speed, consistency and quality in a fast-paced, global environment.

Ares is a flat, flexible, and dynamic organization. The firm fosters a culture of collaboration, entrepreneurialism, integrity and partnership, both internally amongst colleagues and externally amongst clients and other stakeholders. The Ares team operates with a growth mindset, communicates transparently, and cultivates a high-performance and results-oriented environment.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIP

Reports to: VP, Global Client Solutions, RFP

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and project manage RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and ad-hoc investor requests from intake through final delivery, balancing timelines, stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Partner with relationship management, product strategy, investment teams and subject matter experts to create clear, differentiated and responsive investor materials.
  • Customize proposal language to address investor priorities and diligence themes while maintaining consistency with approved messaging.
  • Develop strong knowledge of Ares’ strategies, products, performance data, platform capabilities and corporate infrastructure to support accurate content creation.
  • Review and validate qualitative and quantitative content, including questionnaires, datasets and consultant database submissions, with a focus on accuracy and quality control.
  • Maintain and govern proposal content across RFP technology platforms, including AI enablement, content reuse and alignment with firm standards.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools, data and process improvements to enhance drafting efficiency, response quality, workflow transparency and the stakeholder experience.
  • Apply sound judgment when using AI-assisted content, validating accuracy, tone, sourcing and alignment with approved messaging before materials are shared.
  • Serve as a collaborative, solutions-oriented partner with strong communication skills and accountability under tight deadlines.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university or international equivalent, preferably in a related field (economics, finance, accounting, or marketing).

Experience Required:

  • 3-6 years of experience in the financial services or asset management industry, ideally in RFP, investor relations, client service, product strategy, due diligence or a related fundraising support function.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex written deliverables from intake through final delivery, including drafting, editing, stakeholder coordination, quality control and deadline management.
  • Experience using, implementing or optimizing RFP, proposal automation, knowledge management or AI-enabled workflow tools is preferred.

General Requirements:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex investment, platform and operational information into clear, accurate and persuasive responses.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to organize workstreams, manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders and drive multiple concurrent deliverables to completion.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to identify process improvements, adopt AI-enabled tools and contribute ideas that enhance team efficiency, content quality and response consistency.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality, particularly when reviewing written materials, quantitative data, performance information and client-facing content.
  • Ability to operate effectively under tight deadlines in a fast-paced, evolving environment while remaining calm, organized and solutions-oriented.
  • Collaborative team player who builds strong working relationships across functions, demonstrates accountability and communicates proactively with internal partners.
  • Intellectual curiosity and interest in developing a strong understanding of asset management, investment strategies, private markets and the institutional investor diligence process.
  • Working knowledge of the asset management industry and familiarity with private markets or alternative investment products preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience with Salesforce, PowerBI or AI-enabled workflow, content management and reporting tools a plus.

Reporting Relationships

Principal, GCS RFP

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role.

$100,000 - $120,000

The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long-Term Disability (LTD) and Short-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit.

Ares offers a number of additional benefits including access to a world-class medical advisory team, a mental health app that includes coaching, therapy and psychiatry, a mindfulness and wellbeing app, financial wellness benefit that includes access to a financial advisor, new parent leave, reproductive and adoption assistance, emergency backup care, matching gift program, education sponsorship program, and much more.

There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.

title: Supply Chain Network Analyst
description:
For more than two decades, NVIDIA has evolved continuously. We invented the GPU in 1999, which drove the expansion of the PC gaming market, reshaped modern computer graphics, and transformed parallel computing. Today, the GPU functions as the core processor for computers, robots, and self-driving cars that detect and comprehend their environments. As we are increasingly recognized as “the AI computing company,” we continue to grow our organization and bring together some of the smartest individuals globally. Join us as we lead the way in technological progress.

NVIDIA seeks a highly motivated Supply Chain Network Analyst to support the design, analysis, and optimization of our global supply chain network. This role sits at the intersection of network strategy and data analytics — you will both build and run optimization models and ensure the data powering those models is accurate, complete, and trusted. You will work closely with Logistics and Fulfillment teams to evaluate network performance, identify inefficiencies, and translate complex analyses into clear recommendations that drive real operational decisions. This is a high-impact role for someone who thinks rigorously about supply chain structure, is comfortable building quantitative models from the ground up, and understands that great network design starts with great data.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Design and evaluate global supply chain network configurations, including warehouse footprint, transportation lane routing, and distribution strategies

  • Build and run cost-to-serve models, capacity models, and service-level tradeoff analyses to support strategic network decisions

  • Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analyses to evaluate network changes driven by business growth, demand shifts, or supply disruptions

  • Partner with Logistics and Fulfillment teams to assess network performance, identify inefficiencies, and develop actionable routing, capacity, and cost improvement recommendations

  • Translate complex optimization model outputs into clear, executive-ready insights and recommendations

  • Develop and maintain data pipelines and analytical models that feed network optimization tools, ensuring inputs are reliable and timely

  • Establish data quality standards and ownership practices for logistics master data — carriers, lanes, locations, lead times, and costs

  • Identify and resolve root causes of data defects to maintain model integrity across the supply chain network

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Business Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

  • 8+ years of experience in supply chain network analysis, logistics operations, or supply chain strategy

  • Hands-on experience building and running network optimization or cost-to-serve models — not just interpreting outputs

  • Experience working with logistics data including transportation lanes, carriers, shipments, lead times, and service performance metrics

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (Python or R) for data analysis and automation

  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings clearly to Logistics and Fulfillment stakeholders

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Network optimization platform background — Coupa/LLamasoft, o9 Solutions, Kinaxis, or similar

  • TMS and/or WMS platform experience in a logistics or fulfillment environment

  • Agentic AI tool exposure — NVIDIA Omniverse or Palantir applied to supply chain simulation, digital twin modeling, or operational intelligence

  • Cloud data platform experience — Snowflake, Databricks, or Google Cloud

  • Background supporting global logistics operations across multiple regions or distribution tiers

NVIDIA offers competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, and is widely regarded as one of the technology industry's most sought-after employers. If supply chain strategy, quantitative modeling, and the opportunity to shape global logistics operations sound like the right challenge — we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 124,000 USD - 195,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until July 27, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Motion Planning
description:
Who We Are

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer who can design and build best-in-class planning systems for autonomous driving in structured, low-speed environments.

In this role, you'll be the technical backbone of the planning stack — owning the design and implementation of production-grade mission planning, behavior planning, and motion planning software. You'll work across the full planning pipeline to achieve category-defining vehicle autonomy for the airside, tackling hard problems in trajectory optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, and real-time constraint optimization.

This opportunity offers a deeply technical engineer the chance to shape a market-defining enterprise product that combines autonomous vehicle technology with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) business model. This role reports to our Planning Tech Lead and works closely with the autonomy engineering team.

You Will:

  • Design, implement, and iterate on the mission planner, behavior planner, and motion planner for autonomous ground support equipment operating in airport airside environments.

  • Drive key technical decisions across the planning stack — selecting algorithms, defining interfaces, and establishing the architecture that the team builds on.

  • Prototype and evaluate new planning approaches (e.g., optimization-based methods, search-based planners, learning-augmented pipelines) and bring the best ideas to production.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with perception, controls, localization, and systems engineering teams to deliver an integrated autonomous driving system.

  • Establish and promote best practices in software development, functional safety, and systems engineering as they apply to the planning domain.

  • Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, code review, and design discussions.

You Have:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Math, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or a related field.

  • Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing planning modules for autonomous systems shipped to production or deployed in real-world operations.

  • Strong programming skills in C++ (preferred) or Python, and experience with Linux-based operating systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous technical problems and drive them to well-architected solutions independently.

  • Excellent communication skills, proactiveness, and a strong sense of ownership.

We Prefer:

  • MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.

  • Mastery of Modern C++ (14 and beyond) and safety-critical coding practices (e.g., MISRA, ISO 26262).

  • 5+ years of industry experience in planning for robotic ground vehicles.

  • In-depth understanding of DDS frameworks like ROS/ROS2 or other networking middleware.

  • Experience in startup environments, demonstrating adaptability to rapidly changing priorities.

title: Content Moderation - Bilingual Danish/English
description:
About TaskUs: TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.


The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.


It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer: At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.




So what does a Content Moderator really do?

Think of yourself as someone who will ensure high quality and safe experiences for both people and businesses across the social media family of apps, so not everyone can qualify for this role. We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top-notch. So come on, now we need your full concentration because it’s time to imagine what It's like being a Content Moderator.

As a Content Moderator, you will be instrumental in keeping our online world engaging, appropriate, and safe. You will apply a content policy to digital content and execute handling procedures with consistency. The best candidates are able to identify subtle differences in the meaning of digital communication and accurately enforce the client’s terms of use by carefully monitoring reports of abuse on the site. You will atively participate in employee assistance programs, program reporting initiatives and training to foster the well-being of you and the employee community. A Content Moderator will escalate through appropriate channels any changes that may impact performance or as necessary to maintain required KPIs. You will also adhere to security measures, confidentiality, and other project requirements in any way related to your work.

So what does all this mean for your day-to-day? In the Content Moderator role, you will be working on a computer each day reviewing content such as videos, news stories, still pictures, political ads, and social media profiles. You will then score this content on areas such as age-appropriateness, level of violence, sexual content, and political transparency. In order to properly identify all of these items, you will be trained on how to enforce the client’s policies, and then use these policies to support the overall business.

As a Content Moderator, you understand the importance of working hard and having fun! You will be given daily time to participate in wellness activities such as dance parties, fitness challenges, on-site wellness programs, video games, and team development exercises. TaskUs provides onsite free munchies, popcorn, and food for purchase from our market or local source food vendors. We also enjoy a good party, so there is always one happening somewhere!

Do you have what it takes to be a Content Moderator?

Requirements:

What is it we’re looking for? Well since this is a Content Moderator we need someone with at least one year prior operations experience in shared services or a customer experience environment. What else?

  • We also need someone with at least a high school diploma or equivalent.

  • We also need someone who is fluent in English and Danish, must be able to read and speak the language.

​

Now let’s get technical.

  • We’re looking for someone who has strong interpersonal skills, verbal and written communication skills and most importantly empathy. Someone who has a high affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported.

TaskUs devotes considerable resources to the wellbeing of its employees. Being a Content Moderator means participating in counseling sessions and other wellness programs:


● All employees will attend wellness coaching sessions to ensure awareness of wellness resources and to ensure job adjustment.
● All employees will attend wellness groups.

Creating a Culture of Awareness and Prevention:
TaskUs believes in being transparent with our new employees about their job duties and the possible impact. Some of our campaigns include disturbing content. Examples of these types of material may include but are not limited to:


● Child exploitation and abuse
● Animal torture
● Gang Violence
● Murder
● Hate Speech

As a content moderator it is important for you to know the potential risks related to this type of work. While TaskUs is focused on employee wellness by having counselors on-site, resiliency programming, and other wellness initiatives, exposure to graphic and disturbing content is unavoidable. Some individuals with a sensitivity to viewing graphic or disturbing content may be at risk for developing distress, mental health symptoms, or, in rare instances, Secondary Traumatic Stress based on the content they are viewing.

TaskUs reserves the right to reassign content moderators to other TaskUs projects based on staffing needs, employee performance, and other considerations. In order to help create a community that is safe for all employees, the Resiliency and Wellness Team takes an active role in the primary prevention of mental health concerns through direct practice efforts, e-learning, skills training, and outreach efforts to the TaskUs community. Our programs seek to raise awareness about psychological issues, challenge ideas that contribute to social inequity, disempowerment, and discrimination, as well as the underlying structures that support them. In addition, our programs empower employees to find and use their voices in a healthy and productive way.

About Us:

TaskUs is the fastest growing tech-enabled business services company in the world, delivering the customer support, AI operations and content security services that power the world’s most innovative companies. Listed as one of Glassdoor‘s “100 Best Places to Work”, USA Today’s “Best Company Cultures” and “Best Companies for Women” by Comparably, TaskUs is a Frontline-First company that puts its people at the heart of everything they do. TaskUs has been recognized as one of the Inc. “5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies in America” for the past seven years consecutively. Founded in 2008 by Bryce Maddock and Jaspar Weir, the company raised over $250mm in 2018 from the world’s largest private equity firm, Blackstone.

TaskUs currently has over 47.000 employees and offices across the U.S., Philippines, India, Taiwan, Croatia and Mexico. To find out more visit www.TaskUs.com.

TaskUs Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

How We Partner To Protect You: TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.


DEI: In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.

We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL https://www.taskus.com/careers/.

title: Senior Planning Engineer
location: Newcastle Upon Tyne, United Kingdom, gb
description:
We are currently recruiting for a Project Planner to undertake duties within our Project Controls team.

The Project Planner will work as part of our Project Controls team on high profile construction projects throughout the UK and Europe, providing performance reporting and analysis support. This may be part of a large team or as the key day to day contact point with the client. Key activities include:

  • Identify trends and root causes of deviations against the baseline using lead and lag indicators, recommend remedial actions to drive best value for the client.
  • Lead the evaluation of the projects time, cost, and quality targets, applying governance controls as necessary to enable the successful delivery of the project.
  • Cooperate with a remote team of cost managers responsible for reaching an agreed, market tested cost baseline and ensuring the client is receiving value for money.
  • Guide and influence the general contractor, ensuring they are progressing in line with the schedule and within agreed cash flow parameters.
  • Act as the key point of contact to the client overcoming delivery and commercial issues whilst preparing formal and ad hoc reports focussing on time, cost and quality targets.
  • Control costs with your knowledge of conceptual estimating, funding stage gates, basic contingency principals, procurement principals.
  • Create and/or work within a cost report, summarizing financials in a executive level dashboard.
  • Understand change management principals, lead agreed change management process and workflow, providing a platform for adding/tracking/monitoring/approving change.
  • Coordinate and lead planning sessions and workshops with clients and vendors to compile the master project/programme schedule, agreeing baselines and a critical path.
  • Understand procurement principals, collate lead times from vendors and client into the master schedule communicate the prioritisation of ordering materials and equipment to meet scheduled install dates.
  • Work closely with the client to define vendor schedule requirements.
  • Actively participate in project team risk evaluations, incorporating the defined risks into Monte Carlo to output quantitative impacts to the overall project cost and schedule.

Job Description:

Senior Software Developer - TS/SCI with Polygraph

Key Skills for Success: Go · Rust · Systems Architecture · Distributed Systems · AI-Assisted Development

Your Impact

Own your opportunity to support the nation's most critical missions. We're looking for builders — engineers with the curiosity to spot problems others have learned to live with, and the instinct to reach for the latest tools, AI included, to solve them. Put your software and architecture expertise to work designing, building, and sustaining the systems that keep sensitive operations secure, reliable, and ready, and grow your career alongside a team that values iteration and shares every improvement to lift the whole group up.

Job Description

We're looking for a versatile Senior Software Developer to design, build, and deliver mission-critical software for a government customer in the U.S. Intelligence Community. This is a wear-multiple-hats role for an engineer who is comfortable across the whole stack — someone who can set the architectural direction for a system and then chase a problem through it all the way down to the kernel. You'll participate across the full software development lifecycle — designing and documenting systems, writing code and automated tests, and planning and monitoring production deployments — taking ownership of what you build, from architecture and implementation through containerized build and deployment. You'll bring modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development, to a team that values reliability and maintainability above all. People are our advantage: we invest in your growth as much as you invest in the mission.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
This role designs, builds, and supports complex software systems that directly enable mission success. You will:

• Architect full end‑to‑end software systems and services — defining structure, interfaces, technology choices, and making thoughtful trade-offs based on mission needs and technical constraints.
• Research, design, develop, and modify enterprise software throughout the full software development lifecycle.
• Create architecture diagrams, design documents, and technical patterns that guide other engineers and support long-term scalability and maintainability.
• Write production-grade software primarily in Go and Rust, plus shell/Bash for automation and supporting tools. Develop automated tests to ensure ongoing reliability.
• Contribute to front-end development in TypeScript and React when needed.
• Use AI-assisted and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) as part of daily development — analyzing codebases, troubleshooting production systems, and accelerating problem-solving — while applying good judgment about when human review is required.
• Package, build, and deploy containerized applications in modern orchestrated, GitOps-driven environments. Plan, manage, and monitor deployments, owning the reliability of the software you ship.
• Build internal tools, CLIs, and APIs that streamline development, build, and deployment workflows.
• Work across the entire stack — application code, container runtime, OS, and kernel — to diagnose issues and deliver solutions within distributed, mission-critical systems.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your engineering expertise and passion for innovation to GDIT. The Software Developer Sr Principal must have:

• Education: Technical training, certifications, or a relevant degree.
• Experience: 8+ years of professional software development experience.
• Required technical skills:
– Systems-level programming in Go and/or Rust
– Strong Linux and shell/Bash skills, including understanding at the kernel level
– Experience designing and architecting software/systems
– Building secure, highly available distributed systems
– Containerized software development (e.g., Docker/OCI)
– Writing automated tests and using CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code
– Hands-on experience with AI-assisted or agentic coding tools


• Security clearance: Ability to obtain TS/SCI with Poly (We will sponsor the selected candidate if you do not already have the required clearance)
• Citizenship: US citizenship required


• Role requirements:
– Ability to architect systems and make thoughtful technical trade-offs
– Strong debugging skills in complex, distributed environments
– Comfortable working across the full stack, including OS and kernel internals
– Skilled at troubleshooting, hardening, and improving system reliability
– Able to work independently with limited supervision
– Strong communication skills
– Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools into daily engineering workflows
• Preferred skills:
– Kubernetes (highly desired) and GitOps-based delivery (Flux, Argo CD)
– Systems-level experience with C or C++
– TypeScript/React UI development
– Container tooling (Docker Compose)
– Renovate
– Monitoring, alerting, and debugging large-scale distributed systems
– Building tools and APIs
– Open-source contribution or maintenance


GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.
● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a career in software development at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your dedication to advancing innovation.

title: Senior Operations Reliability Engineer – IAM
description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Sr. Operations Reliability Engineer - IAM
Mexico (Virtual)

Role Overview:
Drive the reliability and resilience of enterprise identity services that enable secure access for a global workforce. This role ensures authentication, provisioning, and identity lifecycle processes operate seamlessly across critical platforms, directly impacting employee productivity and security posture. You will own operational excellence across IAM systems, combining deep technical expertise with data-driven insights to reduce friction, improve detection accuracy, and accelerate resolution. At Genesys, this work supports how organizations connect with their customers through secure, uninterrupted access to the tools they rely on every day. You will also gain exposure to advanced automation, observability, and AI-driven reliability initiatives, positioning you for growth into higher-impact engineering roles.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end resolution of IAM-related incidents, driving rapid recovery and minimizing business disruption
  • Monitor and analyze observability and AIOps signals to detect authentication failures, provisioning delays, and emerging identity risks
  • Correlate events across IAM platforms and dependent systems to identify root causes and accelerate incident resolution
  • Improve signal quality by refining alert thresholds, suppression logic, and detection rules to reduce operational noise
  • Validate and enhance automated remediation workflows to increase system resilience and reduce manual intervention
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to strengthen IAM reliability across cloud, network, security, and endpoint ecosystems
  • Ensure accuracy and integrity of identity event data to enable effective monitoring, reporting, and automation
  • Drive continuous improvement by contributing to post-incident analysis and identifying scalable fixes for recurring issues
  • Support identity lifecycle processes by resolving failures and optimizing provisioning and deprovisioning workflows
  • Contribute to onboarding readiness for new applications by ensuring IAM monitoring and operational requirements are met

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (Licenciatura) in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience in IAM operations, identity platforms, or enterprise IT operations
  • Advanced English proficiency for collaboration in global operational environments
  • Strong expertise in IAM concepts including authentication, authorization, SSO, provisioning, and identity lifecycle management
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting Okta in enterprise environments
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID for identity and access operations
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot SSO, provisioning workflows, authentication failures, and certificate issues
  • Solid understanding of incident management, event correlation, and troubleshooting methodologies
  • Experience working across cross-functional teams in complex operational environments
  • Strong analytical and communication skills to translate technical issues into actionable insights

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell or REST APIs
  • Familiarity with observability platforms, AIOps tools, and event management systems
  • Exposure to automation frameworks and self-healing system design
  • Understanding of identity integrations across SaaS platforms and cloud environments
  • Interest in advancing skills in automation engineering and proactive reliability practices

Additional Information Working Hours: This role follows daytime local hours of 9 AM – 6 PM CST. On-Call Support: Participation in a shared, rotational on-call schedule is required.

  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.

description:

The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

Posted Job Title

Penn Medicine Clinician

Job Profile Title

Penn Medicine Clinician

Job Description Summary

Doylestown Hospital Laboratory provides robust laboratory services to a busy, 250 bed hospital as well as outpatient physician offices. The successful candidate can look forward to working collaboratively with fellow pathologists as well as clinicians throughout the system. Applicants should possess strong surgical pathology skills and be board certified in AP/CP. Fellowship training or equivalent experience in cytopathology and/or hematopathology is highly desirable.

Doylestown Hospital is a community hospital located in the center of Bucks County, Pa, with convenient access to Philadelphia and the Lehigh Valley. The department of pathology receives over 16,000 surgical cases, 2500 cytology cases and performs over 1 million laboratory tests in a typical year. Special diagnostic testing includes immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, and next generation sequencing.

MD or equivalent with 0-1 year of experience and training in surgical pathology is required. Applicants should have strong surgical pathology skills and be board certified in AP/CP. Fellowship training or equivalent experience in cytopathology and/or hematopathology is highly desirable.Doylestown Hospital Laboratory provides robust laboratory services to a busy, 250 bed hospital as well as outpatient physician offices. The successful candidate can look forward to working collaboratively with fellow pathologists as well as clinicians throughout the system.

Doylestown Hospital is a community hospital located in the center of Bucks County, Pa, with convenient access to Philadelphia and the Lehigh Valley. The department of pathology receives over 16,000 surgical cases, 2500 cytology cases and performs over 1 million laboratory tests in a typical year. Special diagnostic testing includes immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, and next generation sequencing.

Responsibilities include daily sign out of a mixture of general surgical pathology cases, GYN and non-GYN cytology, FNA on-site evaluation, frozen section coverage, weekly tumor board coverage, and AP/CP call. University Benefits

  • Health, Life, and Flexible Spending Accounts: Penn offers comprehensive medical, prescription, behavioral health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits to protect you and your family’s health and welfare. You can also use flexible spending accounts to pay for eligible health care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars.

If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. title: Senior Plasma Center Technician
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

At BioLife, we know that flexibility matters—especially for those balancing multiple commitments. That's why we're dedicated to creating meaningful part-time opportunities for our team.


This role is truly part-time, with most shifts lasting between 4 to 6 hours a day, 3+ days per week—designed to fit your life.
• We’ll confirm your availability and shift days and times early in the interview process. And, because we value open communication, you’ll always be informed about any schedule changes in advance.
• Our patients depend on the plasma we collect, so your reliability during your scheduled hours is greatly valued. However, our part-time roles are designed with the understanding that flexibility on both sides is key.


Whether you’re looking for extra income, a way to gain valuable experience, or a schedule that fits your busy life—BioLife welcomes part-time team members just like you! Start strong with our paid, interactive training program!

Please take this virtual tour to get a sneak peek of one of our Plasma Donation Centers.

Phlebotomist
About the role:
Every day, the donors you meet will motivate you. The high-quality plasma you collect will become life-changing medicines. Here, a commitment to customer service and quality is expected. You will report to the Plasma Center Manager and will perform as a plasma donor screener and perform phlebotomy to support plasma center operations.

How you will contribute:
· You will greet donors as they enter and exit the donor floor.
· You will perform venipuncture of donors and programming of plasmapheresis machine.
· You will monitor donors during the donation process and manage donor reactions.
· You will perform all tasks required for the setup, verification, operation, and troubleshooting of plasmapheresis equipment within scope of training.
· You will install, prime, and disconnect disposable sets on the plasmapheresis machines
· You will stock supplies, break down empty cartons and assist with proper disposal.
· You will take and record donor pulse, blood pressure, and temperature measures and monitor electronic donor questionnaire system.
· You will perform finger sticks, test sample, and record other donor measures to include hematocrit, total protein, and weight.
· You will enter donor information into the Donor Information System (DIS).
· You will coordinate donors to donor floor and compensate donors using the Debit Card system.
· You will support the center management team in identifying operational opportunities for continuous improvement, initiating changes to center processes through use of company approved procedures including 5S, Value Stream Mapping and Kaizen.

What you bring to Takeda:
· High school diploma or equivalent
· Ability to walk and/or stand for the entire work shift
· Will work evenings, weekends, and holidays
· Ability to lean, bend, stoop, crouch, and reach above shoulders and below knees
· Ability to lift to 5 lbs., and occasional lifting of materials up to 32 lbs. and rarely 50 lbs.
· Fine motor coordination, depth perception, and ability to hear equipment from a distance
· Because of potential exposure to bloodborne pathogens (risk level 1), 90% of work tasks require prolonged glove wear
· 1 or more years minimum experience working in a customer or patient facing role is helpful

What Takeda can offer you:
Every day at Takeda, we feel good knowing that what we do helps improve the lives of patients with rare diseases. At BioLife, while you focus on our donors, we will support you. We offer a purpose you can believe in, a team you can count on, opportunities for career growth, and a comprehensive benefits program to include retirement benefits, medical/dental, family leave, disability insurance and more, all in a fast-paced, friendly environment.

More about us:
At Takeda, we are transforming patient care through the development of novel specialty pharmaceuticals and best in class patient support programs. Takeda is a patient-focused company that will inspire and empower you to grow through life-changing work.
Certified as a Global Top Employer, Takeda offers stimulating careers, encourages innovation, and strives for excellence in everything we do. We foster an inclusive, collaborative workplace, in which our teams are united by an unwavering commitment to provide Better Health and a Brighter Future to people around the world.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Finance Administrator

Part-time (50-60%, 2.5-3 days per week)

What is Rojo all about?

Rojo Integrations helps enterprises transform integration into a strategic advantage. We connect systems, processes, and people through AI-driven integration and intelligent automation - creating seamless digital ecosystems that are agile, scalable, and built for growth. From strategy and consultancy to managed services and integration software, Rojo delivers end-to-end solutions that simplify complex enterprise landscapes and give businesses real-time visibility and control over critical processes.

With deep SAP expertise and strategic partnerships with SAP, Coupa, Solace, SnapLogic, and Splunk, Rojo supports global enterprises from offices in the Netherlands, Spain, and India. Trusted by global Bluechip companies such as Siemens, AkzoNobel and EPS, we deliver tailored services to meet unique business needs.

We don’t just connect systems; we ignite greatness in every integration.

About the Role

Rojo Integrations is growing fast, fuelled by increasing market opportunities and continuously progressing positive business results. Do you want to become part of the Rojo success story? Here's your chance.

As Finance Administrator, based in the Breukelen, Netherlands, you will play a key role in the day-to-day financial administration of the organisation. You will process debtor and creditor administration, handle invoicing and bank bookings, support monthly closing and reporting, and contribute to payroll processing. This is a part-time role at 50-60% (2.5 to 3 days per week), offering the flexibility to combine this position with other commitments while still making a meaningful contribution to the Finance team.

Key Responsibilities

- Financial Administration: Processing debtor and creditor administration; performing bank bookings and accounting corrections.

- Invoice Processing: Processing purchase and cost invoices, employee declarations, bank mutations, and salary journals for multiple business entities.

- Reporting: Preparing financial prognoses, liquidity budgets, cashflow statements, and corporate finance reports.

- Monthly Closing: Preparing monthly overviews and processing monthly invoicing.

- Payroll Support: Supporting salary journal processing and liaising with payroll providers.

- Manager Support: Supporting the Finance Manager and department managers with financial data and ad-hoc requests.

What do you need to succeed?

- 3-5 years of demonstrable accounting/bookkeeping experience

- Relevant educational background in Finance, Accounting, or a related field (MBO-4, HBO, or equivalent qualification)

- Solid knowledge of Dutch administration, tax and accounting rules

- Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact, Twinfield)

- Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word, etc.

- Analytical and numerically accurate - precise and detail-oriented

- Organised and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

- Proactive, caring, and patient working style

- Ability to work independently and in a team

- Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is an advantage

- Dutch language proficiency is a must; good command of English (written and spoken) is required

Working Relationships

- Finance Manager

- Department managers

- External accountants and auditors

- Payroll provider

- Tax authorities

- Suppliers and vendors

Information Security & Quality Responsibilities

As part of their role, every Rojo employee is expected to:

- Be aware of and act in accordance with Rojo's Information Security & Quality Management System, including all applicable policies and procedures.

- Complete mandatory information security and quality awareness training as required by Rojo's operational plan.

- Protect information in line with Rojo's Information Classification & Data Handling Policy, ensuring that confidential, restricted, or internal information is not disclosed to unauthorised parties.

- Report information security incidents, suspected breaches, or quality non-conformities promptly via the designated reporting channel (JIRA service desk), in line with the Incident Management Policy.

- Support Rojo's continuous improvement objectives by contributing to the identification and reporting of risks, issues, and improvement opportunities within their area of work.

- Comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and contractual obligations relevant to their role, including data protection legislation (GDPR).

What do we offer?

- All the resources you need to support your professional development (e.g. training, mentoring, learning budget)

- A visible role with opportunity to shape your role and contributions, room for developing your own initiatives to streamline our different financial processes.

- A global, inclusive and diverse working climate within a world conscious organisation, with bright, ambitious and positively minded people

- A hybrid working environment; we offer the possibility to work from our office(s)/home or remotely

We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we’re committed to creating a place where everyone can thrive.

We are looking forward to receiving your application, but please note that only applicants with an EU citizenship or a valid residency/work permit will be considered for this role.

Great people rarely fit completely into job descriptions.

If you’re curious, driven, and excited by what we’re building, apply - even if your experience doesn’t match every bullet point.

Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger teams, and better outcomes for our customers.

Come build with us.

title: Physician Assistant-QHC-12600-008
description:
Under the general supervision of a licensed and Board Certified / eligible Physician, evaluates and treats patients having medical problems. Performs routine histories and physical examinations; performs and/or interprets diagnostic tests and/or procedures as detailed in the department specific scope of practice. Participates in teaching and quality assurance activities with other members of the clinical department. Delivers direct patient care. Writes appropriately authorized prescriptions. May respond to initial requests for service-specific consultation as per the department scope of practice. Assists in performance of stress tests in the chest pain unit or stress lab.

Under the general supervision of an appropriately licensed and Board Certified / eligible Physician:

1. Performs complete patient histories and physicals; orders laboratory tests and x-rays; performs and/or interprets laboratory and test results; and initiates treatment. Writes appropriately authorized prescriptions including controlled substances. Assists in performance of stress tests in the chest pain unit or stress lab; may respond to initial requests for service-specific consultation as per the department scope of practice.

2. May initiate or participate in initial management and stabilization of patients or other medical or surgical emergencies.

3. Confers with attending physicians, residents, nursing staff, etc., to ensure delivery of optimum quality of patient care. Confers regularly with Supervising Physician and/or Physician Assistant and co-workers to keep them apprised of clinical developments, patient concerns, etc.

4. Performs other duties pursuant to clinical responsibility, such as arranging follow-up for patients, obtaining informed consent from patient for procedures they are credentialed to perform, recalling patients for further evaluation and treatment, escorting patients, when necessary, to other areas of the hospital, etc. Informs patients of necessary post-discharge instructions as required. Makes appropriate entries in patients charts.

5. Completes and documents participation in continuing medical education required of Physician Assistants in order to meet requirements for certification, including assigned lectures and conferences.

6. Performs related duties as required professionally or at the request of the Supervising Physician, Director of Service and/or Supervising Physician Assistant.

7. Performs related duties as required professionally or at the request of the Supervising Physician, Director of Service and/or Supervising Physician Assistant.

-Bachelor of Science or Master’s degree in Physician Assistant Studies.

-Graduation from an approved Physician Assistant Program.

-Licensure issued by NYS.

-Certification by NCCPA and ACLS/BLS.PALS in some areas of patient care.

-Intermediate computer skills in Word, Excel.

-High level of analytical ability.

Compensation Statement

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $68.52 - $91.36 Hourly. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

title: Senior HCE
description:
• Ensure achievement of Sales budgets for the assigned geographical territory

  • Provide inputs to the District Manager to help him validate the sales forecast or the rolling sales plan as per the defined frequency
  • Provide inputs to the District Manager to help him manage salvage net to maintain it at an acceptable level

  • Schedule the frequency of calls on the doctors depending on their criticality with respect to achievement of the sales targets for the district
  • Deliver promotional messages tailored to each customer’s need so as to maximize sales
  • Strictly adhere to coverage plans and frequency

Operational / Process

  • Stay updated on the competitors’ activities through personal visits to wholesalers and retailers. Maintain regular contacts with medical practitioners, consultants, chemists and wholesalers.
  • Book orders from the retailers to ensure adequate availability of products to meet the market demand. Also, ensure display of point-of-sale promotion material display in retailers’ stores in line with the promotion plan
  • Ensure thorough pre-call planning and ask for the assistance of the District Manager wherever necessary.
  • Prepare and implement special schedule for doctors’ visits/calls at the time of new product launch or sales campaign etc. using special presentation and promotional materials in line with the sales strategy
  • Carry meticulous one-to-one detailing of the product bringing to the doctor’s attention the special features/benefits of the product, its proven efficacy, new research and clinical findings etc.

title: Web3 Security Senior Operations Specialist
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze complex Web3 security cases and extract recurring attack patterns to build and maintain comprehensive SOPs.

  • Proactively identify gaps in current operation workflows and propose systematic improvements to enhance the team's overall efficiency.

  • Partner with AI agents to crystallize security insights into a high-quality knowledge base, improve team’s collective intelligence and operational speed.

  • Stay ahead of emerging fraud techniques and evolving Web3 product logic, translating these trends into actionable defense strategies for the team.

  • Work closely with engineering and strategy teams to transform manual analysis into automated detection rules.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in anti-fraud, risk control, or blockchain-related fields; proven ability to handle complex problems through a structured and systematic approach.

title: Projektleder søges til Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning
description:
Projektleder søges til Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning

Vil du være med til at nedbringe uvedkommende vand og overløb fra vores spildevandssystem på Bornholm? Spildevand er en del af den helt grundlæggende infrastruktur, og det er afgørende for vores sundhed, vores natur og miljø. På en ø som Bornholm handler det i høj grad også om det vand, der omgiver os, og vi har en stor opgave i at sikre, at spildevandssystemet er klar til fremtidig belastning, at vi får genanvendt ressourcerne bedst muligt, og at vi får sikret et bedre vandmiljø på og rundt om øen.

Vi leder lige nu efter en projektleder, som vil lede projektet "Nedbringelse af uvedkommende vand og overløb", der er en del af arbejdet med fremtidens spildevandsstruktur. Vi leder efter dig, som er en fagligt stærk og ambitiøs projektleder, og samtidig har en indsigt og teknisk forståelse af spildevand. Du kan både lede projekter, skabe overblik og have et tæt samarbejde med driften om praktiske løsninger. Du brænder for at skabe løsninger der bidrager til en mere effektiv drift, og samtidig skaber positive effekter i den bornholmske natur, der tilsammen medvirker til at vi opfylder vores vision om udviklingen af et bæredygtigt Bornholm.

Din rolle

I afdelingen arbejder vi både med den langsigtede forsyningsudvikling og med innovationsprojekter, hvor vi udvikler og demonstrerer ny energi-, fjernvarme-, spildevands- og vandrensningsteknologi. Du kommer til at arbejde sammen med 17 projektledere og faglige specialister, der i fællesskab driver 3 strategiske udviklingsprogrammer og 15 innovationsprojekter. Sammen realiserer vi BEOFs strategiske ambitioner til konkrete resultater der kommer Bornholm og bornholmerne til gavn.

I dit projekt vil du komme til at arbejde med en plan for måling af overløb, nedbringe overløb ved regn-hændelser, opspore og nedbringe uvedkommende vand, samt bidrage i koordineringen af de planlagte renoveringer af overløbsbygværker. Du skal derfor kunne omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til praktiske løsninger, og kunne samarbejde tæt med driften og eksterne leverandører ved f.eks. opsætning af måleudstyr.

I alle projekter og programmer i afdelingen arbejder en projektorganisation sammen som et team, og du får derfor god støtte og samarbejde med både tekniske projektledere, specialister og fagligt stærke driftsfolk. Erfaring fra branchen er en fordel.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Projektledelse i samarbejde med projektorganisation.
  • Udarbejdelse af kommissorie, projektplan, risikoanalyse, interessentanalyse etc.
  • Styre alle processer omkring projektet og sikre allokering af de rigtige personer på de rigtige tidspunkter.
  • Bidrage med viden og kompetencer til andre innovationsprojekter i teamet.
  • Sikre at værdiskabelsen i projektet forankres i Bornholms Energi og Forsyning, gennem forsyningsudvikling og samarbejde med kollegaer fra andre afdelinger.
  • Deltage i udarbejdelsen af ansøgninger på nye innovationsprojekter, der understøtter vores strategiske mål og medvirker til udviklingen af et bæredygtigt Bornholm.
Din baggrund

I rollen som projektleder i Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning kommer du til at lede projekter med komplekse problemstillinger og med mange interessenter. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du har et godt overblik og er vant til at uddelegere opgaver til din projektorganisation. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har en teknisk baggrund og du kommer fra en lignende stilling med projektledelse eller på anden vis, har opnået stor faglighed inden for projektledelse.

Dine personlige kvalifikationer:

  • En uddannelse som Ingeniør, Maskinmester, Naturvidenskabelig kandidat, eller lignende.
  • Erfaring med projektledelse og koordinering af komplekse projekter i samarbejde med forskellige aktører.
  • Du er positiv, udadvendt og søger aktivt samarbejdet for at opnå fælles mål.
  • Et personligt drive og elsker at drive projekter i mål.
  • Du kan tænke ud af boksen, og du kan være i, at processer forandrer sig undervejs.
  • Du kan skabe struktur og have det store overblik, men du har også sans for detaljer.
  • Du kan formulere dig på skrift og i tale - på dansk såvel som engelsk.
  • Du er praktisk anlagt og forstår hvordan driftssystemer fungerer.
Du tilbydes

Du tilbydes et spændende job i en ambitiøs virksomhed i konstant udvikling. Bornholms Energi & Forsyning er en af de væsentligste aktører i Bornholms Regions Kommunes ambition om, at øen i 2040 skal være et nul-udledningssamfund baseret på bæredygtig og vedvarende energi.

Gennem vores samarbejde med danske og internationale virksomheder og universiteter får du adgang til et stort netværk af viden, mulighed for rejseaktiviteter og stejle læringskurver.

Du får dygtige og supersociale kollegaer, der arbejder med projektledelse og innovation på et højt fagligt niveau, som glæder sig til mandag morgen for at høre, hvad du har lavet i weekenden.

Derudover tilbydes du løn efter kvalifikationer, pensionsordning og diverse personalegoder. Du vil få base i Rønne i Bornholms Energi & Forsynings Afdeling "Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning".

Sådan søger du

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling, med start snarest muligt, eller senest 1. november 2026.

Du søger stillingen ved at trykke på "Søg stillingen" på denne side, og sende en ansøgning senest d. 23.8.2026, der skal bestå af maksimalt 1 sides motiveret ansøgning og maksimalt 2 siders CV.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at blive afholdt i uge 37 og 38.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan du få hos: Afdelingsleder for Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning, Maria Hach på telefon 40 24 04 93 eller via e-mail mah@beof.dk

title: HEALTHCARE ASSISTANT, MATERNITY WARD
description:
1) GENERAL DESCRIPTION

Provide basic nursing care in accordance with established standards, work collaboratively with team members, and report any incidents or issues to relevant authorities to ensure the delivery of high-quality patient care.

2) JOB DESCRIPTION

Organization and Management

  • Provide basic nursing care that aligns with the vision, mission, philosophy, goals, and objectives of the nursing services and the hospital.

  • Notify the nursing leaders of any situations that impact the quality of care.

  • Obtain ward report and assignment at the beginning of each shift and perform additional tasks as assigned by the Unit Manager or Senior Registered Nurse.

  • Perform Daily routine:

- Conducts regular nursing rounds to assess patients’ needs and communicate with them and their families.

- Prepares and tidies patients’ beds and linens as needed and organizes patients’ belongings as well as furniture.

- Disinfects the beds, furniture, and equipment after utilizing them.

- Maintain the ward, store, fridge and its facilities clean and tidy.

- Assist the patient with filling the hot water flask if needed.

- Answer phone calls and relay messages.

- Attendants to patients call the bell promptly.

- Assists nurses in transporting patients to and from the operating theatre.

- Escorts patients to other services for diagnostic tests and from the ward to other areas upon discharge.

- Dispatches specimens to the laboratory and collects results.

- Collect pharmacy and surgical supplies from pharmacy and the store as required to maintain adequate stock levels for operations.

- Send out portable oxygen tanks for refilling or exchange, ensuring a continuous supply for emergency needs.

  • Assists the trained staff in various aspects:

- Carried out of nursing care, such as patient comfort, safety, nutrition, hygiene, admission, transfer, discharge, dressing, intravenous lines, catheterization, etc.

- Cleans and disinfects the trolley and instruments after use and stores them properly.

- Records the daily charges for the items used in the ward and updates the patients’ charges accordingly.

- Serves meals, prepare drinks for patients if needed, and collects trays.

- Maintains the record of intake and output chart for each patient.

- Lifts, turns, and positions patients safely and comfortably using the correct body mechanics.

- Accompanies the consultant in performing procedures and rounds in the absence of trained nurses.

  • Attend meetings held by the service.

Human Resource and Development

  • Proactive in our own learning and development, and to meet the minimum requirement of 20 hours of continuing education per year.

  • Involve orienting new staff members to the ward routines.

  • Maintain a record of personal leave and training attendance.

Policies and Procedure

  • Adhere to the hospital's policies and nursing code of conduct, ensuring patient confidentiality and standard infection control practices are upheld.

Facilities and Equipment

​Assist the trained staff in managing the proper storage, condition, and availability of biomedical equipment in the unit, maintaining a sufficient supply of ward stock, and maintaining accurate records for equipment, medical supplies, and consumable item specimen collections.

Safety and Quality Improvement Activities

  • Participate in new services, comply with 5S activities, patient safety policies, and adherence to ISO, MSQH, JCI, PSG, BFHI and NNA, ensure comply with patient safety goals, and occupational safety measures.

  • Adhere to the Occupational Safety and Health Act and Regulations 1994, take reasonable care at work, cooperate with employers, wear proper PPE, and follow all safety and health instructions and measures.

3) JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia.

  • Certified healthcare assistants would be a priority.

  • Experience working in a hospital setting is an advantage.

  • Able to converse fluently and write in English language and Bahasa Malaysia.

  • Caring, honest, and responsible worker.

  • Willingness to work on scheduled hours, shifts and weekends, public holidays and any time called during an emergency.

Job Summary:

The Senior EO/IR Systems Engineer will play a primary systems engineering role. The successful candidate will be responsible for sophisticated Electro-Optical (visible-NIR), SWIR, MWIR, and LWIR reflective and refractive optical imaging payload development, integration, and design verification test (DVT) plan development and implementation. This role supports cutting-edge technological ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) and ISR-T surveillance product development through the NPI (New Product Introduction) process, spanning from early prototyping to full market launch. Key responsibilities include specifications and requirements development, characterization, trade studies, tolerancing, radiometric modeling and analysis, system integration, testing, and image quality evaluation.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Lead and contribute to optical subsystem payload development and integration into higher-level, full gimbal systems for airborne and land surveillance applications. Payloads include EO/SWIR/MWIR/LWIR image sensors, laser rangefinders, and optional laser designators.
  • Actively participate in optical and imaging system design, alignment, and testing, as well as gimbal system design, operation, testing, and spatial (6 DOF) sensing systems.
  • Perform optical design of discrete and continuous reflective and refractive optical zoom imaging systems using ZEMAX tools.
  • Develop and maintain specifications and requirements for optical components, optical imaging subsystems, and complete optical systems.
  • Perform radiometric and image quality analysis for EO/SWIR/MWIR/LWIR image sensors.
  • Create, review, and present flow-down specifications for subcontracting optical components and subsystems.
  • Create Design Verification Test (DVT) plans and test procedures for all payload and full-system characterizations.
  • Support manufacturing group in creating acceptance test plans (ATPs) for future product manufacturing and testing.
  • Perform laboratory testing to characterize, evaluate, and calibrate optical lenses and Cassegrain telescopes.
  • Test and characterize EO/SWIR/MWIR/LWIR imaging sensors and camera performance metrics—such as MTF, NETD, SiTF, 3D noise, FOV, boresight, and latency—at both the subsystem level and the fully integrated, software-driven gimbal system level.
  • Review optomechanical interface models and drawings, electrical schematics, and software features/functions to provide constructive feedback to designers.
  • Support the New Product Introduction (NPI) process and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
  • Support Business Development and Sales by analyzing new customer requirements, writing proposals, modeling sensor performance, and responding to technical inquiries.
  • Provide systems engineering support to manufacturing as requested.

Job Qualifications:

  • Education: BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Optical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a closely related disciplinary field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of direct experience in EO/SWIR/IR optical design, optical imaging system design, and characterization.
  • Core Knowledge: Solid foundational knowledge and deep understanding of visible and infrared imaging optics, as well as EO/IR imaging sensors.
  • System Integration: Solid, hands-on experience integrating EO/IR image sensors into gimbal systems.
  • Material Expertise: Excellent knowledge base and experience working with VIS/NIR/SWIR/MWIR/LWIR optical materials.
  • Optical Design Tools: Demonstrated hands-on experience designing optical lenses, reflective imaging optics, prisms, and optical filters for EO/IR imaging using ZEMAX tools.
  • Testing & Characterization: Demonstrated hands-on experience testing and characterizing EO/IR imaging sensor systems.
  • Testing Documentation: Demonstrated experience creating EO/IR/LRF design verification test (DVT) plans and test reports.
  • Systems Engineering: Systems engineering experience developing large, complex EO/IR/LRF surveillance products. DoD or Space systems engineering experience is a plus.
  • Design Review: Excellent knowledge and experience in optical design reviews, as well as optomechanical interface model and drawing reviews and electrical schematic design reviews
  • Sensor Integration: Excellent knowledge base and hands-on experience with EO/IR image sensors and EO/IR/LRF sensor system integration.

title: Electromechanical
description:
Apply today to be an Electromechanical Technician with one of the most innovative and trusted packaging companies in the world. Printpack is seeking a qualified candidate to fill the position of Electromechanical Technician for the Converting plant in Grand Prairie, TX. The Electromechanical Technician installs, maintains, and repairs complex electrical and mechanical manufacturing equipment while ensuring optimal performance and safety standards. Working independently in a fast-paced environment, this position requires technical expertise to manage multiple priorities, minimize downtime, and support production goals through continuous improvement initiatives. Success in this role demands strong judgment, efficient troubleshooting skills, and commitment to maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety. This is a 3/2 Night Shift position from 7pm-7am. Sun/Wed/Thurs - Mon/Tues/Fri/Sat.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Performs comprehensive electrical and mechanical troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex manufacturing equipment, including 24V analog/digital circuitry, VFDs, PLCs, and automated systems

  • Executes preventive maintenance programs through scheduled inspections, calibrations, and repairs while documenting all activities in computerized maintenance systems

  • Interprets and works from electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, hydraulic/pneumatic layouts, and technical documentation to diagnose and repair equipment

  • Tests and troubleshoots electrical systems using multi-meters, ammeters, and diagnostic equipment

  • Installs, wires, and verifies operation of 3-phase, single-phase, and DC motors according to electrical schematics

  • Implements and strictly follows safety protocols, including LockOut/TagOut procedures and emergency response procedures

  • Performs rigging and lifting operations for heavy equipment components while following safety requirements

  • Maintains accurate documentation of repairs, parts usage, and preventive maintenance activities

  • Coordinates maintenance activities with production schedules and shift leadership to minimize downtime

  • Provides technical training and support to operators on equipment operation and basic maintenance

  • Participates in continuous improvement initiatives and engineering projects

  • Collaborates with team members, vendors, and contractors to support maintenance operations and equipment upgrades

Education & Experience:

  • Associate degree in Electromechanical Technology or equivalent experience preferred

  • 3+ years of industrial maintenance experience

Required Skills:

  • Proficiency in reading electrical schematics and mechanical blueprints

  • Strong troubleshooting skills for electrical and mechanical systems

  • Proficiency in computer-based maintenance systems

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Multi-skilled in all areas of industrial maintenance

  • Able to use precision measuring equipment such as calipers

  • Able to engage in a team working collaboratively as well as making repairs independently

  • Metalworking and welding skills are a plus

  • HVAC experience a plus

  • Prefer to have strong electrical skills including experience with PLCs and drives, troubleshooting control circuits

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be 18 years of age

  • Must pass pre-employment assessment

  • Drug screening required

  • Background check required

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Advanced knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems

  • Expertise in preventive maintenance practices

  • Proficiency in basic welding and fabrication techniques

  • Understanding of safety protocols and OSHA regulations

  • Hydraulic and pneumatic systems

  • PLCs and automated control systems

  • Three-phase and single-phase power systems

  • Motor controls and servo systems

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

  • Critical Reasoning and Decision Making

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills

  • Effective verbal and written communication

  • Root cause identification

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Ability to train and mentor others

Physical Demands: The associate will be exposed to the manufacturing environment where hazards and requirements may include but are not limited to:

  • Ability to lift and move up to 50 pounds

  • Standing/walking for extended periods

  • Working in various positions (bending, kneeling, reaching)

  • Required to lift, bend, crouch, reach, twist, and crawl

  • Exposure to manufacturing environment (noise, heat, chemicals)

  • May require working in confined spaces

  • Required to work in high places

  • Required to ascend and descend ladders safely

  • Safely operate mobile equipment

  • Forklift Boom, scissor certification or ability to obtain certification

  • Ability to wear ARC flash equipment

  • Ability to wear respiratory protection as needed

  • Ability to wear required PPE (hearing protection, steel-toe shoes, safety glasses)

Work Conditions: The majority of tasks will be performed in a manufacturing setting with potential exposure to:

  • Noise levels above 85 dB

  • Operation of complex machinery

  • Solvents, fumes and inks

  • Concrete floors, roof areas

  • Working at heights, hot work

  • Works near energized and moving equipment

  • Variable Temperatures

  • Must be able to work flexible shifts

  • May require nights, weekends, and holidays

  • An additional $2.50/hr premium for NIGHT Shift only between the hours of 7pm-7am. Any hours worked outside of 7pm-7am will not receive the premium.

Internal Requirements:

  • Must demonstrate Core Values

  • Must be in good standing with no disciplinary action or attendance issues (No disciplinary action of Written or above)

  • Must have performer or higher rating in last review

  • Demonstrated sense of urgency in production recovery situations
