title: Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions - LATAM
description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

What you bring

  • Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR support and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, undertake research, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Basic understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

  • Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits (offboardings) across multiple international jurisdictions, including AMER,EMEA and APAC regions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.
  • Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
  • Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Employee Relations internal stakeholders.
  • Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.
  • Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.
  • Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.
  • Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Location: For this position we welcome everyone to apply, but we will prioritise applications from the following locations as we encourage our teams to diversify;
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Test
  3. Interview with future manager
  4. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  5. Bar Raiser Interview
  6. Offer
  7. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$37,250—$41,900 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • learning budget
  • home office budget & IT equipment
  • budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

title: DSV Nurmijärvi hakee terminaalityöntekijöitä!
location: Uusimaa, Hyvinkää, Järvenpää, Kerava, Nurmijärvi, Tuusula, Vantaa
description:
Etsimme motivoituneita terminaalityöntekijöitä Nurmijärven DSV tiimiin. Työtehtäviin kuuluvat pääasiassa kerääminen, kontinpurku, hyllytys, tarroitus ja muut vastaavat tehtävät. Työt alkavat sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä ja jatkuvat marraskuun loppuun saakka, mutta mahdollisuus myös pidempiin sopimuksiin on mahdollinen. Tällä hetkellä etsitään erityisesti keräilytaitoisia työntekijöitä.

Nyt on tarjolla huippupaikka – ja se voisi olla juuri sinulle!

Työtehtävät:

• Osallistut monipuolisesti logistiikan ja kuljetusten päivittäisiin tehtäviin, kuten tavaroiden vastaanottoon, keräilyyn, pakkaamiseen, lähettämiseen ja kontin purkuun
• Käytät alan perustyökaluja ja -järjestelmiä, esimerkiksi keräilytrukkia ja varastonhallintaohjelmia
• Huolehdit omalta osaltasi toimitusten tarkkuudesta, aikatauluista, turvallisuudesta ja työympäristön siisteydestä

Tarjoamme:

• Pitkäaikaisen työn arvostetussa logistiikka- ja kuljetusalan yrityksessä
• Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi kokeneiden ammattilaisten rinnalla
• Hyvän työilmapiirin, modernit työvälineet ja osaavan tiimin tuen

Odotamme sinulta:

• Alan koulutusta tai aiempaa kokemusta logistiikan, varastotyön tai kuljetusten parista
• Motivoitunutta, oma-aloitteista ja huolellista työotetta
• Hyviä tiimityöskentelytaitoja ja halua tehdä laadukasta ja vastuullista työtä
• Valmiutta työskennellä vuorotyössä tai vaihtelevissa aikatauluissa, myös lauantai vuoroja kiireisimpinä viikkoina

Työ alkaa sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Palkkaus 16,09 - 18,21 €/h ja määrittämisessä otetaan huomioon aikaisempi kokemus ja koulutuksesi.

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

title: Director Operational Excellence
description:
Job Role Profile:

The Cluster/Vertical Operational Excellence function is a Cluster/Vertical-based role within Contract Logistics that focuses on supporting KAM/Sales in selling new business, launches of new contracts/sites, effective deployment & development of WMS, implementing operating standards, continuous improvement, business process improvement, business intelligence, HSEQ & Security and Strategic Projects. Key in this role is the focus on standardization of processes, tools and systems and the deployment of our Production System. Every Cluster/Vertical in the Region has its own local Cluster/Vertical Operational Excellence team. There may also be the requirement to travel to sites in the Region or global based meetings on a periodic basis.

Objectives:

Operational Excellence is a distinguishing and compelling part of DPW Contract Logistics’ value proposition. This strategic function is to support Sales/KAM ensuring that all what customers need is converted into a solid technical value proposition with competitive pricing, seamlessly implemented within budget/time/specifications, managing change requests, ensuring projects are delivered within the profitability and risk thresholds as approved during sales. During implementation and within the operational stage, the role ensures that all operating standards, HSEQ/Security standards are implemented and adhered to. Once implemented, the role focuses on continuous & business process improvement, best practice sharing, WMS deployment/development, using business intelligence driving efficiency gains, quality enhancements and cost savings. The function also contributes to managing strategic projects (PMO).

Duties and responsibilities:

  • Managing a variety of teams and responsible for: WMS Super User, Launch, CI/BPI/BI, HSEQ, Security and PMO.
  • Provides, manages and controls timely and accurately Budget, Revision and Actuals related to Operational Excellence labor and non-labor expenses.
  • Support KAM/Sales in winning profitable new business.
  • Partner with commercial teams in convincing customers of our value proposition.
  • Supports the seamless launch of new contracts/sites using our standard project implementation methodology ensuring project delivery with scope, budget, timelines and risk.
  • Ensure new customer requirements are following stringent change management process, preventing revenue leakage and scope creep
  • Drive compliance towards implementation Performance Management, focusing on improving Customer KPI’s and DPW global standard internal KPI’s
  • Drive compliance towards implementing, maintaining and improving defined Operating Standards (processes, tools & systems)
  • Deploy LEAN/Six Sigma for Continuous Improvement (5S, Kaizen, Gemba, GSA)
  • Deploy Business Process Improvement techniques and methodology for more radical step-stone changes in Operations
  • Share & implement Best Practices
  • Deploy, maintain and improve Business Intelligence tools for reporting
  • Drive Low Margin program, improving customer profitability
  • Drives compliance towards implementing, maintaining and improving defined HSEQ & Security standards (processes, tools & systems)
  • Improve WMS Product deployment in operations, act as business partner towards Operations, IT and customers
  • This role can potentially replace (succeed) the VP/Directors during absence (succession planning)

Functional knowledge and skills:

  • Performance oriented, goes the extra mile to understand, meet & exceed customer expectations, demonstrates a good service mentality, takes initiatives to proposing innovation, automations and process improvements.
  • Team player and strong collaborator, builds strong working relationships. Networks extensively, internally & externally. Collaborates across geographies, business lines and functions.
  • Pragmatic, resilient and with a sense of urgency. Down to earth approach to issues and (data driven) decisions. Tenacious in delivery, challenges the status quo and black belt in continuous improvement. Thrives and adapts in demanding circumstances.
  • Business acumen, knows our industry well to understand and spot opportunities. Understands and applies financial and productivity measures. Creative in commercial solutions.
  • Passionate about leading & developing people, invests time in people and team development, drives a high performance & winning mentality across his team and company.
  • Positive can-do attitude, authentic and open (no politics). Communicates frequently and encourages 2 way engagement.
  • Impeccable behavior, a role model, lead by example. Values and encourages diversity, displays integrity and confidentiality at all times.

Engagement Internally:

  • Operations within the Region and Cluster, from Warehouse Operator to Cluster VP CL Leader, Regional CL COO and Global CL COO.
  • Business Development, Account Management & Sales within the Cluster/Region
  • Cluster/Regional/Global IT, HR and Finance organization
  • Global WMS CoE team
  • Global Cluster Super User community

Engagement Externally:

  • Customers
  • Suppliers

title: Tendermanager
description:
Strukton Civiel NL realiseert duurzame projecten in de civiele infrastructuur. Wij werken voor lokale, regionale en landelijke opdrachtgevers door heel Nederland. Samenwerking staat centraal in alles wat we doen. In de combinatie van technische expertise, landelijke slagkracht en verbinding met de lokale omgeving ligt onze kracht. Strukton Civiel NL is onderdeel van Strukton.

Als Tendermanager maak je deel uit van het enthousiaste Tendermanagement / Verwervings team van zo’n 40 collega’s, verspreid over meerdere vestigingen. Binnen dit team werk je nauw samen met vier andere tendermanagers. Je vormt daarnaast een hecht team met specialisten zoals begroters, planschrijvers en strategen. Samen zetten jullie alles op alles om winnende inschrijvingen te realiseren.

Samen bouwen we aan iets dat groter is dan onszelf. We dragen bij aan het grotere plaatje. We bouwen slimmer, gericht op wat komen gaat. Werk om trots op te zijn! Kom jij bij Strukton Civiel NL samen bouwen aan de toekomst?

Je bent een natuurlijke leider met sterke communicatieve vaardigheden: je weet je team te motiveren en samen te sturen op resultaat. Met jouw commercieel inzicht kun je niet alleen een plan ontwikkelen, maar het ook overtuigend overbrengen - intern en richting de klant. Dankzij je klantgerichte houding en analytisch vermogen weet je snel de kern van een uitvraag te doorgronden en te vertalen naar een onderscheidende strategie. Je werkt gestructureerd, houdt overzicht in het proces en bent besluitvaardig. Je bent bovendien flexibel en veerkrachtig – je weet dat niet elke tender wordt gewonnen, maar je herpakt jezelf en het team met nieuwe energie. En je verliest de praktijk nooit uit het oog: je houdt actief aansluiting met de uitvoering om zeker te weten dat plannen ook echt uitvoerbaar zijn.

Verder heb je:

  • HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een opleidingsachtergrond in bedrijfseconomie, techniek of een vergelijkbare richting;
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als eindverantwoordelijk tendermanager, waarin je complexe aanbestedingen succesvol hebt geleid;
  • Goede marktkennis, op de hoogte van ontwikkelingen binnen de civiele bouw, waterbouw, drink- en afvalwatersector, stedelijke gebiedsontwikkeling en de energiemarkt;
  • een sterk netwerk van samenwerkingspartners, onderaannemers en andere stakeholders waarmee je snel kunt schakelen;
  • Goede Nederlandse en Engelse taalvaardigheden.

Wij waarderen jouw inzet en bieden daarvoor:

  • Toegang tot opleidingen en volop ruimte voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling
  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding
  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken
  • Een goede pensioenregeling met werkgeversbijdrage
  • Veiligheid en mobiliteit staan bij ons voorop. Daarom krijg je een leaseauto die past bij jou en het werk dat jij uitvoert, zodat jij flexibel en professioneel op pad kunt. Daarnaast ontvang je ook een NS-Businesscard
  • 30 vakantiedagen per jaar
  • Met een ruim keuzebudget boven op je salaris, inclusief vakantiegeld, bepaal jij zelf: meer vrije dagen (tot 13 extra), of extra geld op je rekening.
  • Een uitstekend brutosalaris tussen € 5.800,- en € 8.800,- per 4 weken, afhankelijk van je ervaring

Wil je meer weten? Heeft deze vacature jouw interesse gewekt, maar wil je graag meer informatie, neem dan telefonisch, via e-mail of Whatsapp contact op met onze Recruiter Lucas van Lamsweerde via 06-27482618 of lucas.vanlamsweerde@strukton.com.

title: Senior NPI Materials Planner
description:
NVIDIA has an exciting opportunity for a Sr. Materials Planner in our Quick Turn/ NPI Materials Organization. The position requires exceptional materials management skills and supply planning expertise in a dynamic and fast paced environment. The ideal candidate would have a deep understanding of procurement, planning, and contract manufacturing supply chain in multinational manufacturing industry.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Collaborate effectively with Engineering Program Mgmt. teams to understand build requirements for new products supporting bring-up boards for validation and qualification. Support the engineers’ requests on material transition, samples delivery, deviation release.

  • Manage build schedule shortages impacting CTB (clear to build) and work with materials support team on materials supply risk mitigation.

  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams including GCM, engineering, manufacturing, to ensure alignment on NPI material requirements and build timelines. Use data analytics to identify and address potential roadblocks or challenges.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance NPI supply chain efficiency and effectiveness. Find opportunities to streamline processes, reduce lead times, and improve overall supply chain performance.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate supply risks using data analytics. Develop data-driven contingency plans and alternative sourcing strategies to minimize the impact of potential disruptions.

  • Manage consigned material demand in ERP system and follow through with internal teams to ensure consigned materials readiness to schedule, manage the consigned inventory with accurate allocation and excess disposition.

  • Monitor BOM changes and ensure all changes are identified and loaded accurately through MRP/SAP system.

  • Consolidate results and provide updates to cross functional teams on material status for all assigned NPI builds. Run review meetings with internal (engineering and operations) and external teams (CMs) to align build schedules.

  • Prepare and communicate critical Materials availability updates to cross functional leadership teams; maintain executive reports and summaries, providing accurate and timely data to leadership on agreed cadence.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in operations, IE, supply chain or Business preferred, with 8+ years most recent experience in materials management, production planning, or supply chain management.

  • Experience with ERP/MRP demand planning and forecasting tools, rich experience on different commodities including EE, Mech, Interconnector etc. along with strong understanding of NPI processes and supply chain dynamics.

  • Experience working with BOM in OEM/CM environment required.

  • Project skills and expertise on AI-driven tools design/ development as business user is a strong plus.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Proven experience in materials planning or supply chain management, preferably in a manufacturing or high-tech industry.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with proficiency in data analytics and advanced AI tools.

With equal opportunities, competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our outstanding operations teams are rapidly growing. If you are a creative individual with a real passion for technology and operational success, we want to hear from you!

title: Field Service Engineer North Area, Spain
description:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/insurance.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in India. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in India.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Sygeplejerske til Vikærgården, Udredningsafdeling 2
description:
Om jobbet:

Stillingsbeskrivelse

Vær med til at forme fremtidens nære sundhedsvæsen og skabe sammenhæng i komplekse borgerforløb

På Vikærgården får du som sygeplejerske en nøglerolle i korte, intensive borgerforløb med høj faglig kompleksitet. Du arbejder tæt på borgeren, tæt på beslutningerne og i tæt samspil med tværfaglige kolleger, samarbejdspartnere på tværs af sektorer – med stor betydning for borgerens videre liv.

Vikærgården er Aarhus Kommunes center for korttidspladser – de kommende sundheds- og omsorgspladser – og en central del af det nære sundhedsvæsen.

Cirka 90 % af borgerne på de 63 pladser kommer direkte fra hospitalsindlæggelse, ofte fra Aarhus Universitetshospital, og fra alle specialer. Borgerne er for ustabile til at være i eget hjem og har behov for sundhedsfaglig indsats og målrettet rehabilitering.

  • Fokus på kompetenceudvikling, faglig opdatering og vidensdeling
  • Et fagligt fællesskab med plads til refleksion, sparring og nysgerrighed

Hvis du trives med forandringer, tænker i sammenhængende forløb – og synes det er meningsfuldt indimellem at stå med hænderne på ryggen for at understøtte borgerens egen mestring og rehabilitering – så vil du passe godt ind hos os.

Dine opgaver vil være

Som sygeplejerske på Vikærgården vil du blandt andet:

  • Have overblik og ansvar for fremdrift i borgerens samlede forløb
  • Varetage sundhedsfaglig udredning, klinisk vurdering og opfølgning
  • Udføre både basis- og instrumentel sygepleje, fx sårbehandling, IV‑behandling, sonder, katetre, dræn og medicinhåndtering
  • Understøtte rehabilitering og genoptræning i samarbejde med andre faggrupper
  • Indgå i tæt samarbejde med læger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • Bidrage til individuelt tilrettelagte rehabiliteringsforløb
  • Samarbejde tæt med terapeuter, sosu-assistenter og øvrige faggrupper
  • Sikre dokumentation og kontinuitet i borgerforløbene

Du får rollen som generalist i sammenhængende forløb med bred samarbejdsflade og stor faglig selvstændighed.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er autoriseret sygeplejerske
  • Har gerne 1–2 års erfaring (en fordel, men ikke et krav)
  • Trives med kompleksitet og ansvar
  • Har selvindsigt og mod til at søge faglig sparring
  • Er udviklingsorienteret og nysgerrig på nye arbejdsgange
  • Ser styrken i tværfagligt og tværsektorielt samarbejde



Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt snarest eller senest 1. oktober 2026.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og efter konkret forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation.

Ugentligt timetal: Fuldtid


Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Karen Kinch Hansen, leder på tlf. 5157 6730 eller mail hkika@aarhus.dk. I ugerne 31-33 Berit Rogild Hansen tlf. 8713 1651 (afdelingstelefon)


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 20. august 2026.

Samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende, sidste samtaler den 25.8.2026

I Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg har vi en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelser indhentes referencer og evt. straffeattest. Du må derfor forvente at blive anmodet herom, hvis vi tilbyder dig stillingen.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet.


Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:

Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.


Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Android Developer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android Developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Korea. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Korea.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area for us. We’re happy to discuss hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours, patterns and locations to suit you and our business.

About the Opportunity

As a Principal Solutions Architect, you will specialise in the design, development and governance of integrated digital project controls environments across major capital programmes. This is not a general IT solutions architecture role. It is a domain specialised architecture position focused on Programme Management, PMO systems, Project Controls processes and EPPM technology ecosystems. Working within the Digital and Data Solutions Group under the Programme Controls Technology capability, you will collaborate closely with project management, project controls teams, programme delivery leadership, enterprise architects and technology partners to define scalable, secure and integrated solutions for:

  • Cost Management

  • Schedule Management

  • Risk, Change and Contingency

  • Performance Reporting

  • Data Governance and Integrated Analytics

You will act as a technical authority for project controls platforms, ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture principles, programme delivery strategy and best practice controls methodologies.

We have a number of vacancies based at our Manchester, Glasgow and London office. The roles will be hybrid roles with travel to client sites when required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define enterprise aligned solution architectures for programme controls platforms covering cost, schedule, risk, performance reporting and data governance.

  • Lead evaluation, selection, design and configuration of programme controls systems such as EcoSys, Oracle Primavera P6 and Unifier, Aconex, CDEs including SharePoint and ProjectWise, and related digital delivery tools.

  • Translate business, PMO and programme requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable solution designs aligned to enterprise architecture standards and major programme delivery strategies.

  • Design and govern integration architectures across APIs, data pipelines, reporting tools and wider programme delivery systems to ensure seamless interoperability and consistency of controls data.

  • Identify architectural risks, constraints and dependencies, develop mitigation strategies and ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, resilience and security requirements.

  • Act as the technical authority for implementation teams, software vendors and delivery partners, ensuring solutions meet business, technical and quality specifications throughout the delivery lifecycle.

  • Support digital transformation across PMO and project controls, including process harmonisation, standardisation, change adoption and optimisation of digital ways of working.

  • Provide strategic architectural input across bidding, mobilisation and programme delivery phases, advising on technology roadmaps, solution options and implementation approaches.

Here’s What You’ll Need

  • Strong experience designing and implementing Programme Management and Project Controls technology solutions, ideally within major capital programmes or complex delivery environments.

  • Solid understanding of core project controls processes, including cost management, planning and scheduling, risk, change control, governance and performance reporting.

  • Hands on experience with project controls and EPPM platforms including EcoSys, Primavera P6, Primavera Unifier, Aconex and CDEs such as SharePoint and ProjectWise.

  • Ability to design robust technical architectures covering integration models, data structures, coding frameworks, workflow design and interoperability patterns relevant to project controls ecosystems.

  • Experience assessing and optimising existing systems architectures, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, scalability and analytical capability.

  • Background supporting digital transformation in PMO and project controls, including business process improvement, operating model changes and standardisation of ways of working.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, capable of articulating technical trade offs, solution options and dependencies to non technical audiences.

  • Strong analytical and data modelling capabilities, with experience shaping structured programme data environments for integrated reporting and performance analytics.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Experience designing, implementing or supporting PMO and Project Controls systems including EcoSys, Primavera P6, Unifier, Aconex or equivalent EPPM technologies.

  • Proven experience evaluating, configuring and deploying COTS and SaaS solutions using structured assessment, selection and implementation methodologies.

  • Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, MODAF or NAF and their application within programme delivery and governance environments.

  • Familiarity with DevOps aligned delivery practices and CI and CD concepts, particularly relating to integration environments, automated deployment models and cloud based delivery pipelines.

  • Experience with reporting and analytics tools including Power BI, Tableau or equivalent BI platforms used for programme performance reporting.

  • Strong understanding of integration technologies including API design, ETL processes, data pipelines and interoperability standards relevant to controls ecosystems.

  • Degree in engineering, computer science, project management or a related discipline or equivalent professional experience.

  • APM, PMI or similar project and programme management certification is advantageous and demonstrates strong alignment with PMO and delivery governance disciplines.

title: AI Workforce Development Specialist
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The AI Workforce Development Specialist owns the programs, partnerships, and communications that move Smart Mfg & AI's (SMAI's) upskilling agenda forward. This is a program- and people-centric role. You will design learning journeys, coordinate training across teams, run our expert and seminar series, maintain relationships with technology partners and universities, and track the adoption and impact of everything we deliver. You translate SMAI's strategy into well-run programs that help team members confidently adopt AI efficiency tools, learn new ways of working, and grow into emerging AI roles. You partner closely with the Workforce Development Engineer, who builds the hands-on technical content and tooling you bring to the organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Training & Upskilling of the SMAI Team - Own and drive the SMAI training agenda and the sharing of Best Known Methods (BKMs) for AI productivity tools, ensuring a steady cadence of high-quality, well-attended sessions. Coordinate training on new ways of working, including end-to-end (E2E) AI workflows, partnering with subject-matter experts to schedule, promote, and run sessions. Design and manage structured upskilling pathways that move team members into emerging roles such as AI Product Owner and E2E AI Full-Stack Developer. Administer skills and training platforms (LMS / learning platforms): curate catalogs, run enrollments and learning paths, and maintain content libraries. Define and track learning metrics—participation, completion, skill attainment, and adoption—and report progress to leadership.

  • Partner Capabilities - Coordinate communications around external conferences and announcements from our technology partners, ensuring relevant updates reach the right SMAI audiences. Lead targeted, strategic collaboration with a select group of universities—owning the relationship cadence, joint program logistics, and follow-through.

  • AI Innovations - Organize and run the Generative AI expert series and master classes, from speaker coordination and scheduling to promotion and post-session follow-up. Facilitate innovation sharing across SMAI, creating the venues, formats, and channels that surface and spread new ideas.

  • Technical Leadership Program (TLP) - Coordinate the data science technical seminar series, managing logistics, speakers, and attendance. Support mentoring programs and help clarify and communicate the expectations for advancement into and within the TLP.

  • Upskilling Outside SMAI (Citizen Data Science Development) - Coordinate citizen data science development upskilling programs that extend AI capability beyond SMAI to the broader enterprise. Build communications, onboarding, and community-of-practice structures that help non-specialists adopt approved AI tools responsibly.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Education, Communications, Human Resources, Business, STEM, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, learning & development, enablement, communications, or a related subject area, including the design and delivery of training programs.

  • Strong project management skills capable of managing multiple initiatives, timelines, and key leaders simultaneously.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex or technical concepts into clear, engaging content.

  • Familiarity with AI tools that enhance efficiency and a strong interest in bringing to bear AI-enabled solutions to improve learning, enablement, and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience administering an LMS or skills/learning platform (catalog, learning paths, reporting).

  • Experience managing external partnerships—with universities, vendors, or technology partners.

  • Background in change management or driving technology adoption across an organization.

  • Instructional design exposure and familiarity with measuring learning impact and adoption metrics.

  • Experience in a manufacturing, engineering, or technology environment.

title: Digitaliseringskonsulent med fokus på processer og projekter
description:
Motiveres du af at skabe værdi gennem digitalisering, optimere processer og sikre, at projekter kommer godt i mål?

Vi søger en engageret digitaliseringskonsulent, der brænder for at kortlægge, udvikle og optimere kommunale processer samt sikre, at de understøttes af brugervenlige digitale løsninger.

Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med analyse, procesdesign, projektledelse, implementering og forankring af nye løsninger – gerne i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer på tværs af organisationen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
  • Planlægge, koordinere og gennemføre digitaliseringsprojekter
  • Understøtte implementering af nye processer og systemer, herunder forandringsledelse og kommunikation
  • Kortlægge, analysere og klargøre processer til automatisering
  • Koordinere opgaver med automatiseringsteamet
  • Bidrage til kommunens digitale udvikling inden for blandt andet AI og Microsoft 365 – gerne med afsæt i konkrete erfaringer fra tidligere projekter
  • Facilitere workshops og samarbejde med kollegaer om udvikling af digitale løsninger

Vi tilbyder
  • en spændende og alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse på egne opgaver
  • dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer med stærke faglige kompetencer
  • en leder, der lytter til gode idéer og giver plads til initiativ
  • høj grad af selvtilrettelæggelse og fleksibilitet
  • et stærkt socialt fællesskab med en uformel tone og plads til humor
  • grundig introduktion og løbende sparring, så du kommer godt fra start
Om dig
Du må meget gerne kunne vise din erfaring via konkrete eksempler indenfor 365 og/eller AI.
Måske har du samlet erfaring fra det kommunale via en administrativ uddannelse og/eller stilling, som projektkoordinator, og vil nu tage næste skridt i din karriere.

Vi forventer, at du fagligt
  • har erfaring med projektledelse, procesoptimering eller digitalisering, måske på junior niveau
  • har god systemforståelse og kan omsætte behov til digitale løsninger
  • er stærk i både mundtlig og skriftlig kommunikation i en organisation hvor dansk er primære sprog i systemer og blandt ansatte
Vi forventer, at du personligt
  • arbejder struktureret og trives med at skabe overblik over processer, projekter og digitale løsninger
  • er nysgerrig på, hvordan digitalisering kan skabe værdig
  • motiveres af at samarbejde med forskellige fagområder for at finde de bedste løsninger
  • trives i samarbejdet med mange forskellige faggrupper
  • er initiativrig, ansvarsbevidst og kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag
Om os
IT-afdelingen er en del af Staben i Aabenraa Kommune og består af cirka 35 medarbejdere fordelt på IT-Drift, IT-Helpdesk og IT-Digitalisering.

Du bliver en del af et dynamisk team, hvor samarbejde, udvikling og gode relationer er i fokus.
Vi værdsætter engagement, åben dialog og en uformel omgangstone, hvor der også er plads til et godt grin i hverdagen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelsen sker efter gældende overenskomst , din uddannelse og/eller erfaring.
Det ugentlige timetal er 37 timer.

Tiltrædelse ønskes pr. 02. november 2026. Arbejdsstedet er Aabenraa Rådhus, Skelbækvej 2, 6200 Aabenraa.

Yderligere oplysninger
Har du brug for at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Majbrit Hammerich Hansen, IT Digitaliseringsleder på tlf. 24764664 eller mail: mahh@aabenraa.dk
Hun holder ferie i uge 33 og 34, men svarer udover disse.

Ansøgning
Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag via linket senest mandag den 04. september.
Samtaler forventes at afholdes den 15. og 16. september 2026.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Kommunens mission er, at vi sammen skaber Det Gode Liv.
Er du tilflytter, vil vi gerne, at du falder hurtigt og godt til. Derfor har vi en række tilbud til dig - og dem der eventuelt flytter med.

title: Mechanical and Thermal Supply Base Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is a global leader in the field of AI, computer graphics, PC gaming and accelerated computing. The Supply Base Engineering Team (SBE) at NVIDIA is dedicated to the excellence in New Product Introduction (NPI) for mechanical and thermal components. We have an immediate opening for a Supply Base Engineer role. The mission is to ensure the seamless integration of design and manufacturing processes. As a pivotal part of our team, you will focus on the advancement of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles, developing MFD (Manufacturing for design) solutions, driving manufacturing feedback to Engineering and implementing industry optimized methodology to ensure smooth system integration in manufacturing. You will be working concurrently with NVIDIA hardware engineering teams and thermal, mechanical suppliers to develop manufacturing maturity at the same pace of product design, starting from conception phase, through new NPI to MP (mass production). We are looking for individuals who thrive in a dynamic environment and are not afraid to roll-up their sleeves and get their hands dirty. We desire a self-starter, with great communication skills and a deep sense of commitment.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Manage consumer NPI mechanical and thermal component qualification, manufacturing technology management and MP readiness.

  • Represent Operations during early product life cycle and provide manufacturability, quality, cost and yield impact information to design, sourcing, and manufacturing engineering teams.

  • Ensure clear product specifications, such as CMF (color, material and finish), cosmetic spec, 2D drawing and reliability requirement.

  • Lead suppliers to establish efficient fabrication process flow and to drive solutions to problems that are or might adversely affect MP.

  • Provide manufacturability feasibility analysis, identify risks, develop mitigation plan and apply risk minimizing techniques to optimize manufacturability.

  • Perform surveys and audits for new supplier selection and qualification with functional teams.

  • Implementing KISS principle (keep it simple, stupid), handle DFM exception agreement.

  • Address front line production and manufacturing product issues, monitor health of fleet and initiate investigation of issues, and root cause product failures and drive corrective action.

  • Own yield and efficiency improvement actions and process change decisions based on statistical process control (SPC) data analysis to meet target capacity.

  • Manufacturing waste reduction, cost optimization proposals as well as cosmetic appearance improvement.

What we need to see:

  • B.S. degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience; M.S. preferred

  • 3+ years of consumer product design.

  • In depth knowledge of commonly used industrial design decoration manufacturing technology capability, material selection, and related tooling/mold technologies.

  • Proven hands-on experience and proficiency in DFM good practice to provide data driven product design suggestions.

  • Technical and quality sensitive and effective problem-solver through collaboration and ability, strong performance-oriented spirit, and excellent coordinating & organizing abilities

  • Ability to learn quickly and operate outside of comfort zone, team oriented with a "can do" attitude, highly enthusiastic in solving multi-disciplinary challenges.

  • Experience to visualize, clarify product system assembly needs through optimization, and to analyze a problem from multiple perspectives and explore creative solutions, practical knowledge of system assembly, system testing and tolerance capability.

  • Detail oriented and comfortable multitasking in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities and changing requirements, good project management skills, familiar with NPI, and solid ability to prioritize, ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment and balance multiple projects, ability to drive multiple parts and aspect of products manufacturing process development simultaneously.

  • Working knowledge of modern mechanical design tools preferably Creo or SolidWorks, proficient with commonly used testing, inspection method and instrument.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • The ideal candidate would have balanced design and manufacturing experience and passion for manufacturing process optimization, craftsmanship and quality delivery as well as a background in consumer product mechanical design and manufacturing environment.

  • We are looking for individuals who thrive in a dynamic environment and are not afraid to roll-up their sleeves and get their hands dirty. We desire a self-starter, a leader with a deep sense of dedication

  • Excellent interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-cultural and muti-functional teams.

  • Experience in functional tolerancing, GD&T, SPC, NUDD, system assembly/testing, and a solid grasp of NPI processes.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, focus essential issues, and simplify complexity, and take practical steps towards a solution.

  • Relevant experience in highly cosmetic demanding products.

As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law

As a Facilities Maintenance Technician at Southwest Airlines, you’ll help keep our station safe and running smoothly. You’ll handle repairs, preventive maintenance, and small construction projects to make sure our buildings and equipment work their best. You’ll also check systems, respond to requests quickly, and help prepare for extreme weather. This role is hands-on and important—you’ll support our People and Customers every day while making Southwest better for the future.

Additional details

  • U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the U.S. required and no current or future work authorization sponsorship available.

We’re committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.

Responsibilities

  • Performs on-call repairs and preventive maintenance of SWA facilities and equipment (excluding station ground equipment, computer terminals, etc.) as assigned by the Employee's Leaders

  • Responsible for keeping the workshops and tools clean and organized, maintaining inventory control, and performing other duties as required

  • Performs light construction duties, including drywall, acoustical ceiling, tape, bed, texture and painting

  • Works with the Team to ensure all repairs are performed and requests responded to in a professional and timely manner; and process daily work order requests

  • Assists in scheduling contractors and performing work so as to have the least impact on our Customers’ daily operations

  • Performs routine, systematic inspections, including functionality and condition of mechanical and electrical rooms, restrooms, public areas, roofs, exterior finishes, sidewalks, holdrooms, potable water cabinets, stairwells, and parking areas (where applicable)

  • Provides facilities maintenance services supporting Southwest’s transportation operations located in various facilities

  • Assists in the preparation of the facility for extreme weather conditions

  • Must be able to meet any physical ability requirements listed on this description

  • May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Must be able to work well with others as part of a Team

  • Must possess Leadership skills to direct maximum performance from outside contractors, and maintain working relationships with Internal Customers

  • Must be a Servant Leader

  • Must have good written and verbal communication skills

  • Must possess good organizational and prioritization skills

  • Must be able to obtain and carry a cell phone

Education

title: Team Leader - senior (KONE BUSINESS SERVICES) F/M
description:
At KONE, our purpose is to shape the future of cities by delivering innovative and sustainable solutions for elevators, escalators, and building access systems. Guided by our strategy ‘Rise‘, we are committed to leading in employee and customer experience, sustainability, and innovation. We also embrace LEAN principles and LEAN UX methodologies, driving efficiency, customer-focused design, and continuous improvement across all our operations.

We are seeking an experienced senior Team Leader to join our Global Spare Supply team in KONE Business Services (KBS) center in Bratislava. In this role, you will lead a team of 10 professionals responsible for providing critical administrative support to stakeholders in the spare order management process. Your team will enable complete, correct and punctual deliveries of spares and accessories to frontline units and will manage the interface with key stakeholders during the delivery process.

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, and develop a team, fostering a culture of collaboration, high performance, and LEAN thinking.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, aligning priorities and enabling smooth collaboration.

  • Coach and mentor team members, providing regular feedback and supporting professional growth and development.

  • Oversee resource allocation to ensure critical tasks are prioritized, especially during unplanned demand.

  • Implement proactive workload balancing strategies to optimize team productivity

  • Act as a role model in managing stress and maintaining resilience, guiding the team through high-pressure situations with composure and positive leadership

  • Facilitate open communication within the team to surface challenges early and collaboratively identify solutions

  • Apply LEAN UX principles to improve service workflows, prioritizing customer-centric solutions and quick iterations.

  • Provide expertise and hands-on assistance with operational tasks and major projects as needed.

  • Promote a mindset of continuous improvement, encouraging feedback loops, and data-driven decision-making.

Who We’re Looking For

  • At least five years of experience in leading teams, preferably in supply chain and logistics, with customer service background as an advantage.

  • Good understanding of material and information flow within the supply chain process.

  • Experience from shared services or international corporate environment.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus among diverse stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Attention to detail and ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated competence in managing stress and maintaining resilience under pressure, ensuring steady performance and effective leadership in challenging situations.

  • Ability to analyze data and leverage insights for decision-making and continuous improvement.

  • Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in other European language is of an advantage.

  • Familiarity with SAP or similar enterprise systems is highly desirable.

  • A collaborative and proactive leader who thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

  • Experience in applying LEAN principles or LEAN UX is a plus.

What we offer

At KONE, we are committed to creating a supportive and engaging workplace where you can thrive. Some of our benefits include:

    (Referral, Loyalty & Life Events)

From 2.500 EUR/month; Our final offer will be based on your experience and qualifications.

At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. title: Cloud Solution Architect (Cloud & AI Infrastructure)
description:
Overview

Are you excited about Microsoft Azure? Join our team as a Cloud Solution Architect - Cloud & AI Infrastructure! We work with customers to help them achieve their business priorities and guide them in their Cloud & AI transformation journey. We also support customers in evaluating their applications and business requirements, recommend solutions that meet their requirements, and demonstrate these solutions to win technical decisions.

We’re looking for a passionate and collaborative Cloud Solution Architect to help customers migrate, modernize and secure their infrastructure, applications, and data on Microsoft Azure, laying the foundation for scalable, production-ready AI solutions. As part of the Cloud & AI Infrastructure team, you’ll deliver engagements focused on migration, modernization, operational excellence and resilient architecture using frameworks like Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Framework (WAF). You’ll work closely with customer IT leaders to design and implement scalable solutions, resolve blockers, and accelerate adoption of Azure services through repeatable IP and delivery excellence. With deep expertise across Azure infrastructure, applications, databases, SAP, and hybrid environments, you’ll play a key role in helping customers unlock the full value of their Microsoft Azure investments.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Create business value by translating customer challenges into actionable solutions aligned to high ROI customer outcomes. Ensure a seamless, connected experience that fosters satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term value.

  • Lead architectural design sessions and deliver secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure solutions aligned to customer business goals using frameworks like CAF and WAF.

  • Partner with technical and sales teams to identify opportunities and develop tailored solutions to drive expansion and business value realization.

  • Drive migration and modernization initiatives, including committed proof of concept and production milestones, across infrastructure, data, SAP, and AI workloads.

  • Ensure customer environments are optimized for health, resiliency, security, and performance—enabling production-scale AI use cases.

  • Deliver repeatable IP and contribute to centralized IP development to accelerate deployment and achieve targeted outcomes.

  • Identify and resolve technical blockers to accelerate go-live and ensure delivery excellence.

  • Generate incremental pipeline from each engagement by driving next best actions and aligning with business priorities.

  • Maintain technical intensity through continuous skilling and certifications in priority workloads such as App Service/PaaS Services, Networking, Windows, Linux, Modern Databases, Defender for Cloud and SAP (Native + RISE).

  • Engage in technical communities, share best practices, and contribute to knowledge reuse to accelerate customer transformation and success.

  • Embody our Microsoft culture and values.



Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
    • OR equivalent experience
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Azure cloud architecture and infrastructure solutions

Preferred

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 8+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 6+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting

title: Specialist, Settlement Services
description:
JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION

Responsible for daily monitoring and processing of Settlement processes covering Domestic and Regional and International Market for equities, mutual funds, fixed income, hedge fund, structured funds, ETF, Local and International Securities Lending and Borrowing, Local Market Short Selling and ensuring highest quality of client service delivery as per international standards.
Responsible for handling extremely complex settlement transaction across Local, Regional, International Markets. Processing responsibilities include the receipt of client, market / sub custodian instructions. Validating the correctness of all instructions. Ensuring the matching and settlement of instructions in timely manner across all markets.
Communicate with many entities Clients, Counter parties, Markets, Sub Custodians, Regulators, Companies, Brokers, Paying Agents, Issuers covering Local, Regional, Global Markets, related to settlement process, support Due Diligence visits linking to Settlement process.
The incumbent is responsible for adhering to established quality control measures and procedures.
Responsible to provide the first level training for new specialists and will assist specialists in handling inquiries.

Active participation in understanding the Operating module, including Securities Lending and Borrowing transactions, that are large in value and complex in nature, ensuring their successful settlement processing, avoiding loss and penalties to the bank and clients that could cause the bank Reputational, Financial and Operational Risk.
Current offering of Department: Position Management, Security/Cash Settlement, Corporate Actions, Reporting, Invoicing, Reconciliation, Swift, Market Security Movement, FX Management, Cash Management, Project Support, Proxy Services, Tax Reclaims, Income Management. title: Senior Planning Engineer
description:
We are currently recruiting for a Project Planner to undertake duties within our Project Controls team.

The Project Planner will work as part of our Project Controls team on high profile construction projects throughout the UK and Europe, providing performance reporting and analysis support. This may be part of a large team or as the key day to day contact point with the client. Key activities include:

  • Identify trends and root causes of deviations against the baseline using lead and lag indicators, recommend remedial actions to drive best value for the client.
  • Lead the evaluation of the projects time, cost, and quality targets, applying governance controls as necessary to enable the successful delivery of the project.
  • Cooperate with a remote team of cost managers responsible for reaching an agreed, market tested cost baseline and ensuring the client is receiving value for money.
  • Guide and influence the general contractor, ensuring they are progressing in line with the schedule and within agreed cash flow parameters.
  • Act as the key point of contact to the client overcoming delivery and commercial issues whilst preparing formal and ad hoc reports focussing on time, cost and quality targets.
  • Control costs with your knowledge of conceptual estimating, funding stage gates, basic contingency principals, procurement principals.
  • Create and/or work within a cost report, summarizing financials in a executive level dashboard.
  • Understand change management principals, lead agreed change management process and workflow, providing a platform for adding/tracking/monitoring/approving change.
  • Coordinate and lead planning sessions and workshops with clients and vendors to compile the master project/programme schedule, agreeing baselines and a critical path.
  • Understand procurement principals, collate lead times from vendors and client into the master schedule communicate the prioritisation of ordering materials and equipment to meet scheduled install dates.
  • Work closely with the client to define vendor schedule requirements.
  • Actively participate in project team risk evaluations, incorporating the defined risks into Monte Carlo to output quantitative impacts to the overall project cost and schedule.
  • Work closely with the project team to stay informed on status of project changes, incorporating and communicating these to the project team to allow for approvals in the change management process.
  • Hold vendors accountable for required schedule updates and reporting to maintain timely and accurate updates of the master schedule ensuring that the schedules adhere to the defined process and quality expectations.
  • Experience in at least one of the following: Programme Controls Management, Earned Value (EVM), Change & Risk Management, Planning, Project Controls and or PMO.
  • Applicants will ideally be degree educated, with previous industry & sector experience being essential.
  • Previous experience of the following tools (or one of) is also required: Oracle Primavera, MS Project, Excel, PRISM (Cost Management System)
  • Applicants will also require excellent written and verbal communication skills, be rigorous in following documented processes and governance and be able to demonstrate the ability to innovate in creative ways to meet the challenges of the changing project environment.
