title: Kalder alle supersælgere! Circle K Ustrup Vest søger studerende sælgere på 15 timer
description:
Kære fremtidige kollega

Først og fremmest, lad os starte med at sige, at et job som Sælger hos Circle K ikke er for alle. Men det er et job der passer til mange, og måske også dig?

At arbejde som sælger på Circle K er ikke som ethvert sælgerjob. Os der arbejder her er vilde med det, og spørger du en af vores uundværlige sælgere om hvorfor, vil de bla nævne: Selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og ansvar.

Vi leder efter en positiv teamplayer som:

  • Har en sælger gemt I sig, motiveres af salg og kan levere en service lidt ud over det sædvanlige

  • Kan bevare overblikket og humøret, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft. Også selvom der er lang kø

  • Har en interesse for at tilberede mad. For vi elsker det! Og vi ser derfor gerne, at du har lyst til, at lave de lækreste sandwich og de bedste burgere.

  • Forstår vigtigheden af, at vores kunder får den bedste oplevelse når de besøger os. Dette indebærer også at butikken, kundetoilet og forplads er ren og pæn.

  • Du forstår betydningen af, at arbejde i et team, hvor alle er afhængige af- og stoler på, at hver løfter sit. Og til tider er villig til at give lidt ekstra.

Hvad kan I tilbyde mig?

Vi er en dynamisk, handlingsorienteret organisation, hvor vi arbejder sammen som ét team. Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt og engagerer os ikke i politik eller bureaukrati. Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på.

Udover helt unikke udviklingsmuligheder, tilbyder vi et job med yderst attraktive fordele og personalegoder. Som en del af vores Circle K familie vil du bla få medarbejderrabat på brændstof, bilvask samt på mad og drikkevarer i vores butikker. Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring

  • Fordelagtige lønninger og forskudttidstillæg

  • Og ikke mindst, Danmarks bedste kollegaer

Mange der i dag driver vores stationer eller arbejder på vores kontor, startede deres karriere som sælgere på stationen, måske var tanken bare at blive hos os et stykke tid, men det var begyndelsen på en lang karriere! Og for dig der har andre mål og drømme i din karriere, er Circle K et fantastisk sted til at få erfaring, der er værd at tage med sig videre i arbejdslivet.

Så hvis du vil have et job, hvor du kan være med til at give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse, udvikle dig og blive en del af et fantastisk team på Circle K Ustrup Vest, så er det nu du skal sende din ansøgning afsted.

Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Store Manager Martin Skov på tlf nr.: 74 54 53 44

Antal timer og arbejdstidspunkter

15 timer om ugen fordelt på både hverdage og weekender. Arbejdstiden ligger primært i aften- og weekendtimerne.

Stillingen er tilrettelagt som et studiejob og henvender sig til studerende.

title: Senior Tendermanager
description:
Als Senior Tendermanager word je onderdeel van een professioneel en gedreven Verwervings- en Tendermanagementteam van circa 40 collega’s, verspreid over onze landelijke vestigingen. Binnen deze afdeling werk je nauw samen met vier collega-tendermanagers en geef je inhoudelijk sturing aan multidisciplinaire teams van specialisten, waaronder kostendeskundigen, strategen en planschrijvers. Samen borgen jullie de juiste balans tussen inhoudelijke scherpte, commerciële kansen en een winnende propositie.

Bij Strukton Civiel NL bouwen we aan infrastructurele oplossingen met blijvende maatschappelijke impact. We innoveren, kijken vooruit en realiseren projecten waar je als professional met trots op terugkijkt.

Bouw jij als Senior Tendermanager mee aan de toekomst van Strukton Civiel Nederland?

Als natuurlijk leider en strategisch sparringpartner combineer je inhoudelijke autoriteit met verbindend vermogen. Je weet multidisciplinaire teams te inspireren, scherp te houden en te sturen op het beste resultaat. Je beschikt over een sterk commercieel gevoel: je stelt niet alleen een ijzersterke visie op, maar weet deze ook met overtuigingskracht te presenteren, zowel aan onze Groepsdirectie als aan de opdrachtgever.

Dankzij jouw analytische scherpte en klantgerichte blik doorgrond je de kern én de latente vraag achter de uitvraag moeiteloos, en vertaal je deze naar een winnende propositie. Je organiseert het proces strak en gestructureerd, bewaart de rust onder druk en durft waar nodig knopen door te hakken. In de dynamiek van grote tenders toon je veerkracht en wendbaarheid: met een constructieve en kritische blik neem je het team mee in leermomenten en laad je het op voor de volgende winnende inschrijving. Cruciaal hierin is jouw verbinding met de praktijk; je haalt continu de kennis op uit de uitvoering om te borgen dat wat we beloven, buiten ook écht voorspelbaar gerealiseerd kan worden.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Opleidingsniveau: HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur een afgeronde studie in een technische, bedrijfskundige of bedrijfseconomische richting.

  • Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als integraal en eindverantwoordelijk Tendermanager binnen omvangrijke, complexe en multidisciplinaire infrastructuurprojecten.

  • Marktkennis: Diepgaand inzicht in en visie op de dynamiek binnen de civiele infrastructuur, waterbouw, industriële nieuwbouw, de afvalwatersector én de energietransitie.

  • Netwerk: Een relevant en actueel netwerk van opdrachtgevers, ketenpartners, ingenieursbureaus en onderaannemers waarmee je snel en strategisch kunt schakelen.

  • Communicatie: Uitstekende uitdrukkingsvaardigheid in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als op schrift.

Aanvullende informatie

Wij waarderen jouw inzet en bieden daarvoor:

  • Toegang tot opleidingen en volop ruimte voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling
  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding
  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken
  • Een goede pensioenregeling met werkgeversbijdrage
  • Veiligheid en mobiliteit staan bij ons voorop. Daarom krijg je een leaseauto die past bij jou en het werk dat jij uitvoert, zodat jij flexibel en professioneel op pad kunt. Daarnaast ontvang je ook een NS-Businesscard
  • 30 vakantiedagen per jaar
  • Met een ruim keuzebudget boven op je salaris, inclusief vakantiegeld, bepaal jij zelf: meer vrije dagen (tot 13 extra), of extra geld op je rekening.
  • Een uitstekend brutosalaris tussen € 5.800,- en € 8.800,- per 4 weken, afhankelijk van je ervaring

Wil je meer weten? Heeft deze vacature jouw interesse gewekt, maar wil je graag meer informatie, neem dan telefonisch, via e-mail of Whatsapp contact op met onze Recruiter Lucas van Lamsweerde via 06-27482618 of lucas.vanlamsweerde@strukton.com.

title: Securities Services –  Agency Securities Finance Trading & Analytics – Vice President
description:
Join a global team at the forefront of securities finance innovation. This is your opportunity to shape Trading and pricing strategies and deliver impactful analytics that drive business success. Collaborate with talented colleagues across regions and contribute to the evolution of our data-driven approach. We offer a dynamic environment where your insights and expertise will make a real difference. Take the next step in your career with us.

Agency Securities Finance is a global trading desk within Securities Services that lends equity and fixed income securities on behalf of asset owners to broker-dealers, supporting their proprietary and client trading strategies. When securities need to be borrowed, the Financing Desk negotiates the loan fee based on supply and demand dynamics and the underlying trade rationale. The group’s objective is to generate incremental income for participating clients while also producing fee income for the firm. With five trading desks globally, JPMorganChase provides near-24-hour coverage across 38 markets.

The Agency Securities Finance Trading & Analytics team develops client, trading, and financial resource analytics used to price securities lending portfolios and transactions. The team monitors ongoing client and counterparty performance and delivers revenue reporting, attribution, and forecasting across business activity. These metrics are used to continuously refine pricing models, build new data-driven matrices, and produce accurate, competitive securities lending revenue forecasts—while improving overall efficiency and return on capital.

The team also owns Financial Resource Management for the business, including capital and balance-sheet metrics such as RWA, CCAR/SCB, and overall capital footprint.

Job Summary

As an Agency Securities Finance Trading & Analytics Vice President in the Securities Services team, you will develop and deliver analytics that underpin our securities lending business. You will work closely with colleagues across trading, research, and finance to optimise pricing, enhance revenue forecasting, and support capital efficiency. You will be part of a collaborative team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and your professional growth.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance pricing analytics for securities lending portfolios and individual transactions across clients and counterparties.

  • Produce revenue estimates, summaries, and attribution analysis to explain performance drivers across trading activity.

  • Partner with regional teams to align pricing techniques and forecasting methodology across multiple geographies.

  • Build and maintain matrices/analytics to support optimization of RWA and SCB footprint and broader capital efficiency.

  • Collaborate closely with the Quantitative Research team to design and implement tools that optimize Agency Securities Finance trading and business decisions.

  • Apply a rigorous, data-driven approach using large datasets to generate actionable insights and improve model performance.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

  • Advanced Excel skills and strong familiarity with Bloomberg.

  • Python and SQL skills preferred; comfort working with large datasets and statistical packages.

  • Highly motivated, detail-oriented, and able to multitask under pressure.

  • Strong communication skills and proven ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

  • Strong interest in equity and fixed income markets; securities Finance experience is a plus.

  • Knowledge of bank regulatory capital frameworks (Basel III / Basel IV) is a plus.

  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills; quantitative/modeling background preferred.

This role encompasses the performance of UK regulated activity. The successful candidate will therefore be subject to meeting UK regulatory requirements in the assessment of fitness, propriety, knowledge and competence as assessed by the Firm and, where appropriate, approval by the UK Financial Conduct Authority and/or the Prudential Regulation Authority to carry out such activities.

title: Pædagog til verdens bedste arbejdsplads på Captum Brønshøjvej
description:
Captums beskæftigelses- og aktivitetstilbud § 104 på Brønshøjvej søger en ansvarstagende og struktureret pædagog.

Om os
På Brønshøjvej er der 41 voksne borgere tilknyttet med fysisk og psykisk nedsat funktionsniveau i alderen fra 18 år og opefter. Borgerne har forskellige ressourcer og udfordringer og har behov for støtte i at få struktureret deres hverdag. Captum er en del af Center for Aktivitet, Beskæftigelse og Støtte i Egen Bolig.

Brønshøjvej ligger tæt ved det hyggelige Brønshøj Torv og blandt de store villaer ved Degnemosen.

Vi er et velfungerende stabilt team, der arbejder tæt sammen. Vi er fordelt i to grupper og har mange fælles beskæftigelsesopgaver i og udenfor huset. Vi arbejder målrettet på at give den enkelte borger en arbejdsidentitet ved at give borgerne mulighed for at deltage i lærings- og beskæftigelsesforløb med henblik på, at den enkelte udnytter sit potentiale og har en meningsfuld hverdag.

Vi er et hus med højt til loftet, god stemning, masser af humor og godt sammenhold.

Kerneopgaven er, at borgerne oplever, at deres ressourcer er i spil, så den enkelte kan bidrage med sit fulde potentiale og opnå øget selvstændighed og livskvalitet gennem læring og beskæftigelse.

Captums formål og målsætning er at skabe udvikling sammen med borgerne. Vi spotter talent, skaber meningsfuld beskæftigelse og aktivt medborgerskab, hvor alle udnytter deres potentialer. Vi arbejder aktivt med KRAP-metoden. Dette er en fælles faglig tilgang.

Er du engageret, har en høj faglighed og brænder for at samarbejde i et ambitiøst team, så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Vores kommende kollega forventes at have erfaring med arbejdet med borgere med fysisk/psykisk nedsat funktionsniveau og har kendskab til autismespektrumforstyrrelser og Low Arousal.

Du brænder for målgruppen og har en anerkendende og ressourceorienteret tilgang. Du kan lide at have en travl hverdag med mange bolde i luften.

Vi søger en kollega, der

  • Har erfaring med mennesker med nedsat funktionsniveau og autismespektrumforstyrrelser
  • Er målrettet og kan strukturere hverdagen i samarbejdet med kollegaer på tværs af huset
  • Har et positivt sind og naturligt overblik
  • Er etisk velfunderet
  • Kan igangsætte, motivere og gå foran i de praktiske opgaver, der er på arbejdspladsen
  • Er villig til at indgå i tæt sparring med dine kollegaer og sætter pris på et godt kollegaskab
  • Har en god faglig ballast og kan være en god rollemodel for borgerne
Vi tilbyder

  • Et center i konstant udvikling
  • En spændende arbejdsplads præget af høj pædagogisk faglighed
  • Samarbejde med unikke borgere med hver deres særlige interesser og behov
  • Høj trivsel
  • En plads som medspiller i et ambitiøst og engageret team med dygtige kollegaer, der sætter pris på arbejdsfællesskabet
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling
Det er en forudsætning at du har kørekort, da vi ofte bruger vores bus i hverdagen til beskæftigelse.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er en fastansættelse med en arbejdstid på 37 timer ugentligt og ønskes besat pr. 1. oktober 2026. Ansættelse sker i henhold til overenskomst for pædagogisk personale.

Vil du vide mere?
Du meget velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Michelle Kürstein på 21 76 71 84. Du kan også læse mere om Captum og Brønshøjvej | Handicap

title: Senior Network Cloud Engineer
description:
We're fast learners, hard workers, natural collaborators... and we Make Modern Happen!

Our ambition is to unlock the potential of our digital world so that organisations everywhere can innovate and thrive securely.

We aim to achieve this goal by bringing together the world’s most talented people and the most powerful technologies, combining them to address our customers' challenges and to build something stronger together.

If you share our vision, join us!

Right now, we are looking for a Senior Network Cloud Engineer to integrate our internal team, based in Lisbon or Porto.


Your responsibilities include:

  • Design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient network architectures across Azure and multi-cloud environments;
  • Architect and manage advanced Azure networking services, including VNets, NSGs, Application Gateways, Load Balancers, VPN Gateways, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, and Private Endpoints;
  • Design secure hybrid connectivity across on-premises, Azure, and GCP environments, ensuring robust routing, performance, and security;
  • Take ownership of network optimisation, diagnostics, and troubleshooting, using tools such as Azure Network Watcher, traffic analytics, Wireshark, and tcpdump;
  • Strengthen network security through micro-segmentation, Zero Trust principles, and secure access controls;
  • Support SecOps activities across Azure, including alert management, security recommendations, and response to EOL-related impact in complex tenant environments;
  • Develop automation and Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, PowerShell, Python, or Bash;
  • Design and support container networking for AKS and other Kubernetes platforms, including CNI, ingress, service mesh, and network policy considerations;
  • Produce clear technical documentation, topology diagrams, and operational standards to support governance and repeatability;
  • Collaborate closely with security, platform, and application teams to ensure alignment between network design, security posture, and business objectives.


You must have:

  • Deep expertise in Azure networking and strong understanding of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DNS, and network security;
  • Proven experience operating in hybrid and multi-cloud environments;
  • Strong background in network automation and Infrastructure as Code;
  • Hands-on experience with SecOps, cloud security controls, and incident response;
  • Solid Kubernetes networking knowledge, ideally in AKS;
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate effectively in complex, fast-moving environments;
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.


We value:

  • Exposure to GCP networking services such as VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud CDN, and Cloud Interconnect;
  • Experience with SD-WAN, network virtualisation, and advanced orchestration platforms;
  • Knowledge of Istio, Linkerd, ingress controllers, and network policies;
  • Familiarity with compliance and regulatory considerations;
  • Experience with multi-cloud networking patterns, performance testing, and global load balancing strategies.
  • Certifications (It is not required, but it is considered a plus): Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate; Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer; Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA); Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS); HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate; Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Enterprise; Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate; Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.

We offer:

  • Regular professional development;
  • Certification paths resources;
  • Regular teambuilding programs;
  • Friendly workplace.

description:

title: Bank MRI CT Radiographer
description:
Job Advert

Bank MRI CT Radiographer

Buckshaw Hospital, Chorley

The role

At Ramsay Health Care UK, we know our people are our most important asset. Join us as an MRI Radiographer where you’ll be valued for your skills and expertise, as well as having the chance to build on them through our Ramsay Academy. We will give you access to the latest state-of-the-art equipment and technology too.

You will be part of a close-knit, innovative MRI team delivering an exceptional diagnostic imaging service. At the heart of patient care, you’ll build relationships with all the hospital’s key departments, and our consultants across many specialisms. Whilst providing exceptional clinical care, you’ll also track, process and manage images in RIS and PACS, perform audits and assist in booking in patients. But at its heart, this role is about playing a key role in the diagnosis, treatment, and care of your patients.

Where you’ll be based

Buckshaw Hospital is the third day case hospital to have been built and opened by Ramsay in the last two years. The new development is located at Matrix Park, Buckshaw Village, Chorley. It is an extension of services offered by Euxton and Fulwood Hall Hospitals. The Ramsay Team at Euxton and Fulwood are incredibly excited about the new hospital, not only does it provide further capacity to treat patients in and around the local area, but it develops the service model we already offer in the North West, delivering the best care and patient experience.

What you’ll bring with you

  • Diploma or degree in diagnostic Radiography

  • HCPC registration and evidence of post registration development

  • SOR IV cannulation certificate desirable

  • Sound written and verbal communication skills

  • Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and independently as required

  • Passion to deliver high quality diagnostic services

  • Ability to participate in on call rota and work evening/weekends as required

What we give back to you

  • Competitive hourly rates plus enhancements

  • Free DBS

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Excellent training and development opportunities

  • Free parking and subsidised staff restaurant (subject to site facilities)

  • Free uniform

  • Access to Blue Light Card

​

What is a Bank contract

A Bank contract at Ramsay Health Care UK is a flexible employment agreement where you are not committed to a set number of hours per week. Instead, you work on an ad-hoc basis, filling in shifts that we have available in our hospitals. A Bank contract is ideal for individuals seeking flexibility, as it allows you to choose shifts that fit your availability, leaving you with a greater work-life balance. Bank contracts are also a fantastic way to secure additional income alongside other contracted work. Our Bank staff play a crucial role in maintaining service levels during peak times or staff shortages, ensuring that patient care remains uninterrupted."

About us

Ramsay Health Care UK is a well-established global hospital group with over 50 years’ experience. We are a global provider operating in 11 countries with 77,000 staff who treat 8 million patients each year. It is well respected within the healthcare industry and is one of the leading providers of independent hospital services in England. We are well known for our strong, long-standing relationship with the NHS.

We love people with a positive, “can do” attitude who want to make a difference in their work. "Our employees are Ramsay." The skills and commitment of our employees forms the basis for our success.

We know our people are our greatest asset, our business is growing and we would like you to join us. “The Ramsay Way” culture recognises that people – staff and doctors – are Ramsay Health Care’s most important asset and this has been key to our ongoing success.

We are proud of our ‘Speak Up for Safety’ programme and ensure that the patient is at the heart of everything we do. Join us and have more ‘Time to Care’.

We care. It’s more than what we do, it’s who we are. Everything we do is about striving to deliver the best care. And it's a belief that's as true today as it was when we welcomed our first patients in 1964. “The Ramsay Way” culture recognises that our people are our most important asset and this has been key to our ongoing success.

We are committed to equality of opportunity for all. This position is subject to background and DBS checks.

We are proud to support the UK’s Armed Forces and Reservists and have already achieved the Silver Award as part of the MOD’s Armed Forces Covenant Employer Recognition Scheme. The scheme recognises employers who actively support Defence while encouraging other organisations to adopt the same behaviours in their workplace. As a company we are committed to supporting the wider Armed Forces community and this includes our staff as well as our patients.

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults, children and young people at risk. We expect all employees to share this commitment and behave in a way that supports it. All successful candidates will be provided with safeguarding training appropriate to their role.

title: Android Developer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android Developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Indonesia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Indonesia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Vi er en dynamisk, handlingsorienteret organisation, hvor vi arbejder sammen som ét team. Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt og engagerer os ikke i politik eller bureaukrati. Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på.

title: Incident Response Engineer-Facility Operations Center
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled Incident Response Engineer to join our Facility Operations Center (FOC) team. In this critical role, we are responsible for coordination and presentation within NVIDIA’s datacenters, with a specific focus on incident response, vendor support, and maintenance performance. You will be instrumental in ensuring the reliability and availability of our datacenter environments and minimizing the blast radius of incidents.

What you'll be doing:

  • Primary role is to perform coordination and communication across NVIDIA’s datacenter portfolio from an operations perspective regarding incidents, maintenance, and reporting/monitoring.

  • Develop standards and programs in support of reliability and operations initiatives, including Problem and Change Control, and define and maintain a health score for sites and environments, including testing methods to predict and isolate points of failure, assessing and advising on maintenance strategies, and providing related reporting and metrics.

  • Study failure data and work with machine learning and AI teams and tools to predict future failures, and facilitate reliability studies such as critical assessments, RAM models, and RCM studies. Identify and drive automation & process improvement opportunities across catalog quality workflows and reporting.

  • Coordinate disaster recovery tests, liaise during audits, collaborate with internal partners, and make vital progress to ensure business continuity and compliance. Perform risk assessments to ensure compliance with policies, procedures, rules & regulations, and data center standards.

  • Own and present end-to-end key business metrics related to incident response, including ownership and representation of internal and external tooling. Lead root cause analysis for outages and adjust documentation, workflows, and operating procedures to avoid future incidents.

  • Assess process improvement & transformation opportunities and partner with process owners & collaborators to scope opportunities, define problem statements and objectives, and structure projects and teams.

  • Work multi-functionally with other team members and groups within the organization, and develop strong, productive relationships across peer organizations that further the organization's business objectives. This will incorporate training, coaching, and mentoring Operations teams as needed to empower them to use operations tools and systems to meet daily business needs.

  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunication Engineering, Computer Science, or business-related field) or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of operations or environmental, health, and safety experience within data centers.

  • Proficient in developing and driving reliability activities (modeling predictions, life cycle testing, stress testing, etc.).

  • Commercial and financial awareness, with a full comprehension of the impact of failure in translation to business costs, production targets, and fulfillment of customer orders.

  • Highly developed numeracy, statistical, and reporting skills; ability to analyze, interpret, and apply information, data, and trends.

  • Enthusiastic about achieving goals and maintaining organization, capable of strategizing and meeting set objectives. Demonstrated ability to be meticulous, organized, and capable of consolidating data analyses for presentation to large-scale groups.

  • Proficient in the use of asset database and DCIM solutions to extract data and develop meaningful insights.

  • Experience in designing, deploying, or maintaining large-scale datacenter infrastructure (whether ACSMEP or networking) or the ability to create strategic infrastructure roadmaps including on-premise, hybrid, and cloud technologies.

  • Demonstrated knowledge and advanced proficiency working with Microsoft Office Suite software and G-Suite software.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Proven experience in reliability engineering related to electrical or mechanical cooling systems.

  • Certifications such as CDCMP, CMRP, CRL, CRE in Maintenance and Reliability.

  • Knowledge of relevant ISO standards and their implementation.

  • Demonstrated expertise in statistics, forecasting, and management information methods and techniques.

  • Strong IT systems knowledge and skills including sophisticated Office/G-Suite skills and the ability to learn new software packages.

title: UAV Demonstration and Test Pilot – National & International (all genders)
description:

  • Dynamic: You thrive under changing conditions and short-notice requests.

  • FPV piloting experience.

title: Software Engineer, Backend
description:
We are WisdomAI.

We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.

We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.

About Wisdom

WisdomAI has the mission to provide access and insights from data to everyone. We believe in the power of data to drive better decisions and we believe with Generative AI, there is an opportunity to bring a disruptive change in how employees access insights within their organization. This is a great time to join the company as we have multiple Fortune100 companies as paying customers and still are early enough that you will get to define a lot of the product/engineering roadmap.

Role

We are looking for a backend/infrastructure engineer to join our founding team. We are working on building ML and data pipelines, which can be efficient, secure and highly scalable by design.

Job responsibilities

  • Build large scale data pipelines to handle latency critical analytical workloads.

  • Work with modern cloud infrastructure to build cost efficient and scalable systems.

  • Work closely with customers and founders to define the product and engineering roadmap.

  • Shape up the engineering culture and tech stack for the company.

Qualifications

  • Experience working on large scale data pipelines.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field.

  • Experience working in startup/fast paced teams is highly desirable.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Our CRAFT

CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

C — Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

R — Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

A — Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

F — First principles, grounded in reality. We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

T — Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Equal opportunity employer

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: Head of Programme - VK
description:
Head of Programme (Customer Projects)

Our mission is to deliver clean, affordable energy for all. Our Small Modular Reactor (SMR) provides a British solution to a global energy challenge, and we are uniquely positioned to become a global leader in low-carbon nuclear energy, delivering a technology that will power generations to come.

Our Customer Projects team sits at the centre of some of the most significant energy infrastructure programmes in Europe. Working across design, licensing, procurement and construction planning, the team enables successful project delivery while shaping the future deployment of Rolls-Royce SMR technology internationally.

In this context, we are looking for a Head of Programme (Customer Projects) to support our Project Directors in delivering major international customer programmes. Reporting to the Project Director and leading integrated, matrixed delivery teams, this is a pivotal role that will help establish and deliver multi-billion-pound nuclear infrastructure projects from development through to Final Investment Decision.

We'll need you to:

  • Leading integrated programmes across design, licensing, procurement, construction planning and early site works activities.

  • Coordinating multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, supply chain, safety, regulatory and customer organisations to maintain delivery momentum and critical path.

  • Driving programme governance, risk management, dependency management, reporting and performance against schedule, cost and quality targets.

  • Building trusted operational relationships with customers, suppliers and international stakeholders to ensure successful programme execution and readiness for Final Investment Decision.

As you can see, this is a high-profile leadership opportunity where you'll bring commercial acumen, delivery focus and the ability to unite diverse teams behind a common objective in a fast-moving international environment.

We're looking for:

  • A degree in a STEM discipline (or equivalent experience) and chartered status with a recognised professional body such as APM, or equivalent demonstrable expertise.

  • Experience delivering complex major infrastructure, energy or nuclear programmes, particularly during development, design, licensing or pre-construction phases.

  • We'll ask you about your experience leading large, integrated programmes involving multiple stakeholders, contractors, regulators and customers.

  • Strong commercial awareness, including contract delivery, change management, programme governance and NEC contracting experience.

Location

This role can be based at any Rolls-Royce SMR location. We offer hybrid working, however reasonably frequent international travel will be required, particularly to support customer projects in the Czech Republic and Sweden, with travel expected for up to one week per month.

What's in it for me?

The salary for this role will be competitive and dependent on the experience, skills and knowledge you bring. Alongside a performance-related bonus, pension and flexible benefits package, you'll have the opportunity to play a leading role in delivering one of Europe's most ambitious clean energy programmes. You'll join a collaborative, innovative organisation committed to professional development, inclusion and long-term career growth.

We anticipate a great deal of interest in these roles and you may be asked to provide further examples and evidence of your experience and skills to enable us to refine a shortlist. We anticipate that we shall conduct first round interviews in the third week of August.




Pay Range:

£110,400.00

-

You’ll be joining a forward-thinking organisation that values transparency, fairness, and innovation. We offer:


• A flexible, inclusive, and supportive working environment.

• A culture that values diversity, innovation, and continuous learning.


We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. Inclusivity is important to us, and as a Disability Confident organisation, we are committed to fair, supportive, and continually improving recruitment practices that ensure everyone has the opportunity to thrive.


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. If you feel you meet 75% of the requirements for this role, we would love to hear from you.

title: Product Manager
description:
Overview

Commercial Engineering & AI (CEAI) is the frontier organization for Microsoft’s Commercial Business. We bring together AI‑native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to reimagine how work gets done - at scale and with impact. Our mission is to unlock new ways of operating through intelligent systems while creating the conditions for our teams to do the most meaningful work of their careers.

Customer Success Engineering (CSE) sits within CEAI and builds the AI-powered platforms, applications, and agents that transform how Microsoft engages, retains, and grows its customers. We operate as a builder organization — we ship, measure real usage, and ship again — pairing deep domain expertise with AI-assisted development to move from idea to validated value in days rather than quarters using Microsoft technology stack. If you’re excited to build, experiment, and shape the future of commercial execution with AI at the core, we invite you to apply.

We are looking for a Product Manager who is equal parts Product Strategist and hands-on AI Builder. This is an AI-native product role: you won’t just define what to build — you’ll use AI to build it. You will set the strategy for the next wave of AI solutions across Microsoft’s Customer Success motion, then rapidly prototype and ship those solutions yourself using AI-assisted development. This role blends two operating modes. Great candidates are strong in both — and comfortable moving between them daily:

Product Strategist

  • Owns the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for AI-first applications.
  • Frames the problem spaces, defines the bets, and sequences the portfolio.
  • Translates business goals into measurable product outcomes.
  • Aligns leaders, engineering, and design around a shared strategy

AI Builder

  • Uses AI to build — prototypes and ships applications, agents, and workflows.
  • Turns concepts into working demos in days, not quarters.
  • Instruments builds with telemetry and evals for AI quality and impact.
  • Raises team throughput by applying AI to the product-development loop.

Your work will directly impact multi-billion-dollar businesses — fueling revenue growth, sharpening competitive advantage, and optimizing margins. You will also push the latest AI frontiers, including autonomous agentic workflows, deep research and reasoning, and multi-agent frameworks, while maintaining a relentless focus on high-quality user experiences — from conversational UX to emerging interaction models across the Microsoft and Copilot ecosystem. Just as importantly, you will use AI to raise the productivity of the entire product organization, establishing the tools, patterns, and evals that let the team ship better products, faster.

This role reflects how product management is evolving in CSE — from requirements author to builder and decision architect. We look for people who consistently demonstrate four shifts:

  • Builder, not just author. Move beyond specifications to build lightweight business models, decision flows, prototypes, and AI-assisted experiments that stakeholders can evaluate before engineering commits — using AI-assisted development to check in production-ready code for enhancements where it accelerates learning. The goal is to shrink the distance between an idea and validated business value.
  • Systems thinker. Sees every feature as a node in a larger system rather than a standalone deliverable — thinking end-to-end from upstream inputs to downstream impact. Asks "how should the system behave to achieve the outcome?" rather than "what feature should we build?" Uses AI to model systems, expose hidden dependencies, generate edge cases, and evaluate downstream impacts before implementation begins.
  • Intelligent orchestrator. Treat AI as a reasoning partner that challenges assumptions, proposes alternatives, and automates routine coordination — synthesizing requirements, summarizing decisions, and surfacing risks — so your time is reinvested in ambiguous problems and strategic calls.
  • Decision architect. Shifts from "is the requirement complete?" to "do we have evidence the solution will achieve the outcome?" Defines evals up front and lets data — not opinion — drive the call, generating evidence through business-rule simulation, scenario modeling, edge-case generation, and prototype validation. Correctness before code.


Responsibilities

Responsibilities

Set the Strategy

  • Own the vision and roadmap. Define a multi-quarter product strategy for AI-first applications, translating business goals into a coherent portfolio of prioritized scenarios and bets.
  • Envision the next wave. Lead scenario envisioning and UX & technical product design for agentic and Copilot-powered experiences; advise on GTM, adoption, and evolving portfolio strategy.
  • Shape long-term direction. Capture, frame, and drive key product insights and ecosystem signals from the market to shape the future of Microsoft AI platform, apps, and toolset.
  • Lead prioritization, backlog management, and cross-team alignment, focusing teams on the highest-impact work

Build with AI

  • Prototype, don’t just spec. Use AI to rapidly build applications, agents, and workflows with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and AI-assisted (low-code / “vibe coding”) development.
  • Turn concepts into working software. Stand up functional demos and pilots in days, validate them with real users, and iterate quickly toward production.
  • Ship production quality. Partner with engineering to build and ship robust, reliable, inclusive experiences — owning quality and adoption end to end.
  • Instrument everything. Define telemetry, dashboards, and evaluations to measure AI quality (accuracy, groundedness, latency) and business impact; use the data to validate improvements and inform decisions.
  • Put AI in your build pipeline. Use AI-assisted coding (e.g., GitHub Copilot), AI-generated tests, and AI-assisted code review to compress the distance from idea to shipped capability.
  • Ship, measure, ship again. Treat lead time and deployment frequency as first-class; release, watch real usage and telemetry, and iterate fast — killing what shows no signal and scaling what does.

Increase Productivity with AI

  • Apply AI to the product loop. Use AI to accelerate research, PRD generation, competitive analysis, user-feedback synthesis, and reporting — raising both the throughput and the quality of the product org.
  • Build reusable leverage. Establish patterns, templates, and internal tools that make PMs and engineers across the team measurably more productive.

Lead Across Teams

  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Work with product designers, architects, executives, and end-users to define requirements, prioritize scenarios, and drive execution.
  • Evangelize the frontier. Research, contextualize, prototype, and evangelize frontier technology trends to drive long-term product shifts.
  • Communicate and influence. Clearly articulate goals, findings, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree AND 5 years of experience in product / service / program management or software development, OR equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrable experience building and shipping AI applications and agents — such as conversational UX, agent frameworks, and/or GPT / Copilot solutions.
  • Hands-on builder: proven ability to prototype applications yourself using AI development tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Recent shipping experience of AI and agentic solutions to solve a business problem and strong awareness of the rapidly evolving AI landscape
  • Track record of using AI tools to increase personal and team productivity
  • Demonstrated use of AI across the build pipeline — AI-assisted coding (e.g., GitHub Copilot), AI-generated tests, and AI-assisted code review — to increase engineering throughput and ship more with the same team.
  • Hypothesis-driven and experiment-oriented: comfortable prototyping, validating with real telemetry, and making fast scale-or-kill decisions.
  • Ability to build data-driven product experiences — define metrics and evals, and use analytics and telemetry to derive insights for product and business decisions.
  • Self-starter with curiosity, comfortable with ambiguity and rapidly changing environments; strong cross-group collaboration, problem-solving skills, and a demonstrated growth mindset.

This position is based in Microsoft Hyderabad, and the employee is expected to work from the office 100% of the time.

title: Creative Design Senior Specialist
description:
Hours:

35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with a minimum of 3 days per week to be worked at Head Office in Skipton

Salary:

£44,000 Per Annum

Closing Date:

Fri, 7 Aug 2026

Can you bring big ideas to life? Do you love turning insight, brand and visual thinking into creative work that people actually notice?

We’re looking for a Creative Design Lead to help shape how Skipton Building Society and the wider Skipton Group look, feel and communicate across print and digital channels. You’ll create compelling visual and conceptual work, combining strong creative craft with the kind of fresh thinking that helps a brand stand out.

This is a role for someone who can do more than make things look good. You’ll bring original ideas, challenge the obvious, and help raise the standard of creative work across the team. You’ll work from brief to delivery, creating campaigns, communications and design that feel on-brand, channel-appropriate and built around real people.

At Skipton, we're founded on fairness. We exist to do right by our members - and we believe that starts with doing right by our people. So whoever you are and whatever you bring, there's a place for you here and a genuine plan for where you go next.

What You’ll Do

Here in enabling Functions you’ll tackle big challenges, drive change and watch your career soar. You’ll be part of a team that keeps us running and you’ll have people from all corners of our business counting on you. Every idea you have, every process you improve helps support colleagues, support members to buy homes, and save for the future. None of it happens without you.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Generating original creative concepts and ideas, bringing a clear point of view to every brief

  • Developing visual ideas across print and digital channels, ensuring creative work stretches effectively across platforms and delivers impact in digital spaces

  • Working with the Creative Manager and other designers to help develop, evolve and embed our visual identity across the Skipton Group and Skipton Building Society brands

  • Presenting and explaining creative ideas clearly to senior stakeholders, building confidence through the strength of your thinking

  • Staying close to trends in advertising, design and culture, using your expertise to help grow our digital creative capability and raise creative standards across the team

What You’ll Need

  • Proven experience as a senior designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates both exceptional creative craft and conceptual thinking

  • Experience creating creative work within a regulated environment for established brands, where trust, reputation and customer outcomes matter as much as creativity

  • A strong digital background, with experience creating work across a range of digital channels, formats and emerging creative trends

  • Advanced knowledge of industry-standard creative tools, such as Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma

  • Strong visual design skills, creative flair and a genuine interest in what makes communication work

  • The ability to work across strategic, concept and executional phases of design with confidence

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build relationships, influence others, present creative ideas confidently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

What’s In It For You

Your work matters.

And the way we reward you matters, too.

At Skipton, we offer pay and benefits that really do make life better, together with a genuine thank you for making a difference.

  • Annual discretionary bonus scheme

  • 25 days standard annual leave + bank holidays + rising 1 day per year of service to a max of 30 days

  • Matching employer pension contribution (up to 10% per annum)

  • Colleague Mortgages and access to Skipton products and services at discounted rates

  • Flexible working to help balance your commitments

  • Private medical insurance, health and wellbeing app, volunteering opportunities, cycle-to-work scheme, discounted gym memberships

  • Lifestyle perks such as a Home and Tech voucher, which can be used at John Lewis, Currys, and IKEA

We’re here to make life better for our members.
About Skipton.

Our story began in 1853 in Skipton, North Yorkshire. Today, you’ll find us across England and Scotland, from Aberdeen to Plymouth.

We help over a million members put down roots, save for what matters, and feel good about their money. As a mutual, they own us, so everything we do is for them. You'll feel that same fairness and purpose in how all 2,500 of our colleagues work together, too

It all means that life at Skipton is more exciting than you imagine.

What it's like to work here
Life at Skipton

We talk and we listen to each other. And we make decisions as a team. That way, you get all the support you need to do work that works for everyone.

At Skipton we value work life balance and are proud to support hybrid and flexible working. This opportunity is for 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, and you’ll spend a minimum of 3 days a week collaborating with colleagues at our Head Office in Skipton.

We also value what everyone brings to Skipton. And we create a fair place where you can be yourself. Our colleague networks play a big role in this. They connect people with similar life experiences and make our workplace warm, friendly, inclusive and welcoming.

It’s not just our members who are important to us.
You are, too.

Lots of organisations talk about wellbeing, but they don’t always back it up. As a mutual, we put people first. And that includes the people who work here. So, when we say we care about your wellbeing, we mean it.

Wellbeing isn't just one thing. It’s about feeling good, having energy, and being able to be yourself and perform at your best. That’s why we offer help for your mental and physical health across five key areas.

What’s more, it’s help that you can actually use too - not just read about.

Apply now

Sounds like you? Then apply now.

You don't need to tick every box - we look for people who care about our members and who want to grow at the same time. The rest can follow

title: Senior / Principal Sustainability Consultant – BREEAM Assessor
description:
At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference because we recognise our responsibility to lead the creation of a better industry and the journey to Net Zero. We are driven to help build a world where opportunities are open to all, people can live healthy, safe lives and society has a positive impact on the natural world around it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust, deliver better outcomes for our clients, help our people to realise their potential, and do our part to create a prosperous society.

Our team is dynamic, innovative, and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and supportive company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity, and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world across a variety of sectors.

Our vision is based on the interconnected strands of being ‘Green, Productive and Inclusive’ and we are now looking to expand our growing Sustainability team in the UK to meet the increasing demand across our varied and diverse client base.

Our Team

Our Sustainability team specialises in helping client organisations to measure, manage and reduce energy consumption, carbon emissions, and achieve wider sustainability aims. Our services include, but are not limited to:

  • Delivery of city/regional carbon reduction programmes;
  • Development of carbon management strategies, including Net Zero strategies;
  • Whole Life Carbon and greenhouse gas reporting, and associated ESG disclosures;
  • Identification and assessment of energy saving opportunities and investment case support;
  • Green building certification assurance on real estate capital projects;
  • Estates decarbonisation plan and heat decarbonisation plans; and
  • Net Zero programme management and delivery.

Our specialist sustainable Cities & Workplaces team is growing in response to rising demand from private and public sector organisations. We are seeking individuals with experience and knowledge in building certification, and/or real estate decarbonisation to boost our resources.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior or Principal Sustainability Consultant to play a key role in leading our growing UK building certification team. Working closely with our UK and international sustainability specialists—who have helped shape global Net Zero Carbon frameworks—you will support business development, strengthen our market presence, and promote our innovative sustainability services.

In this leadership role, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary colleagues to design, analyse, model, report, and present sustainability strategies across a diverse project portfolio. You will be central to expanding our team’s capabilities and driving high-quality delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the delivery of building certification projects and competitive bids.
  • Provide expert technical guidance on BREEAM, WELL and other certification schemes.
  • Support clients in setting decarbonisation targets and defining practical pathways to achieve them.
  • Assist senior colleagues in the successful delivery of projects.
  • Coordinate with clients, project partners and key stakeholders.
  • Deliver strategic sustainability advice during early project design stages.
  • Produce concise technical summaries and detailed technical reports.
  • Analyse large datasets and translate findings into clear, robust outputs.
  • Mentor junior consultants and provide support to senior team members.
  • Oversee internal quality assurance procedures.
  • Recommend effective low carbon design measures to clients and designers.
  • Present technical findings and project outcomes to clients.

Skills & Expertise

  • Strong understanding of building design, construction processes, and material performance.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team development capabilities.
  • Deep knowledge of BREEAM, WELL, and other environmental performance standards.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to guide multidisciplinary teams through certification processes.
  • Experience preparing and leading tenders and proposals.

Qualifications

  • Degree (or equivalent) in engineering, architecture, building services or related discipline.
  • Demonstrable expertise in building certification schemes.
  • Strong grounding in environmental impact assessment and environmental science.
  • 5+ years’ experience in sustainability consulting within the built environment.
  • Licensed BREEAM Assessor.
  • Proven experience delivering certification projects and leading or mentoring teams.
  • Experience integrating low carbon and climate resilient design solutions.
  • Commercial awareness related to business development, marketing, and proposal writing.
  • Excellent communication skills and proactive problem-solving abilities.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

title: Byggeleder til H.P. Christensen & Søn A/S
description:
H.P. Christensen & Søn A/S søger en erfaren byggeleder til at styrke virksomhedens projektorganisation. Er du VVS-uddannet eller har du en tilsvarende teknisk baggrund, og trives du med at have det fulde overblik over projekter fra planlægning til aflevering? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Om stillingen

Som byggeleder får du det overordnede ansvar for at drive virksomhedens projekter sikkert og effektivt fra opstart til aflevering. Du bliver bindeled mellem kunder, bygherrer, samarbejdspartnere og virksomhedens montører, og du sikrer, at opgaverne løses i den rette kvalitet, til tiden og inden for den aftalte økonomi. Opgaverne er hovedsageligt i Københavnsområdet, heraf en del som hovedentreprenør.

Dine primære opgaver bliver blandt andet:

  • Planlægning og styring af VVS-projekter fra start til aflevering

  • Koordinering af montører, underentreprenører og materialeleverancer

  • Løbende dialog med bygherrer, rådgivere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere på byggepladsen

  • Opfølgning på tidsplaner, økonomi og kvalitet gennem hele projektforløbet

  • Sikring af arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhed på pladsen

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring som byggeleder, projektleder eller formand inden for VVS, installation eller beslægtede fag

  • Har en solid teknisk forståelse for VVS-installationer, gerne suppleret med relevant efteruddannelse

  • Er en god kommunikator, der kan begå dig lige så naturligt over for en bygherre som over for montøren på pladsen

  • Arbejder struktureret og kan holde overblikket, når flere projekter kører sideløbende

  • Har kørekort, da stillingen indebærer kørsel mellem projekter

  • Er selvkørende, selvledende, selvmotiverende og selvstændig

Vi tilbyder:

  • En central rolle i en veletableret og solid VVS-virksomhed med rødder i Næstved-området

  • Afvekslende projekter i alt fra nybyggeri til renovering af større boligejendomme

  • Gode kolleger og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til at tage ansvar

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Om H.P. Christensen & Søn A/S

H.P. Christensen & Søn A/S er en VVS-virksomhed med hjemsted i Næstved, der løser opgaver inden for VVS-, varme- og klimainstallation for både private og erhverv. Virksomheden har eksisteret siden 1835 og har i dag omkring 40-50 medarbejdere.

HAR DU LYST TIL AT HØRE MERE?

Denne stilling besættes ikke via opslag alene – vi opsøger også aktivt kandidater, der i dag sidder godt, men som er nysgerrige på næste skridt. Så uanset om du aktivt søger nyt job, eller "bare lige vil høre", er du velkommen til at tage fat i mig.

Anzet varetager denne rekrutteringsproces.

Hvis du er interesseret i at søge stillingen, så følg linket ” Søg dette job” nedenfor.

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende, så søg gerne hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte Lars Peter Jensen på Mobil 21210158 Mail lpj@anzet.dk

title: Associate Consultant, September 2026
description:
Our graduate opportunities have a strong record of establishing early career foundations and developing well-rounded industry skills in our Associate Consultants.

You will work on a diverse mix of international projects with the best-known brands in the industry, applying our deep domain expertise and methodology to solve complex business issues.

You will attend our comprehensive training programme where you will learn essential consulting skills and industry knowledge through courses, networking and teamwork.

After completing the training, you will join project teams and provide strategic advice and high-quality analysis on all aspects of strategy planning, transaction support, regulation and policy while continuing your professional development.

Because our project teams are small, you will regularly get direct exposure to our world-class TMT experts, not only in your office, but also across our global locations. You will receive hands-on mentoring from experienced members of the team, including our Partners.

Our culture is collaborative and team-oriented, and you will have an impact on project delivery from an early stage, which will provide a steep learning curve and a structured career progression.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • conducting high-quality research
  • offering quantitative and qualitative analysis of that research
  • gathering and interpreting numerical data
  • modelling and forecasting using various pieces of software
  • presenting your main findings in written, graphical and live form
  • contributing to proposal creation and client meetings
  • collaborating with other teams across our global locations
  • developing deep sector knowledge
  • and more.

If you are a problem-solver who is critical and analytical in your approach, then this is the right job for you.

You must have graduated by September 2026, or earlier, and you must have a degree from any academic background (including STEM, Humanities and others) from a top tier university.

You must enjoy working with numbers as we are a quantitative data-driven business.

As long as you are keen to learn about the sector, you do not need to have a TMT background. As a matter of fact, many of our consultants only became TMT experts after joining us.

You must be fluent in English and Swedish.

Our values are:

Excellence | We are passionate and aspire to be the industry benchmark.

Partnership | We are one team, and we inspire, motivate and coach each other.

Innovation | We are problem-solvers, and we do not shy away from a challenge.

Integrity | We treat people with dignity and respect.

Empowerment | We motivate, inspire and train our people to be the best they can be.

title: Sanitør til skadeservice | bliv en del af Ocab Sjælland
description:
Hos Ocab hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder videre efter brand-, vand- og skimmelskader. Vi søger nu en sanitør, der har lyst til en hverdag med ansvar, faglige udfordringer og et stærkt fællesskab.

Som en del af vores team bliver du en vigtig brik i arbejdet med at begrænse skader og hjælpe kunderne godt videre. Vi ved, at en hurtig og professionel indsats kan gøre en stor forskel – både for bygninger og for de mennesker, der bliver berørt.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab får du en alsidig hverdag med opgaver hos både private kunder, virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber. Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger, men får også et stort selvstændigt ansvar i de enkelte opgaver.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok – uanset om opgaven er stor eller lille.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Deltagelse i vores døgnvagtsordning

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere om den bedste løsning for kunden

Derudover kan du også komme til at arbejde med

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar og møder dine kolleger og kunder med en positiv indstilling.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra skadeservice eller lignende branche – erfaring med skadeservice er en fordel

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering (en fordel, men ikke et krav)

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde

  • Er fleksibel og trives i en hverdag, hvor planerne kan ændre sig

  • Er en god holdspiller, som bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Bor på Sjælland, så du har en rimelig afstand til de opgaver, du bliver tilknyttet

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Vi lægger stor vægt på både dine faglige kompetencer og dine menneskelige kvaliteter. Derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen – uanset baggrund, køn eller erfaring.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Hver dag hjælper vi private, virksomheder og offentlige kunder med at begrænse skader og genetablere bygninger efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader.

Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed, moderne udstyr og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag

  • Dygtige kolleger og et stærkt sammenhold

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Normal arbejdstid mandag-fredag kl. 07.00-15.00

  • Deltagelse i døgnvagtsordning

Arbejdssted: Sjælland

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette
kandidat.


Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakt driftsleder Stefan Nissen på + tlf. +45 25 10 16 42.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk

title: Linux Systems Administrator - RoboGym (human)

You will be part of a three-person on-site IT team, working closely with the central IT team at Neura group headquarters. Your focus: keeping the Linux infrastructure stable and ensuring training data flows reliably from the training cells to the cloud.

  • Configuration management and automation with Ansible, shell, and Python

  • Operation and monitoring of the data pipeline from training cell capture through the Nutanix HCI platform to cloud upload

  • Monitoring system performance and infrastructure health; proactively identifying and resolving anomalies

  • Close collaboration with the HQ IT team and Nutanix vendor support on platform topics

  • Supporting developers with the integration of IT infrastructure into robotics and data products

  • Linux client support for on-site developers and engineers

  • Maintaining operational documentation and runbooks

Profile

  • Degree in an IT-related field or completed IT apprenticeship, in both cases with at least 3 years of relevant professional experience

  • Extensive experience in Linux system administration (Ubuntu/Debian preferred)

  • Proficiency with Ansible and scripting languages (Python, shell)

  • Experience with virtualised infrastructure and HCI platforms (Nutanix AHV or equivalent)

  • Basic knowledge of Windows system administration

  • Understanding of storage and networking concepts in high-throughput environments

  • Independent, structured working style

  • Fluent English, spoken and written (B2+)

  • LPIC-1 or comparable Linux certification desirable

title: Developer Tools DevOps Engineer
description:
NVIDIA Developer Tools team is looking for a DevOps engineer to improve productivity and efficiency of engineering operations. The position will be part of a fast-paced crew that supports desktop and mobile Developer Tools products over a multitude of platforms, including Linux, Windows, Cloud Computing, Android, and other embedded, real-time OSs (RTOS). If you bring excellence and creative thinking while solving issues as they arise – come and join us!

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines for multiple Developer Tools products – enabling fast, reliable builds and automated testing across platforms and architectures.

  • Streamline the product delivery operations within the Developer Tools organization by tracking, measuring, and regularly reporting critical metrics and regression testing.

  • Ensure rapid engineering operations and product delivery by collaborating with engineering and global infrastructure teams to establish and continuously improve product quality baselines.

  • Document runbooks, standards, and guidelines to help teams adopt modern DevOps patterns.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Systems/Software/Computer Engineering, CS or equivalent experience.

  • At least 5 years of direct experience working in large-scale software development setting as a DevOps, Site Reliability, or Build/Release Engineer.

  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging capabilities.

  • Strong hands-on Python and Perl skills, and proficiency in Bash/Shell scripting.

  • Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, storage, and security.

  • Experience with continuous integration systems (Jenkins, GitLab, Gerrit).

  • Familiarity with Git and Perforce source control systems.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to partner across multiple engineering teams to achieve consensus.

  • Self-motivated and adaptable, thriving in a fast-paced, high-demand environment with evolving priorities and direction.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Track record running shared CI/CD platforms for many teams.

  • Experience supporting developer tools or SDKs or other sophisticated C/C++ software stacks.

  • Hands-on background with GPU/HPC, or AI/ML workloads and understanding how CI/CD and infrastructure needs differ for these domains.

  • Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative, driven, and passionate about software tools, we want to hear from you!

title: Quality Inspector
description:

title: Senior Power Engineer
description:
Our team in Yokneam, Israel is looking for a Senior Power Integrity Engineer to join the Hardware Board Design team and lead PI development of next-generation Network Adapters for high-speed communication products. NVIDIA’s Networking division delivers end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet connectivity for servers and storage, including adapter cards, switches, cables and software that power data centers, cloud, big data, Web 2.0 and high-performance computing workloads.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead PI definition and implementation for board-level designs, from concept and architecture through validation, qualification and release to production.

  • Define the power core architecture and requirements and serve as the technical lead for all power-related performance and debug activities

  • Work closely with power supply vendors to align solutions with NVIDIA product needs, and build and optimize configuration files for programmable regulators.

  • Own power delivery network (PDN) design for complex network adapter boards, including rail partitioning, decoupling strategy, VR selection and dynamic load support.

  • Perform system-level power integrity simulations (frequency and time domain) and co-simulation of circuits and PDN models to predict noise.

  • Create and maintain board PI design guidelines: stackup, materials, breakout, routing, decoupling and placement rules for layout teams and external partners.

  • Use advanced 2D/3D EM tools to model and optimize vias, planes, connectors, sockets and other interconnect elements for power integrity.

  • Perform lab characterization and correlation using VNA, TDR and high‑bandwidth oscilloscopes; refine models and design rules based on measurement data.

What we need to see:

  • B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering (or equivalent experience).

  • 5+ years of industry experience in signal and/or power integrity for high-speed board or system designs.

  • Strong understanding of electromagnetics, transmission line theory, PDN behavior and their application.

  • Expert-level proficiency with EM and PI tools (for example, Ansys HFSS/Q3D/SIwave, CST, or equivalent) and SPICE-based time-domain simulations.

  • Proven experience in PDN analysis, including model generation, impedance targets, resonance mitigation and time-domain noise simulations.

  • Hands-on lab experience with VNA, TDR and oscilloscopes for PI/SI validation, de-embedding and model correlation.

  • Ability to work independently in an intense, multi-disciplinary environment with strong ownership and excellent interpersonal skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Deep experience designing PDNs for complex multilayer boards with high-current, low-voltage rails supporting advanced networking or compute ASICs.

  • Demonstrated background in PI co-simulation flows, PSIJ analysis and end-to-end system modeling (die–package–board).

  • Experience with scripting and data analysis using MATLAB, Python or C for simulation automation and large-signal data processing.

  • Exposure to advanced packaging and interconnect technologies (for example, TSV, high-speed connectors, advanced laminates).

  • Practical knowledge of PCB fabrication, product qualification flows and lab debug of complex high-speed boards.
