title: Seasonal Retail Experience Assistant (Multiple)
description:
Fixed-term contract: October to December (with the possibility of extension)
Applications close: 21 August
Online interviews: late August
Assessment day: early September

As a seasonal Retail Experience Assistant, you will work on the shop floor
welcoming visitors, answering questions about products, processing transactions and ensuring the Shop runs smoothly during our busiest trading period. You will also help with stock management, visual presentation and supporting events or product demonstrations. Our aim is to work together to create an engaging, enlightening and enjoyable experience for every visitor to The Shop, so that everybody feels welcome and able to talk to our team.

You will support security and health & safety procedures, including managing visitor flow, being alert to hazards, and responding appropriately to any incidents.

Our approach to retail has been developed in line with the Japanese concept of Omotenashi:

“Translated simply, Omotenashi means the Japanese way of treating a guest. It blends a welcoming spirit with warmth, understanding, and above all respect.

The Japanese language makes no distinction between ‘guest’ and ‘customer.’ In English, the concept of ‘service’ suggests a hierarchy between the ‘server’ and the ‘customer.’ The Japanese Omotenashi, however, is based on a non-dominant relationship between equals – between the person offering the service (the host) and the person receiving it (the guest or customer).

To practice Omotenashi, the host pays close attention to detail and is committed to anticipating the needs of the guest, smiling sincerely and setting a happy, relaxed mood…”

Retail Experience
  • Greeting and assisting visitors in the Shop.
  • Engaging with visitors, enabling them to explore and enjoy the retail shop, by interpreting themes clearly and accurately.
  • Answering questions about products and Japan House.
  • Assisting with retail-related events on the Shop floor, such as product demonstrations or curatorial activities as directed.
  • Staying up to date and knowledgeable about installations and any seasonal or exhibition-related items in The Shop.
  • Maintaining the highest levels of retail standards.
  • Maintaining an understanding of Shop and Stand sales objectives and key metrics.
  • Always presenting a personal appearance according to the dress code and Japan House values.
Customer Service

  • Always following Japan House retail operating procedures.

  • Ensuring products are replenished and well-presented throughout Japan House London.
  • Supporting online Shop activities as directed by the Online Retail team.
  • Serving customers at The Stand in a timely manner and following The Stand’s operating procedures.
  • Maintaining high standards of hygiene and following mandatory food safety standards.
Health, Safety & Security
  • Following emergency evacuation procedures and help keep visitors and colleagues safe
  • Supporting front-of-house security and safety, including visual checks, security checks, lock down procedures and dealing with incidents.
  • Following stock management procedures as directed
Events and Other Activities
  • Assisting with retail-related events at Japan House such as product demonstrations
  • Assisting with external pop-up shops outside Japan House London as required
  • Supporting the delivery of venue hire events.
  • Working in the office and supporting occasional research and administrative duties as required.
Essential
  • At least 1 year of retail or customer-facing experience
  • Experience handling cash
  • Able to engage respectfully with visitors and respond to their questions about products and Japan House in English
  • Able to manage multiple customer interactions and stock tasks simultaneously
  • Able to handle complaints and challenging situations calmly
  • Knows when to ask for help from colleagues or management

  • Able and willing to work a flexible rota including evenings and weekends as required during peak trading. Individual circumstances will be discussed and reasonable adjustments considered where possible.
Desirable

  • Continuous appetite for learning, particularly around Japanese culture and language
  • Strong passion for and an understanding of Japanese culture and history would be an advantage
  • Additional training and / or supplementary courses completed in Customer Services, Retail, or relevant associated areas advantageous
  • Basic First Aid training advantageous
  • High level of proficiency in full MS Office suite

Capabilities
We aim to develop and maintain these capabilities in all our team members:
  • Exceptional standard of customer service through well-established and effective communication skills
  • Places the customer at the heart of what they do, engages and listens and responds to deliver exemplary service, creating an outstanding experience
  • Support the culture of service excellence, both internally and externally
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize work, whilst paying attention to detail

Japan House London is committed to encouraging equality, diversity and inclusion among our workforce, and eliminating unlawful discrimination.
We look forward to receiving applications from all, and particularly those from under-represented groups as we develop our team.

title: Senior Data Product Analyst – Data Distribution & Data Share Capabilities
description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation


At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.


Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

Job Overview:

LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Data Distribution and Platform capabilities, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.

This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.

The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support product and platform decisions related to data distribution via feeds, APIs, and shared platforms.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

Responsibilities:

Data Distribution & Platform Enablement

  • Partner with Product Managers and Platform Capability Owners to support data distribution strategy, including feeds and shared data services.

  • Help define and refine data products that serve multiple downstream consumers (internal teams, platforms, partners).

  • Analyze data usage patterns, dependencies, and downstream impacts to inform platform and roadmap decisions.

  • Support decisions around standardization vs. specialization in data distribution models.

Product Discovery & Capability Support

  • Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.

  • Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data distribution initiatives.

  • Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).

Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving

  • Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.

  • Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.

  • Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.

  • Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)

  • Support Data Product Owners by helping define:

  • Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions

  • Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls

  • Usage expectations and downstream dependencies

  • Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.

  • Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.

Agile Execution & Delivery

  • Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.

  • Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.

  • Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.

Stakeholder Communication & Influence

  • Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.

  • Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.

  • Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.

  • Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)

  • Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.

  • Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis

  • Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.

  • Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.

  • Solid understanding of:

  • Data modeling and semantic consistency

  • Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts

  • Data feeds, pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)

Preferences:

What Success Looks Like

  • Data distribution decisions are made with clear understanding of downstream impact and value.

  • Platform teams have strong analytical support when defining and evolving shared data capabilities.

  • Data quality and semantic issues are identified early, before they impact consumers.

Core Competencies:

  • Experience supporting data distribution platforms, advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.

  • Familiarity with downstream consumer needs (applications, analytics platforms, partners, regulatory consumers).

  • Experience performing impact analysis for data changes across multiple consuming systems.

  • Background in financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated data environments.

title: Søndersø botilbud i Maribo søger SSA uddannet medarbejder i fast aften
description:
Har du mod på nye udfordringer og lysten til at arbejde med mennesker der har en hjerneskade og svære fysiske handicaps, så er et arbejde på Søndersø måske noget for dig?

Om Søndersø

Søndersø er et længerevarende botilbud, hvor borgerne har behov for omfattende hjælp til at mestre deres liv, på grund af betydelig nedsat kognitiv og fysisk funktionsevne.
Søndersø er organisatorisk tilknyttet Center for Socialpsykiatri og rusmidler, hvor vi er henhørende under Det Sociale tilsyn og Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed.

På Søndersø arbejder vi med afsæt i neurofaglige tilgange og metoder som er relevante i forhold til målgruppens særlige behov, hvilket vurderes at føre til positive resultater for borgerne. Vi arbejder ud fra en neuropædagogisk forståelseramme med henblik på at støtte det enkelte menneske i at kompensere for sine begrænsninger ved at udvikle nye strategier med afsæt i borgernes ressourcer.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en uddannet SSA-medarbejdere, som har lysten, evnerne og ikke mindst personligheden til at være ansat på Søndersø.

På Søndersø arbejder vi med en høj grad af selvstændighed og initiativ. Vi har en positiv tilgang til nye udfordringer og er ikke styret af regler men sund fornuft, og ser humor som et vigtigt element i det daglige arbejde.

Som SSA på Søndersø er du medicinansvarlig for dispensering af medicin, hvor du skal arbejde aktivt med FMK – fælles medicin kort. Herudover kommer din grundlæggende faglighed i stærkt samspil med dine kommende sundhedsfaglige og pædagogiske kollegaer.

På Søndersø får du bragt alle dine sundhedsfaglige kompetencer i spil, når du i dit daglige arbejde bl.a. møder sårpleje, lægesamtaler, risikolægemidler og dokumentation. Der er dets lige tæt samarbejde og sparring med Søndersøs sygeplejerske.

Kommunikationen er uformel og åben og vi lægger stor vægt på at man hele tiden udvikler sig fagligt og personligt. Fysisk og mentalt er det et job, hvor man bruger sig selv rigtig meget. I en aftenvagt går vi mange skridt, og der er brug for at have et godt overblik og stor rummelighed.

Vi dokumenterer i Nexus.

Vores forventninger

Som medarbejder skal du medvirke til at vedligeholde en kultur hvor tillid, respekt, anstændighed, inddragelse og anerkendelse er bærende elementer. Har du evnen og lysten til at løfte vores opgaver, så kan du være blandt dem vi søger, men det kræver, at du er klar til at gå på tværs af faggrænser og arbejdsopgaver og have en anerkendende og pædagogisk tilgang til enhver opgave omkring borgerne. Til gengæld har du i samarbejde med teamet indflydelse på at sætte dit præg på opgaverne.

Som aftenvagt på Søndersø vil du få ansvar som kontaktperson for 1-2 borgere, hvor alt fra personlig pleje, økonomi, nyt tøj, optiker og lægebesøg, samt meget mere er en del hverdagen.

Vores nye medarbejder skal være en selvstændige team-player og et menneske med stort M og hjertet på rette sted og skal kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag. Vi ser gerne, at du er i besiddelse af et kørekort B og indstillet på at køre i vores busser.

Vil du vide mere

Hvis du har lyst til at læse mere om os, kan du følge dette link: Center for Socialpsykiatri, neuropædagogisk botilbud | tilbudsportalen.dk (tillidsportalen.dk).

Du er også meget velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Heidi Sørensen på tlf. +45 21 18 52 46, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen.

Ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningsfristen er den 18. august 2026.

Samtaler forventes afholdt den. 28. august 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Stillingen forventes indplaceret inden for et samlet løninterval på kr. 23.858 – 28.148 kr. månedligt ekskl. pension og tillæg. Hertil kommer pension på 14,00% og frit valg 1,29% samt eventuelle kvalifikations-, funktions- og genetillæg.

Aftenvagt 30 t. ugtl. I 5-2 ordning.

Stillingen er med arbejde hver anden weekend, samt på helligdage.

Stillingen er ledige til besættelse 1. oktober 2026.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

I Lolland Kommune arbejder omkring 3.500 medarbejdere hver dag for at skabe værdi for borgerne og udvikle kommunen. Medarbejderne er nøglen til udviklingen og til en arbejdsplads præget af dialog, åbenhed og nytænkning. Derfor investerer vi målrettet i kompetencer, nye arbejdsformer og stærke karrieremuligheder.

Med en placering tæt på Tyskland, Sjælland og Fyn er Lolland samtidig et attraktivt sted at bo. Her får du gode forbindelser til resten af landet, aktive lokalsamfund, idylliske købstæder og storslået natur. Her er plads til både arbejde og fritid – og til en hverdag, der hænger sammen.

Join us and help shape the future of mission-critical applications across large national public service systems. We’re seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join a talented team of experts dedicated to delivering secure, scalable, and high-performing solutions.

The role offers the opportunity to contribute across major national programmes, spanning justice and probation, national licensing, and beyond. It is well suited to an engineer who wants real technical influence, enjoys helping teams succeed, and wants to play a meaningful part in developing the next generation of large-scale public-sector services.

What You’ll Do

  • Take ownership of cloud infrastructure from provisioning through to day-to-day operations, working closely with our Solutions Architect on significant changes.

  • Use Infrastructure as Code as the default for everything, maintaining and improving our setup as the infrastructure evolves.

  • Keep our CI/CD pipelines fast and reliable. When something breaks or slows down, you investigate and fix it properly rather than patching around it.

  • Monitor environments to track performance, uptime, and resource usage. Responding and troubleshooting any issues that might arise.

  • Stay curious about what is happening in the industry. If there is a better way to do something, we want to hear about it. Bring ideas, run spikes and make the case. We’re open to changing how we work when there is a good reason to.

  • Work closely with wider teams to understand needs and provide DevOps solutions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Several years running cloud infrastructure in production on AWS. Experience with Azure is a bonus.

  • Knowledge of Terraform (Teragrunt is a bonus) beyond the basics. You’ve managed complex estates, written reusable modules, and worked across multiple environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and ArgoCD in a production context.

  • Ability to write Python or Bash to automate.

  • Experience with CI/CD (CircleCI is a bonus) at a level where you have created pipelines, not just used them. You understand the security considerations and have thought about deployment from a risk perspective.

Employees of NECSWS are entitled to the following Company funded benefits:

  • Single Private Medical Cover (with the option to select family cover at an additional cost)
  • 25 days paid holiday (includes 3 company nominated days) with the option to buy/sell up to 5 days
  • 4 x basic salary life assurance cover
  • A Group Pension Plan with fantastic employer contributions
  • A selection of tax efficient flexible benefits to suit your individual needs
  • The role offers a competitive salary.

OTHER INFORMATION

Candidates must be able to demonstrate a pre-existing right to work and travel within the EU. Documentary evidence will be required.

All offers are subject to satisfactory vetting and reference checks. Depending on the nature of the role a Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check may also be required.

title: Associate DLT Analyst (Graduate)
description:
Associate DLT Analyst (Graduate)

Req number:

R8173

Employment type:

Full time

Worksite flexibility:

Hybrid

Who we are

CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.

Job Summary

As an Associate DLT Analyst (Graduate), you will support the design, evaluation, and implementation of blockchain and distributed ledger technology (DLT) initiatives across ADB. You will work closely with business and technical teams to gather requirements, evaluate technology solutions, and contribute to digital innovation projects while developing your expertise in enterprise blockchain technologies.

Job Description

We are looking for an Associate DLT Analyst (Graduate) who will support the Digital Innovation team in evaluating blockchain use cases and assisting with the planning and delivery of distributed ledger technology initiatives. This role is ideal for recent graduates who are passionate about emerging technologies, decentralized systems, and digital transformation, and are eager to gain hands-on experience in a collaborative, enterprise environment. This position will be full-time and hybrid in Mandaluyong City.

The ideal candidate has a strong academic background in Computer Science or a related field, excellent communication skills, and a willingness to learn enterprise blockchain technologies. You should be analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders to support innovation initiatives.

What You’ll Do

  • Support stakeholder interviews and workshops to gather business requirements, identify opportunities, and define success metrics for blockchain initiatives

  • Assist in documenting current and future business processes, performing gap analysis, and defining key performance indicators

  • Contribute to cost-benefit analysis and delivery recommendations for blockchain proof of concepts and pilot projects

  • Prepare project documentation, technical requirements, and implementation roadmaps

  • Support requirements gathering sessions with vendors, partners, and internal stakeholders

  • Assist in documenting functional and non-functional requirements for blockchain-enabled solutions

  • Collaborate with senior team members to evaluate distributed ledger technology architectures and technical solution options

  • Support the planning and coordination of blockchain and DLT pilot initiatives

  • Maintain blockchain resources and environments within the Digital Innovation Sandbox

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support innovation projects and other technology initiatives as assigned

What You’ll Need

Required:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field

  • Recent graduate with limited professional experience and a strong interest in blockchain and distributed ledger technologies

  • Basic understanding of blockchain concepts, distributed systems, and enterprise technology solutions

  • Familiarity with banking systems and standards such as ISO 20022 is an advantage

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a collaborative environment

  • Eagerness to learn emerging technologies and contribute to digital innovation initiatives

Preferred:

  • Internship or academic project experience in financial services, fintech, blockchain, or technology innovation

  • Basic understanding of cryptography, digital asset custody, or distributed systems

  • Knowledge of financial regulations or frameworks related to digital assets

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project collaboration tools

  • Proficiency in an additional language such as Japanese, Korean, or Mandarin

Physical Demands

  • Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions

  • Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings

  • Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor

Reasonable accommodation statement

If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.

title: Senior Planning Engineer
description:
We are currently recruiting for a Project Planner to undertake duties within our Project Controls team.

The Project Planner will work as part of our Project Controls team on high profile construction projects throughout the UK and Europe, providing performance reporting and analysis support. This may be part of a large team or as the key day to day contact point with the client. Key activities include:

  • Identify trends and root causes of deviations against the baseline using lead and lag indicators, recommend remedial actions to drive best value for the client.
  • Lead the evaluation of the projects time, cost, and quality targets, applying governance controls as necessary to enable the successful delivery of the project.
  • Cooperate with a remote team of cost managers responsible for reaching an agreed, market tested cost baseline and ensuring the client is receiving value for money.
  • Guide and influence the general contractor, ensuring they are progressing in line with the schedule and within agreed cash flow parameters.
  • Act as the key point of contact to the client overcoming delivery and commercial issues whilst preparing formal and ad hoc reports focussing on time, cost and quality targets.
  • Control costs with your knowledge of conceptual estimating, funding stage gates, basic contingency principals, procurement principals.
  • Create and/or work within a cost report, summarizing financials in a executive level dashboard.
  • Understand change management principals, lead agreed change management process and workflow, providing a platform for adding/tracking/monitoring/approving change.
  • Coordinate and lead planning sessions and workshops with clients and vendors to compile the master project/programme schedule, agreeing baselines and a critical path.
  • Understand procurement principals, collate lead times from vendors and client into the master schedule communicate the prioritisation of ordering materials and equipment to meet scheduled install dates.
  • Work closely with the client to define vendor schedule requirements.
  • Actively participate in project team risk evaluations, incorporating the defined risks into Monte Carlo to output quantitative impacts to the overall project cost and schedule.
  • Work closely with the project team to stay informed on status of project changes, incorporating and communicating these to the project team to allow for approvals in the change management process.
  • Hold vendors accountable for required schedule updates and reporting to maintain timely and accurate updates of the master schedule ensuring that the schedules adhere to the defined process and quality expectations.
  • Experience in at least one of the following: Programme Controls Management, Earned Value (EVM), Change & Risk Management, Planning, Project Controls and or PMO.
  • Applicants will ideally be degree educated, with previous industry & sector experience being essential.
  • Previous experience of the following tools (or one of) is also required: Oracle Primavera, MS Project, Excel, PRISM (Cost Management System)
  • Applicants will also require excellent written and verbal communication skills, be rigorous in following documented processes and governance and be able to demonstrate the ability to innovate in creative ways to meet the challenges of the changing project environment.

title: Temporary | Culinary Service Associate (The Olive Kitchen)
description:
The University of Notre Dame Operations, Events, and Safety (UOES) division is currently hiring for temporary/on-call Culinary Service Associates in The Olive Kitchen in our Campus Dining department. The UOES division oversees the University's event management, hospitality, and customer service functions, while also supporting student life, academic initiatives, research activities, and annual milestone celebrations.

Culinary Service Associate

The Culinary Service Associate (CSA) is a “back-of-house” position. This position is critical to ensuring all diners experience excellent food production and service. This person is responsible for cleaning kitchen equipment, removing trash, cleaning floors and ceiling tiles, assisting with set-up and operation of the dish room, and participating in other general assignments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain the cleanliness and visual appeal of serving lines, food displays, and condiment stations throughout service hours
  • Assist with basic food preparation tasks such as washing and cutting vegetables, portioning ingredients, preparing simple salads, or assembling sandwiches/wraps as directed by culinary staff
  • Monitor and replenish food items on serving lines, ensuring a continuous supply and alerting cooks to low stock
  • Operate and maintain basic kitchen equipment safely, such as toasters, warmers, beverage dispensers, and coffee machines
  • Clean and sanitize workstations, serving utensils, and equipment before, during, and after shifts
  • Assist with dishwashing duties, including scraping, loading, and unloading the dish machine, and proper storage of clean dishware
  • Support inventory management by assisting with the receiving, rotating, and proper storage of food and supplies

The Olive Kitchen is an allergen kitchen, so previous experience working with allergens is strongly preferred.

  • Available to start work in August
  • Capable of managing time effectively with minimal supervision
  • Positive, respectful, and committed to the schedule you create
  • Excellent communication and listening skills
  • Ability to maintain a standing position for extended periods of time (up to 6 hours at a time).
  • Ability to move around the café to attend to the needs of guests

Pay Rate: $17.50/hr

The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment. title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

The Senior Business Analyst plays a key role in shaping the growth and success of Moniepoint’s payment products. You'll design, test, and implement strategies that improve user acquisition, boost retention, and elevate product engagement. This role blends deep quantitative analysis with collaborative, strategic thinking. You'll partner with teams across the business to ensure our payment solutions meet real market demands and grow efficiently as we scale. Ultimately, you'll make sure our products not only attract users but also scale sustainably to create financial happiness for everyone.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with product managers, business development, and data engineering teams to help our growth team uncover problems and make product metrics highly visible.
  • Translate complex product and business questions into simple, actionable insights.
  • Build, maintain, and scale self-service dashboards and custom visualisation tools.
  • Own end-to-end analytics for our growth products—from gathering data requirements and estimating opportunity sizes to designing experiments and conducting post-launch impact reviews.
  • Cultivate trusted relationships across teams, acting as a collaborative link between technology, business, and product.
  • Apply advanced mathematical and statistical modelling techniques (including A/B tests, multivariate testing, clustering, and supervised learning) to solve practical business problems that drive high-impact results.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 4 years of professional experience (excluding academic projects and internships) in a quantitative analysis role within high-scale tech companies, tier-1 consulting firms, or investment banks with strong programming demands.
  • Excellent SQL skills (which we will test during our interview process).
  • Practical experience designing, running, and analysing experiments on digital products (such as A/B and multivariate tests).
  • Hands-on experience with popular visualisation tools like Tableau or Looker.
  • Experience applying statistical modelling and advanced analytics to deliver practical, product-shaping insights.
  • Strong skills in statistical programming (Python) and familiarity with tools like Pandas, SciPy, and Jupyter notebooks.
  • Clear, professional spoken and written English.

Additional skills

  • Product management
  • Analytics
  • Marketing
  • Data Science
  • Design
  • Customer Success

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritise every team member's well-being. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
  • A panel interview with a member of the hiring team.
  • A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Project Manager, Development
description:
Plains is an industry-leading transportation and midstream provider specializing in transportation, storage, processing and marketing solutions for crude oil. We own an extensive network of pipeline transportation, terminalling, storage and gathering assets in key oil producing basins and transportation corridors and at major market hubs in the United States and Canada. The company is headquartered in Houston, Texas.

We’re on the lookout for passionate self‑starters who thrive in fast‑moving, collaborative, and innovative environments.

Plains has an immediate opening for a Project Manager in our Calgary, Alberta office. Reporting to the Senior Manager, you will work closely with Plains’ business units to establish project scope, develop preliminary designs, cost estimates, schedules, risk registers, and execution plans for viable projects. You will provide technical consultation to project teams and Operations to ensure project planning reflects operational requirements, industry practices, and regulatory expectations. You will also support business functions and strategies that optimize the value of Plains’ assets. Some limited travel may be required.

The successful candidate will be eligible for company benefits including medical/dental/vision coverage, retirement savings programs, paid time off, and other company offerings.

Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with Business Development and Execution to establish scope and scope alternatives for projects in the initial phase that meet customer needs.
  • Facilitate project planning sessions to solicit input from departments within Plains and incorporate that input into project scope and scope alternatives for estimates.
  • Develop unclassified estimates, associated risks, and schedule to support new business opportunities. Incorporate lessons learned into estimate development. Support Business Development in achieving a go/no go decision with executives.
  • Provide Class estimate development services to Expansion Projects Team. Solicit input from non‑technical teams and develop associated risk registers, schedules and basis of estimates. Review Class estimates and provide feedback.
  • Utilize Project Definition Rating Index (PDRI) on estimates to measure completeness of project scope definition.
  • Maintain project benchmarking database and assess cost and schedule trends. Translate into action items to ensure ongoing project competitiveness.
  • Perform contingency modeling on Class estimates and support use of escalation tool.
  • Maintain project portfolio prioritization model to support recommendations for projects that align with Plains’ strategic priorities.
  • Ensure project designs and constructed assets comply with regulatory requirements, specifications, and operating practices.
  • Scrutinize scope and design change requests to ensure validity, justification, and impact on EBITDA, reliability, and operations; obtain approvals for deviations.
  • Provide project services such as Project Lookbacks, Contingency & Escalation Modeling, and Construction Quality Management System (CQMS) session facilitation.
  • Develop and maintain Plains’ cost estimating practices and basis; establish industry benchmarks.

Qualifications:

  • Engineering degree in an applicable discipline; professional engineering designation (P.Eng) and registration with APEGA.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in pipeline and oil or gas processing, including design, construction, and project management.
  • Familiarity with labour, safety, and environmental regulations; working knowledge of Canadian codes and standards for pipelines and hydrocarbon‑processing facilities (e.g., CSA Z662, ABSA requirements, CER regulations).
  • Knowledge of AACE and PMI best practices in estimating and project management.
  • Knowledge of cost estimating systems, benchmarking tools, and risk modeling practices.
  • Strong leadership, decision‑making, conflict resolution, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Project and project scheduling tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize workload, and coordinate diverse stakeholders and contractors.
  • Cleared criminal history (background) check and satisfactory reference checks.
  • Valid driver’s license and a clean driver’s abstract. #Plains

At Plains, our employees are our most valuable asset. Hard work is rewarded with competitive compensation and a top-tier benefits program designed to keep our employees safe, healthy and happy. We work hard to deliver the best results to our stakeholders, and we also respect our employees' need for personal and family time, which is reflected in our benefits program.

We are committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, without regard to age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. title: Water Treatment Specialist
description:
At Diversey - a Solenis Company, we are the pioneer, the facilitator of our clients in a wide range of industries around the globe. We do this with our revolutionary cleaning and hygiene technologies - such as floor care machines, cleaning tools & utensils, and chemicals across healthcare, food & beverage, hospitality, and more. Now part of Solenis, we continue to lead global markets with sustainable, science-driven products. We’re proud to be recognized as a 2025 Best Managed Company for the five-year running—reflecting our dedication to excellence, innovation, and market leadership.

For more information about Diversey, a Solenis company, please visit https://diversey.com/en

The incumbent will focus on providing technical support to grow the water treatment business within industrial customers in Vietnam. This person will identify key gaps and improvement opportunities to expand our water treatment portfolio, using a systematic approach involving appropriate product selection, cost-in-use analysis, and clear value delivery to customers.

This role also includes setting protocols for trials, conducting customer audits, leading key pilot programs, and securing product or solution approvals. As a subject matter expert in water treatment, the incumbent is expected to train and support the local sales team in water and wastewater treatment programs.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify customer requirements and transform them into actionable opportunities.

  • Develop systematic programs including product selection, cost-in-use analysis, ROI calculations, and operational benefits.

  • Plan and conduct on-site trials, define protocols and standards, and gain customer approvals.

  • Lead the execution of key value propositions, innovations, and product offerings.

  • Train and support the sales team on water and wastewater treatment programs.

  • Share best practices and replicate successful solutions across customer sites and industry segments.

  • Collaborate with country business teams to achieve growth targets in water treatment.

  • Liaise with senior leaders, technical teams, and operations personnel at customer sites.

  • Build strong relationships with OEMs and service providers in the water treatment space.

  • Work closely with country business leaders, sales and technical teams, sector leaders, and global technical support groups.

  • Engage with the global water treatment community within Diversey to align on best practices.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, or a related Science discipline.

  • Minimum 5 to 8 years of experience in water treatment, preferably in chemical treatment for industrial applications.

  • Experience with industrial customers and applications in utility water and wastewater treatment

  • Background in the light manufacturing sector is preferred but not mandatory.

  • Strong technical problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent communication skills, with proficiency in English (both written and spoken).

  • Ability to conduct technical presentations and customer training.

  • Ability to travel approximately 10–12 days per month or as business needs dictate.

Some Benefits of Working with Us:

  • Competitive salary and bonuses

  • Competitive health + wellness benefit plan

  • Continuous professional development with many opportunities for growth

  • Hybrid work arrangement


We understand that candidates will not meet every single desired job requirement. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve identified and you think you can bring value to the role, we’d love to learn more about you.

This is a fantastic opportunity to build your career with a company who are experiencing rapid growth.

At Diversey - a Solenis Company, we understand that our greatest asset is our people. That is why we offer competitive compensation, and numerous opportunities for professional growth and development. So, if you are interested in working for a world-class company and enjoy solving complex challenges, consider joining our team.

title: Senior/Staff AI Engineer - Remote Care (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior or Staff AI Engineer to join the Remote Care stream at Doctolib.

Your mission will be to build AI-powered tools that transform how healthcare professionals deliver care beyond in-person encounters — from intelligent patient messaging to telehealth experiences. You will work in a feature team developing agentic systems across the Patient Messaging platform and Telehealth software, contributing directly to reducing care team workload and improving patient access to continuous care.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design, ship, and operate production-grade agentic systems powering Remote Care stream products, with strong observability, fallback mechanisms, and fail-safe behaviors

  • Build and improve AI agents, orchestration systems, and core agentic capabilities including memory, reasoning, tool adapters, and multi-agent coordination

  • Partner with Machine Learning Engineers to design and implement evaluation pipelines, security/safety guardrails, and metrics — taking ownership of operational AI projects as data science teams focus on exploratory research

  • Own performance, observability, and security: monitoring dashboards, SLO/SLI definition, and security posture, with a particular focus on medical data sensitivity

  • Contribute to full-stack development when needed to deliver end-to-end features for healthcare professionals

  • Mentor and enable software engineers to build confidently in an agentic AI world

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with hands-on experience in AI/ML systems, including going through the full lifecycle of an AI product from evaluation and launch to production iterations

  • Have 2+ years of experience working with Python and are comfortable with AI/ML engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD, and DevOps ("you build it — you run it")

  • Are comfortable with full-stack development and not afraid to dive into React/TypeScript or Kotlin to ship end-to-end features

  • Are product-oriented and comfortable guiding your teammates to suggest trade-offs that balance business needs with technical constraints

  • Are fluent in English in your day-to-day work with the team

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience building multi-agent systems or working with agent development frameworks

  • Have worked on AI products for enterprise or professional users

  • Have experience in the medical domain, healthcare tech, or regulated AI-based SaMD (Software as Medical Device)

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

  • Partnership for retirement funds with Ciao Elsa

  • A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

  • Electronic meal vouchers (8.00€ per worked day), Foorban fridges, and office breakfast

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Parent Care Program: Various initiatives supporting parenthood, including 100% paid parental leave

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • A partnership with Wellhub, as well as free access to the gym in our Milan office, with 3 classes offered per week (yoga, pilates, functional training)

  • Reimbursement of public transportation

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Behavioral Interview

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Python, Java, TypeScript

  • Full-time

  • Location: Milan, Italy

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Salary range:

    • Senior: €57-75k / year

title: Head of Private Markets Operations, RS&AM
description:
We have an exciting opportunity to join Standard Life as Head of Private Markets Operations within our Retirement Solutions & Asset Management function. This is a key leadership role for an individual with significant experience across Private Markets operations, including pre-investment activity, trading support and trade lifecycle management. The successful candidate will bring extensive knowledge of private market investment products and operating models, alongside a proven ability to lead teams, build strong stakeholder relationships and drive operational excellence.

Job Type: Permanent

Location: This role could be based from our London, Edinburgh, Birmingham or Telford office with time spent working from home and from the office (3 days per week).

Flexible working: All roles are open to part-time, job-share and other types of flexibility. We will discuss what is important to you and balancing this with business requirements during the recruitment process. You can read more about flexible working here.

Salary and benefits: From £90,900 depending on experience plus discretionary bonus, private medical cover, 38 days annual leave, excellent pension, 12x salary life assurance, career breaks, income protection, 3x volunteering days and much more.

To make things easier, you might want to save this advert now, it won’t be accessible after the closing date.

Who are we?

We’re Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone’s journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we’ve been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures.

Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day.

The role

The role is responsible for shaping and leading the operating model and support framework across Private Markets and Counterparty Onboarding activities within Capital Markets. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring robust governance, operational excellence and scalable processes that support the continued growth of private markets investing across credit, real assets and alternative investment strategies.

Reporting to the Head of Operations, this position provides strategic leadership across multiple specialist teams, overseeing the end-to-end investment lifecycle from pre-trade governance and onboarding through to trade support, lifecycle management, regulatory reporting, vendor oversight and operational controls.

The role will play a key part in shaping future operating models, supporting new product launches and investment structures, leading the onboarding of counterparties and ensuring readiness for new business activities. It will also drive transformation initiatives and deliver scalable solutions that enhance efficiency, strengthen controls and improve client outcomes.

  • Define and deliver the strategy, operating model and operational readiness framework for Private Markets and Strategic Onboarding activities.

  • Lead, develop and inspire specialist teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and inclusion.

  • Oversee middle office operations across private market asset classes, ensuring effective controls, accurate data management and efficient lifecycle event management.

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding of counterparties, funds, platforms and investment structures, ensuring compliance with KYC, CDD, AML and regulatory requirements.

  • Partner closely with Front Office, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and external service providers to support business growth and new investment opportunities.

  • Maintain a strong and effective governance, risk and control framework, leading audit activity, issue remediation and operational risk management.

  • Lead and champion process optimisation, automation, technology adoption and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, scalability and control.

  • Act as the senior operational representative for Private Markets, building strong stakeholder relationships and providing leadership across strategic business initiatives.

What are we looking for?

  • Significant leadership experience within Asset Management Middle Office, Investment Operations or Private Markets Operations, with a collaborative leadership style and a track record of developing high-performing teams and building strong stakeholder relationships.

  • Extensive experience supporting private market investment products and trade lifecycle activities.

  • Strong understanding of private credit, private equity, infrastructure, real estate and alternative asset classes.

  • Deep understanding of operational risk, governance and controls within investment management.

  • Demonstrated experience leading counterparty onboarding, KYC, CDD and operational due diligence frameworks.

  • Proven experience designing and evolving operating models within investment management environments.

  • Strong understanding of investment management technology platforms and data flows.

  • Experience managing strategic change, transformation and process improvement initiatives.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional programmes.

We want to hire the whole version of you.

We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels accepted and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If your experience looks different from what we’ve advertised and you believe that you can bring value to the role, we’d love to hear from you.

If you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know so we can help you to be at your best.

We’re reviewing applications as they come in, so apply early to avoid missing out.

title: Radiation Therapist
description:
At GenesisCare we want to hear from people who are as passionate as we are about innovation and working together to drive better life outcomes for patients around the world.

Care to join the team?

Ready for a career move that comes with a lifestyle upgrade?

GenesisCare is inviting passionate Radiation Therapists to join our growing teams across Perth, Western Australia.

Whether you're an experienced Radiation Therapist ready for your next challenge or a recent graduate looking to launch your career, this is an opportunity to join a leading oncology provider while enjoying one of Australia's most desirable lifestyles.

Trade Canberra's chilly winters for year round sunshine, world class beaches and a better work life balance. At GenesisCare, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced technology, innovative treatment techniques and highly experienced multidisciplinary teams committed to delivering exceptional patient care.

You'll be supported to grow your career in a collaborative environment that values continuous learning, professional development and clinical excellence, while enjoying everything Perth has to offer both inside and outside of work.

Benefits of joining our team:

Salary and Lifestyle

  • Salary up to $128,887 plus superannuation.
  • Full time hours across a 9-day fortnight.
  • Monday to Friday roster.
  • 5 weeks annual leave.

Professional Development

  • $1,500 annual professional development allowance.
  • Up to 3 days paid professional development leave per year.
  • Access to ongoing education, mentoring and training opportunities.

Career Growth

  • Join a leading oncology provider with opportunities across GenesisCare's national network.
  • Clear pathways for career progression and internal development.
  • Work alongside highly experienced and supportive clinical teams.

Additional Benefits

  • Paid parental leave, including up to 12 weeks for primary carers.
  • Free and confidential support for you and your immediate family, including wellbeing support, financial coaching and legal advice
  • Discounts on shopping, travel, entertainment and health insurance.

More specifically, you will:

  • Deliver safe and accurate radiation therapy pre treatment and treatment.
  • Provide compassionate, patient centred care throughout the treatment journey.
  • Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team to achieve the best outcomes for patients.
  • Maintain the highest standards of clinical practice, quality and patient safety.
  • Contribute to quality improvement initiatives and service development.
  • Support a positive team culture and exceptional patient experience.
  • Participate in ongoing learning, development and training opportunities.

We're looking for someone who has

  • A qualification in Radiation Therapy and a current (or close to obtaining) AHPRA registration.
  • Eligibility to obtain a Western Australian Radiation Use Licence.
  • Strong planning and treatment delivery capabilities.
  • A passion for delivering exceptional patient care.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • A positive attitude and commitment to continuous learning.
  • An interest in relocating to Perth and embracing a new lifestyle opportunity.

About GenesisCare

By joining GenesisCare, you will be joining a highly progressive and passionate team of healthcare professionals and support staff, united by a common purpose: to design care experiences that deliver the best possible life outcomes. The ambition for better cancer care that began our story, has grown into a passionate team of ~2,000 employees across 50 locations nationally. Join us to design better care and enjoy a career with purpose.

GenesisCare is committed to managing the risk of transmission of specified vaccine preventable diseases (VPDs). Certain roles may require the successful candidate to show evidence that they have been vaccinated against or are not susceptible to specified VPDs.

GenesisCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Product Functional Test Mechanical Technician
description:
We are looking for a talented Product Functional Test Mechanical Technician to join our team specialising in Engineering for Cummins in Huddersfield, West Yorkshire, United Kingdom.

This is a permanent position, working 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday on-site.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Prepare, assemble, and dismantle test articles for evaluation, including initial build, instrumentation installation, and final teardown in accordance with engineering standards.
  • Conduct detailed component analysis within the Components Service area, focusing on After-In-Service (AIS) warranty returns from supported Business Units.
  • Utilize hands-on experience with Cummins Component products and various electronic and mechanical test tools and equipment to screen Component Warranty claims, identifying failure modes through structured parts analysis using standard test equipment.
  • Perform analysis of returned components, align failure modes with Global standards and Global Service Engineers, and accurately document results within internal databases such as Customer Care Information Management Systems (CCIMS).
  • Collaborate with various Global teams to reconvey tested components for detailed failure analysis, recovery activities, and alignment of technical findings.
  • Support and execute product testing according to established procedures, ensuring test validity through proper setup, instrumentation, and validated equipment usage.
  • Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot test stands, rigs, and fixtures, performing equipment upkeep as needed to ensure test readiness, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Continuously review and improve testing and analysis processes, supporting customer, quality, safety, and efficiency objectives while ensuring accurate and repeatable test results.

To be successful in this role, you will need the following:

  • Hands-on experience with Cummins Component products and strong familiarity with electronic and mechanical test tools and equipment, including the ability to screen Component Warranty claims, identify failure modes, and perform structured parts analysis using standard test equipment.
  • Proficiency in diagnostic and reporting tools, including Fault Tree Analysis (FTA's), internal databases such as CCIMS, and Cummins service tools including INSITE and Calterm, alongside a strong command of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to diverse audiences, work effectively with Global teams and Service Engineers, and actively support a culture of safety and continuous improvement.
  • An action-oriented and proactive approach to problem-solving and testing challenges, combined with strong technical aptitude and mechanical/electrical awareness to safely operate, maintain, and troubleshoot test equipment, stands, rigs, fixtures, and instrumentation.

Education/ Experience:

  • High school diploma, certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience in an appropriate STEM field is required.
  • Requires some work experience and intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

title: Principal / Associate/ Director Digital Consultant (Information Management)- UK Wide
description:
Are you experienced in leading digital and data delivery within infrastructure and ready for your next challenge? Join our fast-growing team to shape strategy, define frameworks, and lead client engagement to grow our business. We help transform clients’ delivery by maximising Digitisation and use of Data via Information Management and BIM. You'll play a leading role in improving efficiency and supporting client’s Net Zero goals across major infrastructure, defence, and energy projects.

Your role could span strategy, business development, leading digital set up and delivery on major programmes, either client-facing or internal. We're looking for an enthusiastic person who is passionate about driving digital innovation and making a real impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • You are a leading consultant who will provide Information Management expertise across a client organisation and/or Major Programmes, from set up and strategy through to delivery and implementation.
  • You will proactively steer client engagement, develop ways of working frameworks, support development of new commercial service opportunities while working alongside a wide range of Turner & Townsend teams from other business units.
  • You must be able to demonstrate excellent communication skills with an ability to adapt to and embed into different client environments. This includes identification and communication with key stakeholders and liaison between business departments and groups
  • You will provide expert advice regarding digital delivery and transformation, leveraging your expertise in Information Management and BIM to unlock value and optimise technology use.
  • Take a leading role in business development and the continuous improvement of the Infrastructure Digital Information Management capability while closely engaging with our Infrastructure, Defence, Energy & Natural Resources markets.
  • Capture and analyse client requirements to design and deliver Digital Strategies that meet requirements and business objectives
  • Work with P3M experts to steer the integration of Information Management and asset data with PMO.
  • Author key BIM documentation and processes aligned to industry best practice
  • Define and implement delivery frameworks, governance models, and best practice processes.
  • Strong emotional intelligence to support the professional growth of colleagues, promote a positive team culture, and line management
  • Actively engage with key industry trends; interpret and report and adopt with the wider team
  • Act as an ambassador championing the digital services delivered by Turner & Townsend.

Requirements – Technical Skills

  • A strong working knowledge of Information Management standards e.g. BS EN ISO 19650 and the UK BIM Framework
  • Good understanding of emerging technology that can support our clients & delivery
  • A working knowledge of the roles and responsibilities relevant to a digitally enabled project
  • A working knowledge of the creation and maintenance of key BIM documentation
  • A working knowledge of a Common Data Environment e.g. Aconex, Asite, ProjectWise, etc
  • Knowledge of 3D modelling & review BIM software e.g. Navisworks, Solibri, etc.
  • Understanding of dashboard software such as Power BI, Tableau, etc.
  • Understanding of PMO tools and methodologies
  • Ability to set up, manage SharePoint sites
  • An inquisitive nature to research and learn new software skills.

Requirements – Personal skills

  • Proven ability to engage senior stakeholders, drive business growth, and define strategic frameworks
  • Strong client facing, presentation, and workshop skills
  • The ability to work independently & be self-motivated
  • Effective communicator and collaborator across a diversely skilled team and wide range of seniority levels
  • Confident in challenging others
  • Confident in implementing change
  • Ability to lead meetings and discussions
  • Experience in one of our key sectors (Defence, Infrastructure, Energy & Natural Resources)
  • The ability to travel to any location as agreed and appropriate. T&T operate ‘hybrid’ location working in line with commission needs.

2:1 Bachelors ideally in a STEM subject / relevant professional experience

Relevant professional membership/accreditation e.g. APM, CEng, BCS

Our Digital Careers Pathway at Turner & Townsend is based upon a combination of both the Digital, Data and Technology (DDaT) Capability Framework, and the Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA). Whilst we are not using any one role or skillset for any position, we believe the following are relevant to this role.

SFIA skills: Information Management, Strategic Planning, Project management, Quality Assurance, Methods and tools, Supplier Management, Innovation, Specialist Advice, Consultancy

(Note: the ability to meet any role or skillset in totality is not essential and will not be method of judging future performance – these are purely for learning and development.)

title: lakiernik - dział lakierni proszkowej (k/m)
description:
Investa Sp. z o.o. jest stabilnym pracodawcą dla ponad 700 osób w 6 oddziałach firmy. Od prawie 40 lat dajemy naszym pracownikom poczucie bezpieczeństwa zatrudnienia i gwarantujemy im rozwój zawodowy. Jesteśmy liderem w dystrybucji stali nierdzewnej i aluminium.

Dołącz do nas jako:

miejsce pracy: Wrocław


Twój zakres obowiązków

Nie będziemy owijać w bawełnę – na lakierni dzieje się sporo i każdy dzień wygląda trochę inaczej. Chcemy dać Ci jasność - czym konkretnie będziesz się zajmować:

➡️ praca na dziale lakierni proszkowej - obsługa nowoczesnej linii lakierniczej Gema

➡️ przygotowywanie powierzchni do malowania: czyszczenie, odtłuszczanie, kontrola przed procesem

➡️ obsługa myjki lakierniczej - dbanie o parametry i jakość przygotowania

➡️ zawieszanie i zdejmowanie detali z linii lakierniczej

➡️ aplikowanie farby pistoletami GEMA

➡️ nadzorowanie procesu wygrzewania, aby powłoka była trwała i estetyczna

➡️ pakowanie gotowych elementów i przygotowywanie ich do wysyłki

➡️ transport ręczny lub wózkiem gotowych produktów

➡️ kontrola jakości powłoki lakierniczej i zgłaszanie ewentualnych nieprawidłowości

➡️ dbanie o porządek oraz podstawowa konserwacja maszyn i stanowiska pracy

Nasze wymagania

A czego oczekujemy od Ciebie? Niewiele ponad zdrowy rozsądek, doświadczenie i chęć, żeby wykonywać swoja pracę dobrze, bo reszty nauczymy Cię na miejscu:

➡️ doświadczenie w pracy na stanowisku lakiernika – warunek konieczny

➡️ sumienność i staranność w wykonywaniu powierzonych obowiązków

➡️ gotowość do pracy w systemie zmianowym (na początek jedna zmiana od 6:00 do 14:00, po uruchomieniu linii – dwie)

➡️ chęć rozwoju i zaangażowanie w nowy projekt

Mile widziane

Masz doświadczenie?

Super! Pamiętaj, że w Inveście stawiamy głównie na osobowość i chęć rozwoju! Jeśli już potrafisz obsługiwać wózki widłowe bądź pracowałeś w innej firmie produkcyjnej czy magazynowej – Twoje szanse wzrastają!

📢 U nas słowo jest droższe od pieniędzy. Masz pewność, że dostaniesz warunki, na które się z nami umówisz! Jeśli wiążesz swoją zawodową przyszłość z obszarem produkcji i masz min. 2-letnie doświadczenie w pracy w lakierni proszkowej – w Investa Sp. z o.o. we Wrocławiu mamy dla Ciebie idealną propozycję współpracy.

title: Senior Principal Architect, Hardware Safety
description:
Senior Functional Safety Architect

Role Summary :

Lead the technical definition and implementation of functional safety for next-generation Automotive Compute Subsystems and complex SoCs enabling L4 autonomous driving and humanoid robotics. As the technical authority for Functional Safety, you will define safety architectures, drive compliance with ISO 26262 and IEC 61508, and work across architecture, hardware, software, verification, security, and product teams to develop safety-enabled compute platforms that meet the demanding requirements of AI-driven safety-critical systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the functional safety architecture for complex Automotive and Robotics SoCs and Compute Subsystems.

  • Develop and maintain Functional Safety Concepts, Technical Safety Concepts, Safety Requirements, and Safety Cases in accordance with ISO 26262 and IEC 61508.

  • Drive safety analyses including FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, DFA, and safety mechanism definition to achieve target safety integrity levels.

  • Collaborate with system architects and IP teams to integrate functional safety into CPU, GPU, NPU, interconnect, memory, and system IP architectures.

  • Provide technical leadership throughout the safety lifecycle, ensuring end-to-end traceability from requirements to implementation and verification.

  • Partner with verification, software, security, and quality teams to ensure robust implementation and validation of safety requirements.

  • Support customer engagements, functional safety assessments, independent audits, and certification activities as the technical safety expert.

  • Contribute to the evolution of safety methodologies and architectures for AI-enabled autonomous vehicles and humanoid robotics.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

  • 16-20 years of experience in semiconductor or embedded systems development, with significant experience in Functional Safety.

  • Deep expertise in ISO 26262 and IEC 61508, with practical experience applying these standards to complex semiconductor products.

  • Proven experience defining safety architectures, safety mechanisms, and safety cases for Automotive SoCs or safety-critical semiconductor platforms.

  • Strong understanding of modern SoC architecture, including CPU, GPU, NPU, system IP, hardware/software partitioning, and verification methodologies.

  • Experience performing and reviewing FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, DFA, and safety requirement decomposition.

  • Excellent technical leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Experience engaging with automotive OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, silicon partners, and independent functional safety assessors is highly desirable.

  • Knowledge of SOTIF (ISO 21448), ISO/SAE 21434, and AI safety concepts is an advantage.

title: Clinical Research Coordinator A/B
description:

With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

Posted Job Title

Clinical Research Coordinator A/B

Job Profile Title

Clinical Research Coordinator A

Job Description Summary

This position will assist in the coordination of multiple research projects, which may include clinical trials and observational studies focused on lung transplantation. Tasks include but are not limited to screening of patients, obtaining informed consent, collection, processing and storage of biological samples, and collection and entry of patient reported data and clinical information from medical record review. The CRC will assist with Institutional Review Board (IRB) filings and inquiries, and will be responsible for the organization of study documentation. The CRC will also work closely with the research team to accomplish study goals, identify problems and develop solutions.

Job Description

Clinical Research Coordinator A: Coordinate and implement research projects focused on lung transplantation and disease. This includes but is not limited to:

  • Screening, recruiting, and consenting patients according to protocol
  • Scheduling and conducting patient study visits
  • Collecting study data, completing case report forms, entering data into study databases and resolving data entry errors/queries
  • Assisting with regulatory submissions
  • Communicating with study team members
  • Organizing and maintaining all documentation
  • Collecting and processing study specimens
  • Participating in reoccurring study team meetings
  • Showing vigilance in patient safety, protocol compliance, and data integrity
  • Adhering to all University of Pennsylvania and GCP guidelines

Clinical Research Coordinator B: In addition to the above, the CRC-B will establish workflows, pathways, and methods to operationalize protocols, regularly prepare, draft, and submit regulatory correspondences, and mentor/train less experienced research staff in the completion of their duties when required. The CRC B will have less supervision and will need to use more independent judgment when managing their assigned research studies.

*Position contingent upon continued funding*

Qualifications
